1025161.description_html:
4-blocks from the subway stop, this elegant 100-year old Catholic rectory in Gothic style, features stained-glass windows and unusual architecture. The home and beautiful garden create a sense of timelessness and peace in the midst of the city. Guests are awed by its beauty and the almost spiritual sense of quiet. Free street parking by permit. Excellent restaurants and museums are within walking distance. We are equidistant from the beach, Hollywood, hiking, and Downtown LA.

The space
The charming guest room (one) has a queen bed, wifi, desk workspace, ceiling fan, full-length mirror, closet, and French windows with a back garden view, and black-out shades. . The attached private bath has a clawfoot tub/shower and a shared kitchen. Enjoy a sunny morning coffee in the garden, an evening glass of wine, or reading by the fire in the living room on chilly nights. Quite private—we’re usually upstairs and cook 3-4 eves/week.

Guest access
Home: The full downstairs, kitchen, living room, dining room, breakfast nook, patio, and back garden may be used. Transportation: We recommend Uber, Lyft, or taxi since LA parking is expensive and difficult to find. The bus stop is one block away, a 7-minute ride to the subway. The light rail train ($2.35 round trip) that takes you to the Santa Monica 3rd Street Promenade and Pier is 10 minutes by car and 15 minutes by bus from our home.

During your stay
We will be present but primarily use the upstairs level, so it is quiet. We love meeting people and interacting with guests as they wish. We cook dinner near the guest room three to four times weekly.

Other things to note
4 blocks from the subway stop, various teas, French-press coffee, an electric kettle, and refrigerator space are available in the adjacent kitchen. Guests may use the kitchen for cooking. Complete cleanup is required. A pack-n-play bed is available for a baby. A pet is allowed for an additional fee.

reviews.comments:
I had such a wonderful stay here!
It truly felt like a little oasis of peace in the middle of LA. After busy days exploring the city, it was the perfect place to come back to and relax.
The hospitality was amazing, and I felt so welcome from the moment I arrived. I also really appreciated all the wonderful recommendations, which made my short stay even more special.
We loved Rebecca’s and David’s home. Super comfortable and cozy. Great location and within walking distance to LACMA which is why we came down. Highly recommend and would come back again!
Thank you so much for a fabulous stay!  Everything was perfect, and the garden was beyond perfect - I could have happily spent my whole stay in LA just sitting in the garden.

A French gothic mansion located in the centre of all the major attractions in Los Angeles.
The place is very unique, stylish, cozy and clean.
There are restaurants and cafes within walking distance, as well as art galleries.
David is an excellent host, and gave us tips on where to eat and places to
visit as well.
It’s a perfect place for a couple visiting L.A.-

This was our first airbnb stay and we felt right at home with David, Rebecca and their son Nolan, who happened to be visiting  the day we arrived.  Had some great coffee and music conversations and were delighted to be able to see David and his band play at a cool LA venue.  Comfortable bed and fantastic location.  Walking distance to everything we wanted to do, Would stay again with David and Rebecca  on our next visit to LA.
Great stay, perfectly located for exploring LA. House is gorgeous and Rebecca and her husband were wonderful hosts, very kind and welcoming. Would stay again!
Great host !
My daughter and I had a lovely stay! What a lovely unique home and gracious hosts. We’d definitely come again.
Such amazing hosts and home! They felt like instant friends. Beautiful garden. Cozy and clean

We had a great stay at Rebecca and David's home. As suspected from the photos, their home is beautiful and a joy to see. David got us checked in and gave us a rundown of our room and common areas. The location is great - there are plenty of great restaurants within walking distance, and the D Line subway station is only a 5-10 minute walk away. We'd love to be back and would recommend this spot without hesitation (especially if transit access is a priority). Thank you David and Rebecca!
Rebecca 和 David 非常友善，也給了我很多實用的旅行建議

Один из тех Airbnb, где всё оказалось даже лучше, чем ожидали. Жильё супер — очень уютное, комфортное, стильное и с действительно интересной атмосферой. Видно, что всё сделано с душой и вниманием к деталям.
Отдельно хочется сказать огромное спасибо хозяевам — невероятно милые, доброжелательные и гостеприимные люди. Очень приятные в общении, всегда на связи, готовы помочь и при этом совершенно ненавязчивые. Благодаря им мы чувствовали себя максимально комфортно, почти как дома.
У нас остались только самые тёплые впечатления от проживания и общения. С удовольствием вернулись бы ещё раз и однозначно рекомендуем это место другим гостям. Настоящие 10/10! ❤️

Felt right at home! Rebecca was very welcoming and gave me a tour of the house and amenities and their quirks upon arrival. We were grateful for the local recommendations and one of the comfiest beds we’ve slept on in a while. So much to do around the area that we did not spend much time at the Airbnb, though it was a beautiful and peaceful place to relax in the evenings!
My fiancé really enjoyed her stay here. And the host were welcoming and helpful
Amazing people

とてもフレンドリーで親切なホストさんです。
子どもと2人の滞在でしたが、安全に過ごせました！
立地もとても良く、夜でも安全なエリアで、歩いてすぐバス停やスーパーがあり、観光にも生活にもとても便利な場所です。
1階の設備も整っており、お水のサーバーが用意してあったりと、とても助かりました！
全体としてのサービスや設備、立地や価格などとても良く、満足した滞在となりました。
ありがとうございました！

Rebecca was a great host! Very friendly and welcoming. My only complaint is that the last day ants did get into the house and my bags had a ton of ants in them. She mentioned she had a remedy to get rid of them though. Other than that, the place was clean and in a good location. I would recommend.

With only a few quick days in LA, this house is situated in such a great spot! Really easy to get to museums and explore around, made even better because the house itself is a unique gem. Thanks again for being so accommodating!

Perfect and pleasant stay. This charming house is located in a quiet area, with restaurants and shops accessible by foot. All main locations are easily accessible by car from La Brea. We will choose Rebecca’s home when we come back to LA.

We had a great time at this beautiful home. We felt right at home!
The bed was very comfy and we always found parking no matter how late we arrived.
Thank you!
好

The Best way to stay in LA.

Rebecca was welcoming and really informative. We couldn't ask for a better hostess. The room and bathroom were great and the ceiling fan was a life saver. We had access to the patio, downstairs lounge, kitchen and dinning room. We used the fast and reliable internet while enjoying a wine in the lounge very comfortable. It was nice and private but Rebecca was only a shout away for advice and help.

The local recommendations for places to eat and things to do were great. Thanks Rebecca I agree that was the best chicken salad I have ever eaten. The neighbour hood is safe and feels comfortable. Great location with a Ralphs and Walgreens just around the corner. When we got there the road noise was loud but once you got inside we hardly noticed it and we slept great.

Next time in LA we will be staying here!

My husband and I cannot say enough good things about our 2 night stay with Dave and Rebecca. We initially planned to stay just the 2 of us for the weekend, and at the last moment our plans to have our two small children with their grandparents fell through. We thought for sure we'd have to cancel and just pony up the dough for a hotel room, but Dave and Rebecca welcomed us in with open arms. She even let us use the playpen and toys she keeps for her own grandchildren without question. It was a huge relief that they were so flexible and accommodating as our plans changed.

The home itself was so rich with character, we fell in love instantly with the stain glass windows and all of the woodwork. The room fit the four of us without issue. My husband, 5 year old and I all slept comfortably on the bed and my 2 year old's playpen fit next to us with ease. There is a bathroom adjacent to the bedroom which made it easy for us to maintain privacy and not take up too much of the house. The backdoor is also right next to the bedroom so it was easy coming and going as needed.

We all felt very comfortable and at home throughout our stay. We especially enjoyed the (all too brief!) conversations with Dave and Rebecca. They are really special people, we'd be delighted to stay again.

David and Rebecca provide an exceptional home environment to stay in.
The room I used was very comfortable and cosy, the bed being divine. However it is next to the kitchen and road so if you are a light sleeper it can be noisy.
The amenities are very good quality and I’m sure everything is present but I did have difficulty finding some of what I needed.
I think David and Rebecca are often available to look after their guests but on this one occasion it was not possible.
However I greatly appreciated being able to leave my luggage for a few hours and some helpful advice from Rebecca in the morning before I left.

1073348836769885053.description_html:
The glistening jewel of Asheville and the Blue Ridge Mountains. This brand-new, mirror house blends luxury, modern architecture, and the beauty of the mountains. Ideal for a romantic getaway or small gathering, offering sophisticated style and luxurious comforts. Located just 3 miles to the heart of downtown Asheville and the Blue Ridge Parkway. After a full day of Asheville adventures return to the mountaintop to catch the sunset, cozy up by the fire and enjoy the hot tub under the stars.

The space
"The best of the best" Top 10 of the Best Airbnb's You Should Visit -Levi Kelly Tours

Welcome to the FITZ Mirror House, a brand new architecturally stunning retreat offering an elevated experience where modern design, sophisticated refinements and mountains meet. An immersive experience to delight in the magic of nature. Nestled in a private forest setting, this mirrored home blends seamlessly with its surroundings to capture the beauty of the trees and mountains. Inside, every detail has been carefully curated to ensure an exceptional 5-star stay, making it the perfect Asheville destination for a romantic getaway to celebrate a special occasion or a peaceful escape and mountain retreat.

The Space:
• Living Area – Enjoy a chic open concept living space with a modern aesthetic that showcases clean lines, neutral tones and an artful approach to design. A relaxing ambiance with leather seating, linear gas fireplace, 65" Samsung 4K Smart TV with streaming apps, Bose bluetooth speaker and views through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

• Sleek Kitchen – A fully equipped kitchen with everything you need to prepare a gourmet meal or a midnight snack. With dining table and comfortable seating.

• Studio style bedroom – King size bed dressed in Bellino Fine Italian Linens, 100% long staple cotton percale bedding, Samsung 55" 4K Smart Tizen TV with steaming apps, smart tech touches with bedside USBC/A charging ports, room darkening shades and forest views to create a tranquil atmosphere for a restful night's sleep.

• Luxurious Bathroom – Unwind in a spa-like experience with soaking tub, separate walk-in rainfall shower with pebble stone tile, and dual vanity designed for your ultimate relaxation.

• Outdoor Hot Tub- After a day of Asheville adventures, enjoy a therapeutic soak with 37 jets in the private outdoor hot tub under the stars, surrounded by nature's beauty.

• Location- City + Nature
Downtown Asheville: Only a 10 minute drive to the city center to discover Asheville's vibrant downtown area, filled with artists' galleries, specialty boutiques, world-class restaurants, and local craft breweries. Blue Ridge Parkway: A short drive to "American's Favorite Drive" and surrounding hiking trails, picnic areas, and natural wonders of the Blue Ridge mountains. Close proximity to the Biltmore Estate and Gardens.

Whether you're planning a quiet retreat or a special celebration, The FITZ Mirror House offers an exceptional 5 star experience for an Asheville escape. We look forward to hosting you. Cheers!

Guest access
Enjoy the Entire Home

Other things to note
Featured by You Tube & Apple TV host Levi Kelly. See the full tour on You Tube (Levi Kelly Tours): " 5 Star Custom Mirror Tiny House Experience"


Our top priority is to provide our guests with a luxurious, comfortable, safe and most enjoyable 5 star stay. Please don't hesitate to let us know if you need any assistance with planning and Asheville area recommendations.

The FITZ Mirror House is located on Town Mountain in Asheville. It is a premier residential location; a very beautiful and peaceful setting. It is important to us to be good neighbors so we kindly ask to please be respectful with noise levels. Thank you for your understanding and helping to preserve the serene ambiance. Plus this way, you will be very likely to catch a glimpse of the magnificent wildlife that resides and roams on Town Mountain.

Steep paved drive with parking options at the home (or below the home which requires a short walk uphill)

content.localizedString:
HOUSE RULES, THEFT, DAMAGES, SAFETY & SECURITY

We strive to make your stay luxurious, comfortable and safe. Please follow these House Rules and Airbnb Community Standards.

Renters must be 25+. 
No unregistered guests.
Photo ID may be required at check-in.
Quiet hours: 9:00 p.m. - 8:00 a.m. 
No parties or large gatherings.
No smoking/vaping or open flames inside.
Illegal substances not allowed on the premises.

THEFT & DAMAGES:
Responsibility: Removal or damage to property (towels, furniture, etc.) will be reported and pursued. Guests are liable for damage, including stains to linens/towels from makeup, hair dye, lotions, food/drinks, etc.
Plumbing/Septic System: Only toilet paper can be flushed. Do not flush wipes, including "flushable wipes", feminine hygiene products, etc. Guests are responsible for plumbing related issues.
Report Damage: Notify host contact promptly about any damages.

SAFETY:
Children: This property may not be safe for children under 12. Supervise minors at all times. The property is not "child-proof."

SECURITY:
Cameras: 2 exterior security cameras are in place for safety. They do not monitor interior spaces. Cameras can record video and sound when activated by motion. Camera Locations:
1) Ring style doorbell, front door
2) Main driveway entrance

Thank you for understanding. A confirmed reservation is an agreement to Airbnb Community Standards and Etiquette for Guests, Cancellation Policy and House Rules.

reviews.comments:
Absolutely magical. We had a last-minute change to our flights home and decided to book FITZ Mirror House, and it was one of the best decisions of our trip.
We have traveled to many beautiful places and stayed in incredible luxury homes, but this place superseded them all. Every detail was thoughtfully considered- from the best cookies I’ve ever put in my mouth to the Dyson hairdryer and vacuum, hidden storage spaces, and countless other little touches, we couldn’t have been more accommodated and impressed.
The home itself is stunning. The design is perfection and the views are unbeatable. Waking up surrounded by the forest and soaking in the hot tub with coffee in the morning or under the stars at night was unforgettable.
I am an anxious traveler, and after several days with friends and kiddos, we really needed an extra day to slow down and reset. This was exactly what we needed.
The hosts were incredibly sweet, responsive, and accommodating.This place is truly something special.

Claire and Austin have an amazing retreat!  If you’re looking for a romantic, quiet getaway this is your place!  The town of Asheville is a short 15 minute scenic drive. You have multiple hiking trails near the house. We absolutely loved this location and the amenities. The added treats were special too.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The FITZ Mirror House was hands down one of the most amazing places we have ever stayed. Truly a 10/10 experience — I never wanted to leave!
It is exactly like the photos, if not even better in person. The house was incredibly clean, modern, beautifully designed, and so well appointed. You can tell so much thought went into every detail. The personal touches, welcome snacks and drinks made arriving feel extra special.
The setting is absolutely magical. Being tucked away in the woods surrounded by nature was so peaceful and relaxing, and the mirror house itself made the whole experience feel completely unique. It was the perfect place to unplug, slow down, and just enjoy being together.
Austin and Claire are such warm, gracious hosts and made the entire experience feel so welcoming and special. You can truly feel the care and heart they’ve put into this place. Thank you both for sharing such an incredible little piece of magic with us!
This was one of those trips and pla

★★★★★
We had such a great stay at the FITZ Mirror House! The space is beautiful, super clean, cozy, and surrounded by gorgeous scenery. Austin and Claire have really thought of everything and we felt right at home. We also loved the thoughtful local snacks left for us and the restaurant recommendations. Such a peaceful and unique place to stay while still being close to Asheville. Would absolutely stay here again!
Very nice for a couple's retreat. Relaxing and refreshing.

Claire and Austin’s home is a beautiful place. It is well appointed, upgraded and so private even with the mirrored windows. I really enjoyed waking up to a spectacular view. I felt like I woke up in the woods as if I was in a fairy tale.
The house was exactly as it was pictured on Airbnb. Thanks for a memorable vacation!

Loved staying here for my boyfriends birthday. The hosts went above and beyond to make sure our stay was wonderful. Such a cool place to stay at. Very modern place & I loved using the dyson to dry my hair
Its was amazing

Hi Austin and Claire,
Your stay was everything I ever wanted and more. We made a 3 course meal and your kitchen had everything we needed and more. I was able to make some cocktails the right way with your bar items. The TV in the bedroom was the best. We had such a relaxing and enjoyable weekend and I can’t wait to tell more people about your place!
Thanks for hosting a much needed relaxing weekend for us! Can’t wait to be back.
This is a very special place. It truly is "Magical."

My husband and I enjoyed our honeymoon here! This house was perfect. The surroundings are peaceful and private and it was amazing. Austin and Claire left us lots of complimentary goodies, lots of local treats. They were responsive and gave many recommendations through messages and the book that is at the house. The space was very clean and very well maintained. The kitchen is fully stocked and has a lot of amenities. We are so happy we chose this place in the mountains! We had never been to Asheville before, so this trip was everything we hoped for and more! I can’t wait to come back one day!!
Nice place , great communication. Definitely would recommend

Austin and Claire are terrific hosts and the Fitz Mirror House is “as advertised”!  Gorgeous setting and the design elements of the home are unique and well executed.  This is truly a unique experience especially for those who appreciate architecture and design.  The proximity to Asheville combined with a secluded mountain setting are one of a kind in our experience.  We have stayed at numerous Airbnb’s in the Asheville area but none of them have combined these two elements like this one.  If you want to take advantage of all that Asheville has to offer while getting a genuine blue ridge mountain experience, look no further.

We can’t say enough about this stay! The house is beautiful and every detail was carefully thought out. This area felt private, but not scary and exceeded all expectations. It was so easy to get downtown and to other outings. However, we really didn’t want to leave the house to do anything because it was such a great spot.
An absolute treasure! The hosts have thought of everything to make an already amazing place even more so. I truly didn’t want to leave
Nice, beautiful, cozy, modern and well appointed.  All was great.  We enjoyed our stay.  We are Grateful.

Easily my favorite Airbnb of all time.  Just arriving at this house is worth the price alone -- and this remains the case -- every time you leave and return, whether it's day or night (they have excellent lighting that makes the house look so cool at night).  Just an amazing house in such a beautiful and magical setting.  The layout is open, views out the floor to ceiling windows to the forest, very comfortable, modern, and equipped with everything you can imagine.  So many nice touches.  Forgot your bluetooth speaker?  Don't sweat it -- they have a nice blue tooth bose speaker.  Kitchen is fully equipped.  Multiple coffee options.  Dimmers on just about every light (a detail I appreciate).   Could go on . . . . And they are the best and most responsive hosts, who are clearly emotionally invested in this wonderful house and providing their guests with the best possible experience.  A+!  We hope to return.
Thank you so much for everything, you’re Magical Mirror House is really MAGICAL 🥹 It was amazing experience. Modern, cozy, clean and fully of European charm. Highly recommended place🤍
Perfect AVL escape! Tucked away in the woods yet super close to the city. It was the absolute best retreat for our family! Thank you for making us feel right at home.

Our stay at this property was absolutely wonderful. The owners have paid exceptional attention to every single detail, from the thoughtful design and layout to the overall functionality of the space. Everything was impeccably clean, peaceful, and extremely comfortable.
We especially appreciated the generous welcome snacks and small details. The home was stocked with high-quality amenities: an ample supply of plush towels, premium soaps, and a fully equipped kitchen with everything we needed and more.
The small outdoor space was a true gem — private, serene, and beautifully maintained. The hot tub was amazing after a hike in the mountains. It was the perfect way to unwind at the end of the day and take in the natural beauty of the area.
It’s clear the hosts have gone above and beyond to create a space that’s both inviting and functional. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a private, peaceful getaway.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Austin and Claire's mirror house. It was a unique and magical experience. From the moment we arrived, we felt at peace. During our stay we enjoyed relaxing in the hot tub and cooking in the beautiful kitchen. Waking up surrounded by trees was something we will never forget, we even saw a black bear nearby! The house was so clean, very comfortable bed, and the architecture and design of the house was stunning. Austin and Claire thought of every detail to make the stay comfortable. They even left us some local treats and shared helpful local recommendations.  We hope to return for another amazing experience!

Our hosts were exceptional!  They were very quick to respond with questions we asked. For such a small home it exceeded any expectations. The home is in a secluded area but we could still see other homes. The views were amazing and the drive into Asheville was close. The home had all the amenities as a five-star resort. The attention to detail and cleanliness of the home makes you not want to leave.  They provided a home manual which gave instructions of the home, restaurants and areas to visit. It also gave the hosts background and a little information about the home build.  We appreciated the snacks and drinks provided when we first arrived on the property.  We definitely would return and look forward to staying at their other property!

When I found this place I knew it was perfect but it turned out to be much more impressive than the pictures. The location is tucked away in the woods and secluded but easy to access, which made it an ideal location for a mountain escape. The space itself could be more thoughtfully designed, expertly built, and perfectly decorated… it truly is spectacular! All the little details and touches you expect from a high end Airbnb experience including coffee, snacks, and even a small assortment of travel essentials just in case you forgot something.
I’ve stayed in many very nice Airbnbs, this one is top of the list. Claire & Austin are incredible hosts and the home is absolute heaven. I don’t say this often, but we’ll 100% be returning!

The FITZ Mirror House exceeded all of our expectations. We celebrated our 8th anniversary there and could not have chosen a more perfect mountain retreat. The home was thoughtfully designed and impeccably equipped with everything we could possibly need—every detail clearly catered to guest comfort.
Enjoying the hot tub while it snowed was unforgettable, the bed was exceptionally comfortable, and the fireplace quickly became our favorite feature. The kitchen was fully stocked, making it easy to settle in, and the welcome drinks and snacks were a thoughtful and appreciated touch.
Our stay was incredibly relaxing, and we were truly blown away by the experience. We look forward to returning in the future.

content.localizedString:
Pet Policy:
Well-behaved dogs under 60 pounds are welcome with advance written registration at check-in. A nightly fee of $25 plus tax per pet will be charged to your credit card at check-in. Pets must not be left unattended in guest rooms and must be on leash when outside on property.  Aggressive behavior or disruption of other guests may result in removal from the property without refund. Cats are not permitted. Please notify the host in advance if you plan to bring a pet. Unregistered pets will incur a $300 fee.

Guests must be 21 years of age or older to check in. A valid government-issued photo ID and the credit card used to guarantee the reservation are required at check-in.

--- Check-In & Check-Out Times:
Check-in begins at 4:00 PM. Our front desk is staffed 24 hours a day, so you may arrive anytime after 4:00 PM.
Check-out is by 11:00 AM. - Additional charges will apply for late checkouts.

--- Non-Smoking Policy:
All guest rooms are non-smoking. A $300 cleaning fee will be applied for smoking in the unit.

--- Beach Access:
Discounted passes for Lakeside Beach are available for $5 plus tax per person  per day at the front desk (regular price is $30 at the entrance). A credit card and photo ID are required to purchase the discounted pass.

--- Infant Accommodation:
Pack and Play playpens are available upon request at check-in for $25 plus tax per night, subject to availability. Availability is not guaranteed.

--- Quiet Hours:
Please respect other guests peaceful enjoyment by observing quiet hours from 10:00pm to 7am.

Only thing is the cloth shower curtain water spills thru since the shower head is powerful with no option to turn lower, great pressure though. I would book again.
A nice place to stay in Lake Tahoe, near a lot, but also out of the way of the much busier main road
Room was decent, we’ve stayed here a few times great location. Unfortunately this time our room smelled pretty bad of pet urine and when we had the AC on it was significantly worse.
Conveniently located to most things in South Tahoe. Hot tub was a great touch.

Had a great stay at the hotel. Easy check in and parking close to the room.

Can recommend!
Great location clean place Ariel was a great host
Great location and hot tub
It was exactly what we wanted! Great location as well
Great location!

Wirklich eine sehr ordentliche und saubere Unterkunft. Leider sind die Wände sehr dünn, was es mit nachtaktiven Nachbarn etwas schwierig macht zu schlafen (eine Nacht war wirklich extrem)
Lage ist gut, man kann alles in der Umgebung schnell erreichen, vieles sogar zu Fuß. Den Strand hier direkt an der Unterkunft kann man sich schenken, in der Nähe gibt es aber einige sehr schöne ruhige und auch kostenlose Strände
Great location
Great place to stay, highly recommended!
We loved our stay, it was clean and quiet. It was walkable to the shopping center and bars.
I came in for a quick 2 day trip! This was a great place to stay
Easy check-in, great location.

We enjoyed the pool and hot tub.  Night #1 was great.  Night #2 was not great.  Staff very friendly and helpful but we had a neighbor in 114  that had a big down in the unit.  They apparently left the dog as it barked longer than an hour and whined.  It was a larger dog by the sound.  Called the front des and they said they would handle it.  45 minutes later my husband walked down to the office and urged the attendant to come listen.  Attendant did listen and did hear the dog.  Told us it would be handled.  This was 10:34-``:`5 pm.  Also, it was evident when the human came back that night, it quieted the dog.  Also, whomever was in room 114 was very loud.  Always stomping, banging drawers or doors.  The desk attendant said there was no notes from the nighttime clerk and that they had a stiff dog policy which was read to a guest ahead of me and if 3 Peaks was going to charge 300-400 dollars I feel we should get some compensation from the mostly sleepless night we had.  We would go again
Really enjoyed a couple days here for decompression after a long camping trip. Enjoyed the pool and hot tub, near by restaurants and the staff were very helpful.

The bed was comfortable, clean room, AC worked well, nice big TV, big/deep drawers which I personally love, strong water/shower pressure, shampoo/conditioner made our long hair feel soft and smelled great, awesome two level hot tub by the pool, great beach/pool towels, and an easy 3 minute walk from the lake and beach. The $5/each for beach access was so nice, especially when watching others pay $15-$30 each.
I will say I wish there were hooks for towels near the sink (sink was in a different room than the shower/toilet/tub, but overall our stay was great and we would stay again!

Nice hotel stay. Bathroom was a bit small with sink actually on the outside of the bathroom. Biggest problem was the noise from upstairs residents, loud AC unit that was acting strange (turning off and on all night inconsistently) and an alarm clock that also woke us up with strange static noises. Other than that was a comfortable stay. Bed was comfortable. Smart TV was great. Location was great. Overall worth the money.

Stayed here for a weekend to go to a nearby concert. Had a room right next to the road and very noisy upstairs guests until 3 in the morning but other than that, it was a nice room, check in was easy and it was really nice to get a $5 voucher for the beach pass, instead of paying $30 at the beach. Location was close to everything, right between Heavenly Village and the lake, as well as the concert venue. Overall, good experience.

I was looking for a decently priced place near the lake, and that’s what I got. I wasn’t expecting anything super spectacular, so I wasn’t disappointed. I had to wait a bit to check in, but there were only two people at the front desk; everyone just happened to show up at once. The employees were kind and helpful. Area and pool/hot tub was nice. Definitely cabin-outdoorsy vibes. So much so that the outdoors came inside; there was a huge mosquito on the shower window, and when I showered I discovered a nickel-sized black spider in its web on the shower ceiling. Not very soothing to be naked with a spider! Also, the bed headboard looked like it hadn’t been dusted in a very long time, and there were food crumbs on the side table. Pretty gross, but at least the sheets were clean and nicely made, and it was fairly comfy! Although the room had a bit of an off smell, it thankfully wasn’t humid and the AC worked well. I would just say to clean a bit better, but otherwise it was a good stay!

Great place in South Lake Tahoe. Check in was easy. Room was just as described.  The room had clean linens and a nice king size bed. Bathroom was decent. The hot tub was nice, I did not use it. The pool was closed. The property is VERY walkable to restaurants and shops.  There is one restaurant just steps behind the property.  I love that it is dog friendly too.  I would totally stay again!

reviews.comments: This was the perfect long weekend getaway! Everything was exactly as pictured, very clean and came with everything you could need. The perfect location for a quiet evening at the Dome but also a convenient 20 minute drive to downtown Asheville. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone staying in the area!

Worth the trip.
The home was wonderful with the hot tub, fire pit, swings and well curated home with everything you needed including a Brita pitcher in the refrigerator. The owners were near but with the landscaping you could barely tell they were there. The bed was a bit hard and the pillows were pretty small in case that matters to anyone. Also, take food storage if you need them. Otherwise, we were very happy with Jordan's place. It was around 20 minutes to downtown Ashville so it was wonderfully convenient and gave you a wonderful respite in nature as well.

Great place to stay if you want to be outside of downtown Asheville but still be close to everything. The property is peaceful and exactly as the pictures show. It only took about 20 minutes to get to downtown, Biltmore, restaurants, etc. We would definitely stay here again!
Great place and loved Rocky!

This is such a peaceful property. Beautiful private stream, relaxing hot tub, fire pit, hammocks, and a dome with air conditioning and such cute furnishings … what more could you need?! Plus, an easy 20 minute drive to downtown Asheville. Will definitely book again!
Loved it! 10/10
Very nice place and a great get away for a couple!
We had a great stay at The Dome! Very peaceful!

My husband and I were here to celebrate his birthday and our anniversary and this was perfect! We had fun driving a short distance to check out everything in Asheville in the mornings and relaxing in the creek or by the fire pit in the afternoons and evenings. This was such a great stay and we would definitely recommend Jordan’s place and would love to come back in the future!
The inside was exactly as pictured and very clean. Extremely pleased with everything inside. The outside of the structure, especially the 'window' parts and the yard were not as well kept.
10/10 place for our baby moon! Perfectly comfortable with all the amenities but still felt like we had a taste of camping. Would and will definitely come back!
Great place for a quiet relaxing vacation. No surprises as the dome is exactly how depicted in photos. We also enjoyed daily visits from Rocky the pup.

This place was exactly what we needed after the hustle and bustle of our wedding. Sitting in the creek amongst all the nature was cathartic. The dome provided all the amenities we needed for our stay. A perfect way to start our marriage.

Everything about our stay was perfect. It was easy to find, matched the photos exactly, and was serene and peaceful. The dog came to say hello daily, he was our favorite (plus the cutest goats we’ve ever seen!) This was the perfect weekend getaway. Totally zen experience. Highly recommend Jordan’s place!
it was such a great get away for my partner and I and there wa so much to do!

Jordan’s place was beautiful and quiet I went here to get away from the noise and it was worth it… The dome was so clean I own a cleaning business and whoever is cleaning  is doing an outstanding job.
This stay was just what we needed! A great get away, comfortable, romantic, and plenty to do in the area. Will be recommending this location! Thank you for sharing the space with us.

We wanted a quiet, secluded place where we could rest-- the pix of the chairs in the creek caught our eye... and we LOVED sitting in the creek while feeling the cool water pass over our feet. The scene was tranquil, quiet, and private. We enjoyed the hot tub at night, and the dome when it was raining. An easy 15 minute ride into West Asheville allowed us to walk the River Arts District and enjoy great restaurants. Jordan was a responsive host; we highly recommend the Dome in Candler!

Very quaint, cozy place for some R&R.
Centrally located to great hiking, casino, downtown. It was a great stay!

Beautiful place for a serene weekend getaway! Inside the dome was clean, cozy, had all the amenities I needed, and several thoughtful touches (like teas and snacks). Morning coffee in one of the swinging chairs or hammock was the perfect way to start the day. The creek was gorgeous and such a cool relief on a hot day. I loved taking a dip in the creek and then laying out in the little beach area to sunbathe and read. Wrapping up the day with a fire or hot tub dip under the stars was the cherry on top! Jordan was always responsive to messages and made finding the place and checking in easy. It was a short drive into the city. Though the house is nearby, the space still felt very private and peaceful. Might have to find my way back here!

My fiancé & I were very excited when we booked the dome for 3 nights & it did not disappoint. From the dome itself to the how well the property is laid out it all delivered. We actually decided to spend one whole day just relaxing on the property; sitting down by the creek, unwinding in the hot tub, grilling out/eating outside, doing a bonfire & swinging on the swings staring up at the stars at night. It rained 2 nights & the sound of the rain on the dome was very peaceful. The visits from the cat, dogs, roosters and getting up close to see the goats was the icing on the cake.
If you're looking for a mtn oasis that is still very close to all that Asheville has to offer (one of my favorite cities in the country) look no further. Kudos to Jordan & his family for a 10 out 10 experience.

We had a great anniversary trip at the dome. The location is great-close to town but also in the woods and next to the creek. The swings, fire pit, grill and hot tub were great amenities. The host communicated well and let us quickly know about an internet outage in the area. We really enjoyed our stay.

Jordan went above and beyond to make our 3-night anniversary stay unforgettable. Before we arrived, he helped set up a surprise for my wife with rose petals leading to the bed, a heart of petals on the bed, a bouquet of 21 roses (one for each year of marriage), and a box of chocolates—absolutely perfect! The dome was even better in person than in the photos—clean, cozy, and well-stocked. The kitchen had everything we needed: microwave, coffee maker, hot plate, pots, dishes, and silverware. Even cleaning supplies were included! The view was breathtaking, and the peaceful atmosphere made it the perfect escape. The price was fantastic for everything included. We’re so grateful for Jordan’s hospitality and attention to detail. This trip wouldn’t have been the same without it!

Wonderful experience! Loved the Dome at The Haven. Incredibly peaceful setting and still fun property! The creek and bamboo forest are amazing!
The Dome was so perfect - all the creature comforts a “non camper” loves! With the benefits of feeling like you’re in a private oasis in the Smokey Mountains.
I would def stay again - close to all Asheville attractions - without city chaos. The hosts are very kind and helpful too.

1175524394009585983.description_html:
PRIVATE RIVERFRONT GUEST HOUSE SUITE • 15 Min to Downtown Nashville
Breathtaking waterfront views of the Cumberland River from your private deck & fully fenced yard. This modern waterfront retreat offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful river escape just 15 minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, Bridgestone Arena & Downtown Nashville.
🌊 Private waterfront deck with river views 🚣🏻
🐾 Fully fenced, pet-friendly yard 🐕‍🦺
🎸15 mins to Broadway, Bridgestone & Gulch 🤠
✈️ 20 mins to BNA Airport 🚖

The space
The light-filled Guest Suite has tall, lofty ceilings and extra large windows overlooking the Cumberland River - 2 Beds (1 King & 1 Queen), small office area and a dining table that seats 4.
The kitchenette is equipped with microwave, toaster oven, Keurig coffee maker, tea kettle, Brita water filter and a mini fridge with freezer, along with a full-sized washer and dryer to use at your convenience.
The bathroom has a large soaking tub, oversized shower and a double vanity.
We provide sheets, towels, shampoo, body wash, blowdryer, clothing iron, WiFi, Cable TV, Netflix and games.
We are centrally located in a safe and well-established neighborhood in West Nashville - quiet and away from the hustle and bustle of downtown.
• Take a quick Uber/Lyft to almost anywhere in Nashville in 15 minutes or less.
• 4 miles to The Nations and Sylvan Park, 5 miles to Green Hills and 9 miles to Broadway.
• Walking distance and less than 1 mile from popular restaurants, grocery stores and shopping.

Guest access
• This unit is attached to our primary residence, however the space is very quiet and well sound proofed (you will not hear us and we will not hear you 😊), and we do not share a wall with you as there is a hallway with multiple doors separating both units.
• You will have your own separate entrance and private driveway for parking.
• Your backyard is fully fenced off.

Other things to note
• We are happy to host your furry friends and provide dog bowls and treats if needed.

• We are extremely close (~1 mile) from Interstate 440.

• Please note, our second bedroom is smaller with a slatted door and offers a medium level of privacy; the original hardwood floors in the guest bedroom have natural unfinished edges that can appear slightly chalky or dusty in certain lighting — this is part of their vintage character and not dirt.

• We prioritize deep disinfection between stays and occasionally use bleach for maximum cleanliness, which may cause minor fading or discoloration on some linens and towels over time.

body.localizedContent: This home is highly ranked based on ratings, reviews, and reliability.
A quiet riverfront retreat in West Nashville, about 15 minutes by car to Broadway and downtown.
A private deck and fenced yard right on the river, with a fire pit for evenings by the water.
Guests praise Michael and Jamie for fast replies, thoughtful touches, and going above and beyond.

house_rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedString:
PET RULES
• Maximum 2 animals per reservation. Please let us know about all animals, including assistance animals, before arrival so we can prepare accordingly.
• Animals must be under your control at all times and supervised whenever outdoors, including in the backyard and driveway.
• Pets may be left unattended indoors for reasonable periods if they are house-trained, well-behaved, and not prone to excessive barking or destructive behavior.
• Please immediately pick up and properly dispose of all animal waste. Failure to do so may result in a sanitation fee.
• Please keep the couch covered to help prevent scratches and stains.
• Excessive cleaning required due to animals may result in additional cleaning charges.

Absolutely no smoking.

No river access unless accompanied by a host. Please contact us in advance to arrange.

reviews.comments: Nice quiet neighborhood and enjoying coffee in the morning while taking in the river view was a perfect way to start the day. Very proactive and communicative hosts. Easy checkout and our dog loved the fenced in backyard.

I’ve got to say, I have never experienced hosts that were so responsive and kind. This is truly a gem of an Airbnb and I would choose to stay here again and again if I were in Nashville. Not only is the location very close to a highway but it sits on the Cumberland River and it is so fun to watch the passing barges and boats. It is attached to the host’s home, but it has been fenced in a way that you feel complete privacy.  I asked if the freezer which is in a small fridge could be defrosted because the frost was taking up space where I could put my freeze packs for my knee because of recent surgery. The response was instantaneous and done within hours. We arrived earlier than expected in Nashville and so we were informed in a timely manner when cleaning was done and we were able to check in a little bit early. We were offered a refund of our pet deposit because we decided not to bring our dog. Thank you Michael and Jamie…your hospitality went above and beyond.

We stayed for one night on our way through and it was perfect.  It is close enough to Nashville so it didn’t take long at all to get there but far enough away to have the peaceful atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.
such a cute little place for a perfect getaway! super clean and cozy
Very friendly and responsive hosts, beautiful area.

Location is great, totally worth it, the only thing it lacks is cooking space, grill would be awesome too.
Other than that totally worth it.

Michael and Jamie’s place was great. Super spacious, had all of the necessities, and the view was really pretty. They communicated effectively and were always friendly. I would love to stay again next time I’m in Nashville.
Super clean, comfortable, peaceful and safe place! Really nice views and very attentive hosts. Would come back, no doubts! Thank you for the comfy stay!

I stayed at Michael and Jamie’s place while I was traveling from Atlanta to Tennessee to visit family. They were so friendly and responsive and I felt right at home. The space was very spacious and had so many extras. The view was so peaceful. It was just what I needed. I hope to come again.
Really great place. Wonderful views of the Cumberland river. Great space for an overnight stay
Amazing- absolutely loved the view over the river! And so close to shopping and broadway! Really loved it here!

This was a same-day booking and arrival for the pup and I, and Michael & Jamie were quick to respond and accommodate our needs. The arrival instructions were easy and helpful, the space was spotless, comfortable, and luxurious for the compact interior size, and the yard and views were even better than anticipated. The neighborhood was beautiful for a stroll and easy access to the highway still. We are so grateful for the hospitality and would highly recommend!
Beautiful view, incredibly peaceful. Extremely clean, luxurious bathroom, incredibly comfy bed! Close to nashville- only 15/20 mins away to reset and get some quiet. Highly recommend

We are from Australia and after travelling for 5 weeks or so in the UK and USA it was  nice to stay a few days in an Air BnB with some home comforts. We caught up on some washing and we were able to have a few meals at home rather than eating out all the time. Michael and Jamie’s place was on a beautiful quiet spot on the river. Loved seeing all the boats and barges going by. So clean and tidy, easy check-in, had all we needed for our stay, it was within walking distance to the local grocery store if you needed to walk, enough kitchen facility’s to have some simple meals. Michael and Jamie were so communicative and offered advice about how to best get into downtown Nashville. Highly recommend for a short stay.
The place was amazing. The view was so spectacular. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming. Would most definitely stay again. We felt at home.

We truly enjoyed our stay. The home was beautiful, very clean, and had everything we needed to feel comfortable. The peaceful atmosphere and gorgeous view made it even more enjoyable. Michael and Jamie were great hosts, and the entire experience was smooth from check-in to check-out. We’d happily stay here again. Thank you for a wonderful experience!
Great hosts! My family enjoyed visiting Nashville. Would recommend this unit to anyone.
everything alright
Great location. Very clean

This place couldn't have been more perfect. I was with my dog and with the place allowing dogs, it did not smell and was very clean.  There was a small air purifier which is a wonderful addition to the home.   It was relaxing just to see the river whether I was outside or indoors.  Michael and Jamie were very responsive and helped accommodate a few requests I had in regards to my dog. He is old and doesn't always get along with other dogs.  They were very proactive in making sure our dogs were not in the yard at the same time. (there is a shared fence).  Ensuring me that myself and my dog was a priority to having the yard available.  That was SO important to me because where we live we don't have a yard and it was so enjoyable.   Location was great.  Close to places to get food/grocery but an easy jaunt to get to downtown or any other areas of nashville.   I would certainly come back and stay for a longer time.

I believe this was my third or fourth stay at Michael and Jamie's. Every time they are so responsive and accommodations are exactly what I need for myself and my pup.  Absolutely love the River view and some quiet time on the deck overlooking the river throughout my stay.  I appreciate that they have everything you need without a lot of clutter or things a pet might get into. I feel safe and relaxed while staying here. I love that it's so close to stores like Target and many others if you need something. Close to restaurants in the West End area so you don't have to go far. Downtown Nashville is not too far. Thankful they offer this Airbnb for others to enjoy.

This was my first time in Nashville and Michael and Jamie’s guest house elevated the experience. It’s very clean and cozy. The beds are very comfortable and the guest house has absolutely everything you’d need to have a relaxing time. Forget anything? Don’t worry because Michael and Jamie probably have whatever it is stored away in the drawers!
The backyard is gorgeous. Perfect place to sip morning coffee and wind down in the evening time. Lots of boats and planes go by, cool rock formations by the river and birds to watch.
Another great feature is the bathroom. It makes you feel as if you’ve been transported to a resort! Giant shower, giant tub, double sink.
The guest house is the perfect distance from the city. Close enough to get anywhere in about 20 minutes but far enough to have peace and quiet.
Myself, Husband and friends had a great time and will definitely be coming back to stay at Michael and Jamie’s guest house in the future!

Our stay was very nice! The home was clean and comfortable and the view had me wishing we’d booked another couple nights! The hosts were responsive and helpful. I have dog who is reactive to other dogs and the hosts (whose house is attached) kept their dogs inside while mine were outside, which was so kind of them! They also had special touches like a record player, binoculars, and board games. The location was also perfect, only about 15 min from downtown and very close to some great restaurants and bars if you didn’t want to head downtown and fight the traffic. Would 100% stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Jamie & Michaels place.
The views of the river were amazing from the suite as well as the deck overlooking the river. The yard was completely fenced and grassy so our pups were safe. The neighborhood was great for walking and neighbors were friendly.
The location in West Nashville was so convenient to everything and Jamie & Michael gave us great recommendations for dog friendly venues. Like the Greenway and MLRose which were so close!
We really enjoyed our stay and recommend it highly!

reviews.comments: Great for a short stay
Pod39 was excellent, organized, clean, great location. Its a Pod hotel so the rooms are a tad small, but efficient, quiet. Wifi was excellent. I enjoyed my stay.
Great location and friendly staff
Great location and very friendly staff! Place was super clean too

I am local. My sister was visiting from out of state. We spent two nights and everything was fantastic about this place!!!
My sisters birthday was 9/11 and she wanted to spend it in the city for her birthday!!! Our pod was quiet, centrally located to everything and absolutely loved every single thing!!!! Definitely be back!!! Thank you!!!
Second time I have stayed here. Enjoy it every time!

My husband and I are in our 60’s and really enjoyed the location, vibe, breakfast offerings and rooftop bar.  The room was basic compact, no frills, but had everything we needed.  In fact, room 424 was one of the darker, quieter rooms that we’ve ever slept in! Esp. In NY!
Staff is A1. Awesome rooftop view
Perfect home base with Manhattan! Check out the rooftop bar at night. I loved my stay, I’ll be back

No frills location in Midtown. Easy 20-25 min taxi from LGA, about $50. Name of the hotel is hidden under all the scaffolding, so it was a bit difficult to find at times. Easy walking distance to restaurants, bars, metro and Times Square. We stayed in the bunk room, which was...economical. But very clean and worked well for two people who just used the room to sleep. Front desk staff were very helpful and delightful to talk with!
Great location! However, the price was way too expensive for the value.
Great location
Great place to stay, so close to Central Station and walkable to a lot of the sights. Friendly staff. Felt safe as a solo female traveller. Great views from the roof top bar

Peak time in NYC with fashion event and tennis. I looked at hotels and decided POD was far better value. What stood out is how clean it was. Great sheets and very clean. Very friendly team who really were so so helpful.
Proactively told me to get complimentary coffee, arranged a car to airport cheaper than uber, found my credit card and emailed me to come
Back to get it, just really friendly and happy to help.
Thanks to them whole team!
Muy Buena hubicacion para visitar lugares turisticos.
Perfect spot for a quick trip to manhattan

Great location—an easy walk to Grand Central Station. The pod was small, but exactly what we wanted for our stay: clean, comfortable, and convenient. Also, surprisingly, the water was really tasty lol!

Great stay at Pod 39! I booked this stay for my daughter, and she had a wonderful experience. The room was clean and comfortable, and the host was very communicative throughout the stay, even calling to let them know the room was ready early.
The staff and bellman were fantastic and very helpful with storing their bags before check-in and after check-out. Daily housekeeping was also a great touch, with fresh towels and the room kept tidy.
The room is quite compact, especially if you have more than two suitcases, but they managed perfectly well. The location was excellent, just steps from Grand Central, the subway and plenty of restaurants and food options, making it very easy to get around.
They also enjoyed having access to the nearby PureGym, the laundromat just down the road, and the lovely open-air rooftop bar. Overall, a great stay and a very convenient base for exploring New York!

The bedroom at pod 39 was great. It was clean and quiet -- which was exactly what we were looking for. The beds were comfy. The room is slightly smaller than I was expecting, so if you have more than a carryon suitcase, it might not fit. We each had a carryon and it was crowded. That being said, it was walkable distance to lots of locations, there's a free gym pass (the gym is around the corner and you'll need to download the app for it, a hassle but worth it). It's only a couple streets from the metro. The Wi-Fi worked great as well and there is a desk in the room to sit at and use. I would definitely stay here again!

Good stay at POD 39. Excellent Midtown location near Grand Central, subway lines and restaurants. The room was very clean, modern, and efficiently designed. While smaller than it appears in photos, it was still comfortable and functional for two people.
The bathroom was comfortable - the shower had great water pressure and consistent hot water. Heating worked well, though it was a bit noisy at times; we got used to it quickly. Staff were friendly, professional, and very helpful throughout the stay.
One note for future guests: the rooftop patio shown in the listing photos was closed for maintenance during our stay, and this was only communicated at check-in. It was a factor in our booking choice, especially since I was traveling with my daughter on her first visit to NYC and considering it was a driving factor we paid $800+ for 2 nights.
Overall, a clean, well-run, and well-located place. Would stay again if all advertised amenities are available.

Really enjoyed my stay! The hotel was exactly as advertised, and the location worked out perfectly for my event. The full pod was the perfect size for one, the bed was super comfortable, and I loved having a desk, bathroom shelves for all my things, and plenty of extra towels, soap, and hair wash. The air conditioning worked great, and having a hair dryer included was really convenient. I didn’t get to explore the rooftop or bar this trip, but I’ll go there when I visit again.

We had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone wanting a very central location while still enjoying peace and quiet. The location was perfect, close to Grand Central, the subway lines, the LIRR, and Bryant Park.
What impressed us most was how quiet the hotel was despite its size and central location. The windows insulated sound very well, the blackout shutters made sleeping easy, and even the rooftop bar never caused noise issues.
The room was clean, modern, and compact. It was a bit small for two people with luggage, but fine since we mostly only slept there. Safety felt very good, and we appreciated the in-room safe as well as complimentary drinking water station downstairs.
The only downside was occasional AC system noise in the room, likely due to a general technical issue, but the staff, especially Jeanny, were extremely kind and helpful in trying to resolve it. Overall, a very positive experience. We would happily stay at Pod 39 again.

Staying at Pod39 was honestly what you need for a New York trip! 7 minute walk to the subway.
Restaurants,Shops,Bodegas whatever you need is super close. However please note the rooms are really small. As soon as you open the door you’re at the bathroom and bed. My boyfriend and I learned lots of love and patience sleeping there lol. But like I said you’re in New York, you’ll be out most of the time anyways. We showered and slept there. The staff there is great! Didn’t eat at the restaurant onsite but we went to the bar there. Amazing happy hour! Will most likely stay there again given the price, location & just an ideal spot!

Great place, friendly staff. Really cool hangout spot in the back lobby. Free storage for luggage. I checked in early, there was loud construction happening through the wall so I went back down and asked for a different room. They gave me a different room on the opposite side of the building and jt was much quieter. Very nice stay. Even had a slight view of the East River. Only annoying thing were the cleaners coming around knocking on doors at 9 am and then again at 11. We have until 12 to checkout. The doors are not soundproof at all so you can hear everything happening in the hallway. But otherwise was very good!

13434357.ld_name: South Tahoe Bungalow Close Walk to Everything

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: If you have a dog and want to visit Tahoe, this place is great.  Works even if you don't have a dog.  Enclosed back yard, clean place, dog supplies and just all around good location.  Lots of amenities that you normally have to go find on day 2 are provided and numerous hot spots are nearby to include the Heavanly Gondola.  Try it, you won't regret it.

The location was incredibly convenient, within walking distance of shops and restaurants, and the room was clean and the bed comfortable, making for a very pleasant stay. Best of all, the fenced backyard was a huge plus for our dogs. One of our dogs is reactive so having this fenced yard gave us a lot of peace of mind!! Ernie was also a great help—he answered questions promptly and was flexible and kind. It was a wonderful trip.

reviews.comments: The area is super safe and nice to walk around anytime of day or night! Food places right down the street. And beautiful weather! It was the best. Wish they would give a better breakfast but I’ll take a coffee and sweet break any day! Will be back again!
Excellent neighborhood, friendly staff, pool was very clean.

I had a great stay!
Clean and comfortable and centrally located
Great place to stay for the price
The hotel was pretty good overall. There was a slight smell in the room, possibly from the carpet, but it wasn’t a big issue. The pool was nice and deep, and the hot tub was great.

Well managed, well located for a family visit in Highland Park, and close to the fun main streets of Highland Park and Occidental College. We slept well and felt refreshed in the morning by the clean bathroom facilities. The front desk personnel were friendly and efficient. We will stay here again.
3rd time staying here it’s always clean and the check in is smooth front desk is always super nice
It was very comfortable for me and my family!
Love the place, very quiet, clean , safe and all the staff was very friendly. Definitely will book again
Went to a concert at the Hollywood bowl - good location for a fair price! The front desk woman was very nice and helpful.
Super hotel : propre, personnel accueillant, parking et piscine, lit très confortable. Nous recommandons

広い部屋で、コストパフォーマンス最高です。
ドジャースタジアムからもUberで25ドル程とダウンタウンと変わりません。
It was a great place to stay for a night! The location was great for the concert we were attending, and there were places around for food etc! Would reccomend!
Just needed somewhere to rest my head for the night, and it was perfect.

Excellent service, professionalism and very polite people at the front desk
Pool super clean and well maintained

Excelente hotel! Fácil acceso, responden super rápido tus dudas o tus peticiones, pedí una cuna para mi bebé y no tardaron más de 2minutos en responderme!
Todo super limpio y muy cómodo, además de muy accesible a lugares riquísimos para comer cerca y todavía nos dieron unos cupones de descuento para comer en algunos restaurantes cercanos riquísimos 🥰
All good.  Would stay again.

La chambre était top, comme sur les photos. Le nettoyage était très bien fait, merci aux femmes de ménage ! La literie est juste géniale, très confortable. Petit plus pour la place de parking et l’emplacement (proche de restaurants et supermarché). Seul petit bémol, les murs sont très fins et on entend les voisins bruyants.

From the moment I checked in until the moment I checked out, the staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The hotel was very clean, well-maintained, and conveniently located close to everything, with plenty of great restaurants nearby.
The front desk staff was especially friendly, knowledgeable, and responsive to anything I needed. Rocio and Esmirna are doing a wonderful job running this hotel and creating a great experience for their guests.
I would definitely recommend staying here and will gladly return on my next visit!

I had a really good experience at this hotel. The location is excellent and the area is very convenient for getting around and exploring. The front desk staff was super friendly and helpful, and the check-in process was very easy.
The room was really nice, comfortable, and in good condition. The only issue was with the housekeeping service. On the day they cleaned my room, it seemed like they only made the beds. They didn’t change the towels or clean the floors, counters, or other surfaces, so the cleaning felt a bit incomplete.
Other than that, everything was excellent. Overall, I was very happy with my stay and would definitely stay here again.

Check in/out was a breeze. Security deposit is $100 which is standard for most hotels/motels. The unit was clean and didn’t have any bugs/cockroaches. AC was nice and cool. I was surprised to see that there is an elevator in the property which is great for people with accessibility needs and/or have big/multiple baggages. We were just disappointed that the shampoo and body wash pump containers in the bathroom were not refilled at all during our stay; we let the front desk know but they just gave us sachets of shampoo and 2 bars of soap. The walls are also very thin and you can hear loud banging and chatter from outside, so if you’re a light sleeper this would be something to think about. The noises didn’t bother us that much though. It was easy and convenient to communicate with the front desk through texting. The location is great and safe, and close to everything. We would definitely consider going back!

We stayed one night in the family room and had a very comfortable experience. The room was clean and spacious, with a dining table that was perfect for enjoying a takeaway meal. It was located on the second level and we didn’t experience any noise issues.
The location is convenient for visiting Hollywood attractions. There is off-street parking available, though it was full on Saturday evening, so we parked on the street instead, which was also free and easy enough to find. In the morning, complimentary coffee and a selection of packaged bakery items were a nice touch.
Overall, this place offers great value given its location. We’d happily stay here again.

The Hills Hotel was a great stay. Even though it’s not a large luxury brand, it absolutely deserves five stars. Eagle Rock is one of the calmest and safest neighborhoods in Los Angeles, with cute coffee shops, cafés, and a low-key nightlife that isn’t overwhelming at all.
The hotel was very clean, which was the most important thing for me. It felt safe and well-maintained. While it’s not a brand-new modern hotel, it does have a slightly updated feel and was very comfortable.
In the morning, they offered Starbucks coffee and pastries, which was a nice bonus. The lobby was clean and welcoming, and there’s a small pool area for guests who want to use it during warmer months.
Overall, it was a clean, safe, and comfortable place to stay, and exactly what I needed. I would definitely stay here again.

The price was a little high for the amenities. The room has lamps that have outlets in them, but the one I used only worked part of the time. The wifi was intermittent and would stop at pretty inconvenient times. I was the only person in my room and only used my phone (I used my laptop until the last morning). The toilet in the room was loose from the floor but it didn't leak, so I didn't report it. However, it was very close to the wall, which was odd. Parking was quite sparce at night, but I never had to park on the street.
Otherwise, the room was fine. The bed was comfortable, and the room was clean. The staff was courteous and helpful. I would stay here again but only at a cheaper price.

reviews.comments: Delightful place to spend a couple nights with  two adult daughters. Well located for walking to Hall of Fame and Broadway.

The location was great and very close to Broadway, which was really convenient for us. The host was also helpful and did provide some compensation for the issues we experienced, which we appreciated.
Unfortunately, our stay wasn’t as pleasant as we had hoped. The AC stopped working, and the room became extremely hot, which made it difficult for us to sleep and enjoy our stay. We also felt that the bedsheets were not as clean as expected.
We were a group of girls there to enjoy a short trip together, so dealing with these issues was disappointing, especially since we were only there for a limited time. We appreciate the host’s effort to address the situation, but overall, we wish our stay had been more comfortable and relaxing.
Gail was great and helpful! Location was perfect! Can’t wait to come back!
We loved staying here so much, plenty of room and a short walk to broadway and other things to do in Nashville!!
Thank you, Gail!
Perfect location. Just as expected. Gail is always accessible and courteous.

Perfect stay for our first ever mom trip. The place was just as pictured. Super cute decor. Loved how close it was to the outdoor amenities. The building is great. Host was very communicative. Would recommend to others!

We were a group of girls staying here for a bachelorette party, and the place was absolutely perfect! It was totally Pinterest-worthy, smelled amazing when we arrived, and had the cutest girly vibe. It’s also really close to Broadway, and everything is easily walkable. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Gail was a great host and very responsive from the beginning. Checking in was very easy. The place is beautiful and had everything we needed. We loved the pool area which is just across the hall. We also loved the walkability to Broadway.  Great host and great stay!
Will definitely stay again. Great communication.

We had a great stay! The location was perfect—just a short, easy walk to Broadway, with a tattoo shop conveniently located right in front of the building. The Airbnb was clean, cozy, close to the pool and had such a cute vibe, making it perfect for our girls’ trip.
The only small issue was that the wall lights in the makeup room didn’t work, but there were table lights available, so it wasn’t a big problem and we made it work.
Overall, this was a super cute place to stay, and we’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a fun, convenient spot in Nashville!
It’s a perfect place for a girls weekend. Comfy beds and cute decor.

Gail’s place was lovely to stay in. Perfect for a bachelorette trip. The lock systems can be a little confusing and take some getting used to but by the end of the trip we were pros. Thank you Gail :)
So fun! Celebrated 20 years girls weekend!!!

We were very pleased with the location of the Airbnb. It was walkable to broadway but also far enough off broadway where we were able to rest at night with minimal noise. The way the Airbnb was decorated was very cute and it was clean. Overall, the space looked like the pictures, however, there are a few things that could use some upgrades.
Great location blocks away from all the action
Great landing spot to explore Nashville! Would definitely return on our next trip.
Absolutely gorgeous space and so close to everything in downtown Nashville! Gail is a great host-very helpful and responsive! We had a great time and would recommend this space to anyone!
Amazing Air BnB stylish and roomy

Perfect location, walkable to almost everything we needed and close to broadway. Super cute condo with lots of great backgrounds for photos before a night out. Gail was super responsive and helpful and had even left us a little welcome package with treats. Great price for a shared girls getaway. Close access to the pool was very convenient for us. Would definitely stay here again!

Gail was super friendly and responsive. She made me feel like we have known each other for years.
The place had comfortable beds and large bathrooms. It was perfect for our group. The location is walkable to all the places you want to see (Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, great restaurants, and Third Man Records). While stays in the area are pricey, I think it is justified with the ease of walkability and not having the hassle that can come with having to drive and park.
I look forward to staying there again.

Great stay overall! The location is prime and the space looks just as cute as the photos. Gail was very responsive and helpful throughout our visit. A couple things to note — amenities were a bit limited, and we did have to go out and buy toilet paper. Two beds were air mattresses, which were a little uncomfortable. But aside from that, the place was clean and charming, and we enjoyed our time there.

Great stay in Nashville! The location was perfect—easy walking distance to most of the main spots, including Broadway, restaurants, and live music. We especially appreciated how safe it felt, even walking back at night after enjoying the nightlife. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Would definitely stay here again!

This Airbnb was absolutely amazing and perfect for our bachelorette trip! The place was stunning! Beautifully decorated, spotless, and so cozy. The location could not have been better… we walked to Broadway and so many fun spots with ease. The kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed, which made cooking together super convenient. Once we were inside, everything about the stay was truly perfect. The only hiccup was arrival — we didn’t have the building passcode right away and had to wait to get in. Also, the front desk charges $5 per bag and only holds luggage until 4 PM, so definitely keep that in mind when planning your day. The airbnb was also in a very safe location! This Airbnb was a dream and made our trip unforgettable! Highly recommend!

Experience the best of South Beach from this charming and perfectly located stay. Just steps from the beach, you’ll be surrounded by white sands, iconic lifeguard stands, trendy shops, and vibrant restaurants. Stroll to Ocean Drive and soak in the lively Miami atmosphere. This private room offers a comfortable queen-size bed, beach towels, and free WiFi—everything you need for a relaxing, fun, and effortless beach escape.

No hidden fees. No cleaning fee!

The space
*Room numbers will be assigned upon arrival at the hotel. Our front desk is available 24 hours a day.

✔ One Queen Bed
✔ Free happy hour signature cocktail at a sister property.
✔ Suitable for 2 Guests
✔ Comfortable European pillow-top beds with luxury linens.
✔ No on-site parking — guests often use street parking or nearby garages (paid).
✔ Complimentary Wi-Fi (Not high speed download)
✔ In-Room Safe
✔ Minifridge
✔ Iron and Ironing Board
✔ Flat-Screen TV
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Hairdryer
✔ Bathroom Amenities

Guest access
What You’ll Love:


♡ Your entire room— including living spaces, kitchen, bathrooms, and amenities.
♡ 3-minute walk to the beach
♡ Shared courtyard and plunge pool area.
♡ 24-hour front desk and concierge services, so help is always available.
♡ If you’re shipping items ahead of arrival, the reception will hold packages up to a few days before check-in for a small handling fee.
♡ Nightlife and neon nearby
♡ Walk to South Pointe Pier for sunsets & seafood
♡ Trendy cafés are steps away
♡ Classic Art Deco charm

Other things to note
★ Age Requirement: Guests must be 21 years or older.

★ No Resort Fee

There are no resort fees and no cleaning fees—what you see is what you pay.

Your Airbnb reservation includes complimentary:

High-Speed Wi-Fi
Beach Towels
Shampoo & Conditioner
Access to the pool at one of our nearby sister properties (details will be provided upon arrival)

★ Parking: On-site parking is not available. We recommend using nearby public parking options for your convenience.

★ Booking Policy: Reservations must be made by the guest who will be staying. The primary Airbnb guest must be present at check-in with a valid government-issued photo ID that matches both the Airbnb profile and the reservation name.

★ Luggage Storage: For safety and liability reasons, we’re unable to store guest luggage.

★ Housekeeping: Complimentary housekeeping service is provided every third day of your stay.

★ Incidentals Hold: A valid credit or debit card is required at check-in for a $100 incidental hold per stay. Please note that we do not accept app-based cards, Chime, mobile payments, prepaid cards, or cash.

★ Guests are responsible for any damages caused to the room or hotel property by themselves or anyone in their party. Costs for repairs or replacements will be charged to the registered guest.

★ The property is smoke-free. A fee of $250 would be charged in case you are found smoking and violating our house rules and hotel policy.

★ We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone in compliance with federal and state laws.

★ Room Details: The photos shown represent the variety of décor and layouts across our rooms. While all rooms are the same category, each one may vary slightly in style or layout—adding a unique touch to your stay.

★ Additional Adults: An extra adult fee of $25 per person, per night applies. Maximum occupancy is 4 guests per room, depending on the room type.

★ Children: Children aged 12 and older are welcome with an additional fee of $25 per child, per night. A maximum of 3 children is allowed per room, based on room type occupancy.

★ Crib Availability: Cribs are available at no additional charge, subject to availability.

★ Pets Welcome: Well-behaved dogs up to 40 lbs are welcome! A maximum of two dogs per room is allowed. A $250 non-refundable pet fee applies per room, per stay. For everyone’s comfort, dogs must be accompanied at all times.

★ Kids Stay Free: Children under 11 years old stay free when accompanied by an adult.

★ No-Show Policy: If a guest does not arrive for an active reservation, the room cannot be held, and the applicable cancellation policy will apply.
