reviews.comments: Great price, great location & friendly staff
Molt bona ubicació. Simple però perfecte per gaudir d'una gran estada a Miami
Good

Highly recommend. I came to Miami 3 times and by far this was my fav stay. The hotel is right nearby so many restaurants, beach. Room service cleans daily. We were able to check in early for extra charge. Room was clean no complaint. Only issue is the room key never really work, so we had to ask for front desk to open it.
Other than that great place and friendly staff

Honestly, I was very disappointed with my stay. The bathroom had a really bad smell that made it uncomfortable to use, and there were cleanliness issues around the sink that were concerning. I reported the sink issue during my stay, but I did not feel that the problem was properly addressed.
For the price and the expectations I had for my stay, I expected the room and bathroom to be clean and well-maintained. Unfortunately, the condition of the bathroom really affected my experience. I would not stay here again unless these issues are addressed and the cleanliness is significantly improved.
Just one word, amazing. For this price everythings perfect. Thanks
Hotel staff were very nice and accommodating. The room was very clean. I would stay there again.
I will definitely be returning
Excelente hospedaje, buen precio, nos dejaron realizar el checkin antes de lo establecido, y tiene muy buena ubicación.

4
The hotel’s location was excellent, and the check-in process was smooth. Finding the property was also very easy. The host was extremely polite, welcoming, and hospitable, which I genuinely appreciated.
That said, the room itself was quite small, and unfortunately, there was no hot water during my stay. The property also feels somewhat outdated and could benefit from some meaningful updates and improvements. In particular, the beds were extremely firm and uncomfortable, and upgrading the mattresses would make a significant difference to the overall guest experience.
Overall, despite those issues, it was a decent stay. Aside from the lack of hot water and the outdated accommodations, I really have no major complaints. With a few updates and improvements, I believe this property could provide a much better experience for future guests.
A una cuadra de la playa y lugares para comer!

This place is dirty and sticky. You can tell the owner dosnt give af. My room 203, you could tell was recently “renovated”. Its sooo bad. The wood floor is bouncy, the paint lines are messy in the bathroom, broken tiles, shotty cauk lines, and water pressure is slow as it shoots every which way from the broken shower head. Its very slippery with and I almost fell many times.
I had a decent sized blood spot on one of the main pillows, and a hair that didn’t belong to me.
The worst part: the card reader would take so much effort to get inside. Every time I tried to get back in I would have to spend 5 minutes swiping a hoping it would work.
They also had construction and loud partying
The girl who works in the morning is nice and good at her job. The location is amazing but everything else is a disaster
Espaço limpo, bem localizado perto de tudo, recomendo.
Comfortable stay near Miami Beach. Will be back
L’hôtel ne correspondait pas aux attentes
Está a una cuadra de la playa y cerca pasa el bus y hay restaurantes. La atención fue rápida y buena, el lugar fue muy cómodo y limpio. Volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí. Gracias.
no comment…

Decent stay. We had a separate booking from our travel mates and noticed our check-in time was an hr later. The young lady at the front desk was eager to assist in getting us in sooner but we just decided to leave and come back at our check-in time so that they could accommodate us with a bottom floor. Both front desk ladies, I wish I could remember their names, were super helpful.
Entering the hotel, the smell of mildew and cleaning product was overwhelming. There is a bar onsite but the bartender was on vacation so we had to visit other bars. Happy hr was included but at another location several blocks away.
The rooms were a bit small and we noticed we didn’t have any towels or wash cloths when it was time to shower. We were able to get some after visiting the front desk. I’m sure it was just an accident by housekeeping.
We requested late checkout, but they were only able to accommodate one of our rooms at $20/hr. We opted out.
Overall, for a short stay, it was great place.

Stayed for 1 night for my birthday, check-in was fine, the worker at the desk was very nice and helpful. We got into the room fine, no visible problems with the room. We went out for dinner and drinks for a little while, but when we came back there was a different worker. This worker disabled our room keys for some reason, which was very inconvenient since the room was all the way on the 3rd floor. Not the biggest deal. The biggest issue was in the morning. I woke up with bug bites all over my legs which were very itchy. The host through Airbnb claimed that there is no bugs and was not willing to do anything about the inconvenience. If I didn’t have bug bites before staying in their room, how would the bites just appear overnight? Very disappointing experience as it was my birthday and not what I wanted to wake up to. Google reviews of this place also show that a multitude of customers have had the same issues with this property. If you like bugs and getting chewed on, come here.

We stayed for a couple of nights and loved the location of Hotel Shelley. We appreciated the attentive reception staff and ability to access other hotels for beach equipment and happy hour. We did notice the hotel hallway and our room had a noticeable smell which made our stay a little less enjoyable, and our access card unfortunately stopped working halfway through the stay. The location was great, the hotel could do with some work.

Great location, really comfortable bed but HORRIBLE smell in lobby and room. If you have any allergies or sensitivities to smell, avoid. The room was also much smaller than we thought. No place to put luggage.

Unfortunately, the hotel did not provide any coffee, and there was no coffee maker in the room, which was disappointing. The hotel also needs better maintenance—especially replacing the carpets. The stairway carpets were extremely dirty and should be changed. In addition, the door locks need to be updated, as the key cards were difficult to use and did not work easily. The quality of the toilet paper was also very poor.
On a positive note, the staff were very friendly, helpful, and welcoming, which we truly appreciated. The room itself was clean, but overall the hotel had an unpleasant smell, which affected our experience.

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: We had a wonderful stay at this home. The place was clean, comfortable, and the view was beautiful. The host was staying next door but was very respectful of our privacy and only let us know he was available if we needed anything. We were also able to check in an hour early, which was a big help. Gated fence was very helpful for us and our dog.  Overall, a great experience.

Phil is A+++ Airbnb host! Thank you for opening your home to us and our pup for this lovely stay. This was our first time staying in the keys and we were so happy we chose you as our host. The fire-pit, enclosed yard, and access to Netflix was so thoughtful. The house was beautifully curated and the amenities abundant. We surely seek you out for our next stay. Thank you again for being so accommodating and dog friendly!
Very nice home in a beautiful location with all amenities we needed. We specifically loved the morning and evening visits from bunnies who nibble on the lawn.

Phil’s house was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay. It’s in a great location, and Phil was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We had a wonderful experience and would definitely love to come back again!

We loved Phil’s place and wish we could stay forever! Phil was such a wonderful host. The house is right on the water which makes early morning paddle boarding or a late afternoon sunset so perfect. We hope to come back!

Hands down one of the best houses we have ever stayed at. Spectacular location, house and water views. Water accessible from dock or grass path. House had everything you would ever need for a comfortable stay. Phil was an awesome host! Great communication and made us feel like we were part of the family. We will be coming back soon!

We had a very nice stay at this Lake Tahoe home. The house was very clean, comfortable, and welcoming, and the host was friendly and responsive. The location was a bit farther from the main attractions we planned to visit, but still an easy and manageable drive.
One thing to note is that the house can get quite warm. There is no A/C, and although fans are provided, it was still hot at times even with windows open.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and appreciated how clean and well-kept the home was.
Phil’s place was very clean and comfortable and the location was unbeatable with great views.  Would highly recommend

We truly could not have asked for a better host or a better place to stay. Philip was exceptional and went above and beyond to make our trip enjoyable. When I mentioned that we might need bear spray for a few hikes, he dropped some off without hesitation.
From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The views were absolutely stunning, the house was fully stocked with everything we needed, and the location couldn’t have been more perfect. We highly recommend staying here and would gladly return!
Great stay, highly recommend!
Philip went above and beyond to make sure we had a great time in Tahoe. Amazing Host!

We had a wonderful stay at Phil’s beautiful waterfront home. Phil was an amazing host - always reaching out to make sure we had everything we needed. We spent so many hours out on the deck watching the boats go by and loved having our morning coffee out there. So relaxing and peaceful! The accommodations at the Keys were an added bonus - great for our toddler. We will be back!
What a lovely spot! Phil is a great host and his home is stunning. Easy to bike to the community amenities and local spots!

Wonderful accommodations and extremely helpful host, welcoming and went out of his way to ensure we had everything we needed for our stay. Could literally not have gotten better for a summer getaway and I'm sure the place is equally comfortable in winter. Location is situated close enough to downtown to be easily accessible while being far enough for peace and quiet in Tahoe.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful home in South Lake Tahoe. The house was spotless, comfortable, and very well maintained. It had everything we needed to relax and enjoy our vacation.
The location was perfect for exploring the area. We spent time kayaking on the lake, shopping, and enjoying some great local restaurants. After a day of activities, it was so nice to come back to such a welcoming and comfortable home.
Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations. The home was beautiful, clean, and made our trip even more enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting South Lake Tahoe!

Our stay at Philip’s waterfront house was perfect for our family of 4 plus our goldendoodle! Philip was so kind and welcoming, and his communication was excellent. I asked him about local farmers markets and he went out of his way to research them and get back to me. Truly above and beyond! The house had everything we needed with comfortable beds, clean linens and a superb location. We will definitely be back!

Phil was an outstanding host and his place on the keys was beautiful.  He was super responsive before, during, and after the stay and gave me some great tips for biking in the area.  His place is absolutely as advertised and well located.

It’s hard to post this review… I selfishly don’t want to hype this place so I can easily come back again soon!!! Lol
But we’ve stayed at DOZENS of rentals, all over the country over the last decade that Airbnb has been a thing… Not only does Phil have one of the most beautiful and amazing homes we’ve stayed at, but Phil himself is one of the coolest and most accommodating hosts that we have ever had the pleasure to deal with!!! He was super accommodating to every weird question or scenario we threw at him. We cant wait to come back soon… Thanks again Phil!!!
What a gorgeous place! We really enjoyed our stay as the view was incredible. The place had high quality items. We would definitely stay again!

Philip’s place in the Tahoe Keys was absolutely stunning. The views were breathtaking, offering a perfect blend of serenity and natural beauty. A major bike trail nearby made exploring the area effortless, and several convenient stores were just a five-minute drive away, adding to the ease of the stay. Every detail of the property reflected comfort and thoughtfulness, making it a truly memorable place to experience.

The host was very communicative and kind re our need for scent free cleaning and healthy air quality and went the extra mile. This made all the difference. Beds were very clean and comfortable. Location on the water gorgeous and with view of mountains. This was so lovely night and day. Great location peaceful and nice neighborhood but short drive to be able to shop or eat. We were traveling to Kirkwood and drive was manageable and nice. Everything worked. Nice fireplace, kitchen well equipped. A great home away from home. Thank you.

Phil's place is one of the best Airbnb rentals we’ve stayed at. We had a wonderful time and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The home was beautifully designed and very practical for daily use. It was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well stocked with everything we needed, making it very family-friendly. The location was quiet and peaceful, yet close to the ski resort, making daily trips to Heavenly incredibly convenient. We were lucky enough to enjoy a white Christmas, which made the stay extra special. It was the perfect place to come back to and relax after a full day of skiing and activities. Phil was a very responsive, friendly, and thoughtful host. We felt at home and would love to stay at Phil's place again when we visit Tahoe in the future. We highly recommend Phil's place for families looking for a cozy vacation getaway!

I can't say enough about what an amazing stay we had at Phil's place. From when I booked the place, Phil reached out and was very responsive to my questions. I arrived late the first night and Phil had left lights on and made it very easy for me to get settled. Phil also had everything you could think of that you might need - including really good coffee.
His place is beautiful - definitely one of the top Airbnbs I have stayed. I enjoyed sitting on the deck in the morning and watching the birds. I thought it might be busy but I found it very peaceful and relaxing. The beds were extremely comfortable and I had the best night sleeps I have had in a long time. The house itself was pristine and we felt right at home from the start. During our stay, Phil was available for questions and helped us get a pass to the Keys pool and beach access. I loved the coffee shop that was in the Tahoe Keys marina and suggest checking it out. The location is perfect! I highly recommend staying at Phil's.

My wife, 1 year old son, cat, and I stayed at Phil's place for an entire 17 days and enjoyed every minute of every day. The home is so comfortable, inviting, spotless and comes with priceless water and mountain views located right in the Tahoe Keys. Phil was also always right there if you needed him but never intrusive or disruptive. He was super helpful with any thing we needed and was a pleasure to talk to and get to know. My wife and I own and manage 2 airbnb's as well so we know the ins and outs of short term rentals and can attest to the 5 star quality of Phil's listing and ability to host at a higher level than just being every day renters. We highly recommend staying with Phil! thanks again!

house_rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedString:
I allow 3 guests per stay, with no additional charges for the extra guests, but 3 is the absolute maximum allowed. This is inclusive of babies and children (and remember the place is not baby-proofed). The space is meant to sleep 2 comfortably in the bedroom area and then 1 more on the fold-out futon. Please let me know how many guests are going to stay so I can plan my clean time and provide enough towels and supplies. 

Please treat this escape as you would your own home. There are dumpsters in the garage for you to throw out your trash at the end of your visit. Please hand wash any dishes you use, or load and start the dishwasher. Be sure I have your cell number before your stay so I can answer your calls or texts promptly. The complex is very quiet, so please help keep it that way. Voices carry, so speak softly on the stairs, outside the units, and when on the phone. This is a peaceful, quiet escape I know you’ll love!

Please be assured that the square footage, decor, amenities and sleeping accommodations will be the same.

En suite private bathroom connect 2 private guest rooms. Room 1 has comfy queen-size memory foam bed. Room 2 has twin bed with twin trundle.

The space
This is for a Hosted Rental - meaning the homeowner is in the home during rental. I live here with my 12 year old service dog, Siberian Husky. He is very calm and gentle.

Your spaces for only your use include Private guest room (1 or 2 bedrooms depending on your reservation) with a private attached bathroom, exclusively for your use.

The main area of the house is shared with me, as this is a hosted rental. That includes the living room with fireplace and massive TV, kitchen, backyard with hottub, and off-street driveway parking.

You may use all shared spaces.

When guests are using kitchen / living room I generally keep to myself on the other side of the house in my room, but am available for anything you need!

Guests are welcome to use the kitchen and all appliances and cooking supplies, living room (tv, video games, wood burning fireplace), backyard (deck, outdoor dining, bbq, hottub) and front yard. Guests may also park in the paved driveway and use EV Tesla charging. Tesla charging available for a $40 fee per stay.

Fully fenced in backyard with hottub and gas bbq grill for shared use as well.

Please, no parties and no smoking.

Guest access
Guests can access the home via a smart-lock on the front door. It will have a custom PIN for your stay.

Do not leave any food in cars overnight.

During your stay
I’m readily available for any needs or to give lots of recommendations!

Other things to note
Must be 21+ to book.

This is a “hosted rental” which means you share the common space with me (& my dog). I’m here to help with any questions or needs but stay out of the way when I have Airbnb guests.

The listing includes two bedrooms connected by a shared private guest bathroom. Bedroom 1 has a pullout queen sleeper with memory foam topper. Bedroom 2 has a twin bed with the option for a second twin bed, which is a trundle underneath.

Your reservation includes access to all common areas including kitchen, backyard, front yard, living room - which are shared with me, the homeowner.

If you would like to come with a group of more than four, the house can accommodate up to six guests total. We have the option to set up an inflatable queen mattress in the living room. Please inquire in advance if this is something that you’re looking to do and we will make special arrangements.

My 12 year old Service Dog (Siberian Husky) lives here. He is very calm and friendly, and takes lots of naps. I keep your bedroom doors closed so that he does not have access to your private spaces.

No Smoking Permitted in the home.

EV charging available w Tesla Charger for a $40 fee. Inquire in advance.

I also offer AIRBNB Experiences to local hikes, lake excursions, foraging, and more!

Lake Tahoe has HIGH Fire Danger - please do not bring fireworks, bonfires, or improperly discard of cigarettes.

16534724.description_html:
Brand new Swedish modern haven - perfect home base to explore Austin. Walk to downtown and East Side venues, food trucks, bars, shuttles, bike path and Town Lake. Sleeps 4, nice front porch for breakfast and happy hour, wifi, central heat/air, quiet block, washer/dryer. Gorgeous wood interior, sweeping ceilings with a skylight for tree viewing and daydreaming. Private alleyway entrance with dedicated off-street parking space; secure, keypad entry. Many amenities!

The space
So, I had this idea for a tree house on the ground in my backyard...and that's what I got. The vaulted ceilings are this beautiful light pine, with a ginormo skylight and peek-a-boo gable windows to frame the tippy tops of my backyard pecan trees. The kitchen walls are made of the 1939 cedar shiplap planks I removed from my kitchen a few years ago. Real, hardwood flooring throughout (except the bathroom.) Bathroom walls of the light pine - like a Swedish spa.

The roofed front porch has a bistro table and chairs - with a layered view of my little corner of the East Side, it's the perfect setting for your morning coffee or your happy hour beer. (Both included.)

There's a full kitchen with rustic ceramic tile counters and a brand new stainless steel fridge and gas oven, complete with Le Creuset cookware. Tea kettle, drip coffee maker, french press, ZeroWater filter pitcher, microwave, toaster, immersion blender, etc. Kitchen is usually stocked with salt, pepper, cooking oil, coffee, sugar and creamer. There are endless delicious places to eat within walking distance, but if cooking's your thing, you'll be all set.

The bed situation:
- 1 luxurious, queen-sized EcoCloud Hybrid mattress by Winkbeds on a real wood platform bed frame built by a local Austin woodworker. (Look up that mattress and check out the reviews.)
- 1 sofa that converts to a queen-sized bed. I freaking HATE 98% of all pull out couch mattresses so I went with the IKEA Friheten that uses the firm couch cushions instead of a janky fold up faux mattress. Once the foam topper and mattress pad are on, you really can't tell the difference between it and a high end real mattress. I highly recommend.
- Pillow concierge - OK, not really, but I'm always having a problem with other people's pillows so I decided to go all Golidlocks here and get three different sets: freaky thin, medium, and criminally fat. Surely one will be right for you.
- The softest sheets you will ever have felt. Seriously.
- Please note: If you need black out curtains and midnight-dark for sleeping, this isn't your casita. There are blinds on all the eye-level windows, but there's a large skylight in the ceiling and gable windows with no covering.

The bathroom, with natural black slate tile flooring and hand-crafted Brazilian wood counter, comes equipped with my favorite organic shampoo, conditioner and body gel, as well as wash clothes, hair dryer and a place to put your toothbrush. I can confidently say it's the cutest little porcelain galley sink you will ever have seen. And lots of hooks!

The pantry has brand new fancy full washer and dryer that you are welcome to use.

There is a big flat screen TV with broadcast channels, Netflix and HBO Go. TV mount has extending arms so you can watch from the bed or the living area - and only one remote!

Storage: One of my frustrations with other Airbnb places I've stayed is that there were never enough places to put my stuff. So, I went a little storage crazy. I've installed clothing and coat hooks wherever I could, there's a closet with hanging cubbies, hangers and two luggage racks so you don't have to kneel on the floor to find your socks.

Random, and yet helpful or fun, amenities:
- a few different maps - bike, bus system, tourist
- Texas Monthly's famous edition that lists the best barbecue places in Austin/Texas
- Board games like Scrabble and Pictionary and cards
- A collection of books by Texas authors

Guest access
The casita is all yours - there is a private, alleyway entrance gate and a gate that separates my yard from the casita. Privacy for everyone! I have electronic key pad locks, so no keys, just a code.

If you have a car, you have your own, off-street parking place right next to the entry gate.

Other things to note
Easy walking, biking, busing and driving downtown, Convention Center, South Congress, Lady Bird Lake Hike and Bike Trail, museums, the art studios of the Eastside and UT, the University of Texas. Tons of delicious Eastside/central restaurants and some of the best food trailers in Austin all within walking distance: Indian, Mexican, Cajun, gourmet sandwiches, Asian fusion, fish and chips, vegan delicacies and Thai favorites.

Even better, you’ll be less than a mile away from several of the New York Times “Best Restaurants in Austin” list:

•⁠ ⁠Canje - a modern Caribbean restaurant (0.7 miles away - 3 mins drive)
•⁠ ⁠Discada - a Northern Mexican street-food eatery (0.3 mile away (1 min drive / 6 mins walk)
•⁠ ⁠Suerte– modern Mexican with house-made masa (0.7 miles away - 3 mins drive)

On a separate note, here’s our personal choice that we think you should also try:
•⁠ Launderette - a contemporary Mediterranean-inspired restaurant (0.4 miles away - 1 min drive / 8 mins walk)
•⁠ Mr. Natural – natural foods store and vegetarian Mexican restaurant (0.4 miles away - 1 min drive / 8 mins walk)
•⁠ Via 313 - Detroit-styleDetroit-style (0.7 miles away - 3 mins drive)

1674833575946093753.description_html:
Tucked into the tree canopy of West Lake Hills, Yaupon Valley Treehouse is a one-of-a-kind limestone home where the Hill Country forest comes right to your windows — and two decks sit nestled within the trees. Eight minutes from downtown Austin, and a world away from it.

The space
The house sleeps up to 8 across three bedrooms — two kings and a dedicated bunk room with two twin-over-full bunk beds that families with kids absolutely love. Two full bathrooms, including a stunning skylit wet room that has to be seen to be believed. The living room wraps in floor-to-ceiling windows with nothing but woodland in every direction — oaks and cedars as far as you can see. The kitchen is fully equipped and built for real cooking — open shelving, dark granite, a proper dining table that seats the whole group.

Step outside onto either of the two decks and you're nestled within the trees. Morning coffee out here, surrounded by the Hill Country canopy, with downtown Austin eight minutes away — that's the Yaupon Valley experience.

Traveling for work? There's a dedicated workspace with high-speed WiFi. In town for F1 at COTA? You're 25 minutes from the circuit. ACL at Zilker? Ten minutes. SXSW at the Convention Center? Twelve.

The private yard is shaded and safe for kids and dogs alike — Yaupon Valley Treehouse is pet friendly.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE
· 3 bed / 2 bath · sleeps up to 8
· Primary — king
· Guest — king
· Bunk room — 2 twin-over-full bunks · sleeps 4
· Skylit wet room bathrooms
· Floor-to-ceiling canopy views
· Two decks nestled within the trees
· Fully equipped kitchen + open dining
· Dedicated workspace + WiFi (100mbps+)
· Smart TV with streaming · Washer & dryer
· Pet friendly
· 8 min downtown · 10 min Zilker · 25 min COTA

Guest access
QGests have full and exclusive access to the entire home including

Both private decks and the outdoor yard
All three bedrooms and closets — primary, guest room, bunk room
Both bathrooms
Full kitchen, dining room, and living room
Dedicated workspace
Washer and dryer

The only exclusion is the locked owners closet off the Flex space

Access method — self check-in via lockbox to the right of the front entry door. The lockbox code is unique to each reservation and sent the morning of check-in.

Parking — driveway access for up to 4 vehicles, with overflow on the right side of the driveway.

Other things to note
The property is set in a natural Hill Country environment — expect wildlife including deer, birds, and occasionally foxes. Standard Hill Country — not cause for concern, just good to know.

The home is climate-controlled by 6 individual split AC units. Each room has its own unit — there's a quick guide inside on how to best adjust them.

The lockbox code is the last 4 digits of the phone number on your reservation. Keys are inside — a spare set is on the kitchen counter.

Trash and recycling pickup is on MONDAY — bags go to the bins at the end of the driveway.

Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM. West Lake Hills is a residential neighborhood — please be mindful of neighbors.

Unfortunately the room was pretty dirty, we found items left behind by the previous hotel guests, random stains on floor from food and other. Our AC broke 2nd night they came out to fix it but by the end of the day it was not working again. Not worth reporting again. Towels were ripped, hallways were warm and dirty, even elevators didn’t feel cleaned. Beds are not comfortable, usually hotel beds are pretty good but not in this situation. Great location, 10 min walk from Times Square. Would not stay here again, the cost usually helps me overlook these issues in some situations but there’s not much positive to say here.
It was a wonderful stay, no complaints!
Great place to stay and also good customer service. Will be back in the future.
We had a great extended stay at the Truss Hotel. Very close and within walking distance for so many things. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the housekeeping always did a wonderful job!
Great place!
awesome stay! perfect location and amazing staff.

I was genuinely blown away by the Truss Hotel!
For a hotel in the heart of Manhattan, the spaciousness of our room was such a pleasant surprise. We had a king-size bed, mini fridge, microwave, desk and chair, great closet, and comfortable bathroom. It was a brilliant use of space. Nothing had that tiny, cramped NYC hotel-room feeling. There was enough room to unpack, stretch out, and feel comfortable.
The linens were lovely, and housekeeping was wonderful. We needed a couple of extra things during our stay, and they were incredibly responsive and friendly. The concierge was also extremely helpful.
The location is fantastic: very walkable, tons of restaurants nearby, convenient subway access, and close to everything you want to do in the city.
What really surprised me was the value. For the location, room size, amenities, cleanliness, and service, the price was incredibly reasonable.
I would absolutely stay at the Truss Hotel again and look forward to coming back!
It was a nice size but the shower was gross
Good place and location
Everything was fine overall, except that one of the lights didn’t work and we also couldn’t open the curtains because apparently there was a restaurant directly outside our room.
Awesome and helpful staff. Very close to Times square and Penn station as well.
Great stay!
Great area walking distance from timsquare. friendly staff always helpful clean room with a lot of space! Closet/ etc.

Our stay was great! The location was very convenient. Our room was very clean and had lots of space. It was very quiet and cozy! We couldn't check in early because it was busy, but the staff was very accommodating and friendly, and they helped us check in our luggage early and had it ready when we were back to check in. Check-in and check-out were both very easy and quick.
Great stay overall! Would stay again even though we couldn’t check in until an hour after check in time due to room availability

Don’t book through air bnb. they’ll give your room away before you arrive and you’ll have no where to stay and will have to find a new hotel. they also won’t reach out to you when they do this and will only let you know when you arrive and you’ll be looking and paying for a new hotel.
Great place to stay especially for a MSG event.

Absolutely amazing stay! The location was perfect—close enough to walk to everything, but far enough from the heart of the city that it didn’t feel overwhelming. I was pleasantly surprised that we had no issues at all with outside noise, which I know can sometimes be a concern when staying in New York City.
The room was a great size for NYC and was comfortable and nicely kept. The front desk staff were absolutely wonderful and so helpful throughout our stay. They even stored our luggage for us for a very small fee, which was incredibly convenient.
Overall, we couldn’t have asked for a better location, room, or experience. We absolutely loved our stay and would definitely stay here again!

We stayed at Truss Hotel for one night because of its excellent location within walking distance of Times Square, making it easy to explore the city. The price was very reasonable for such a convenient area. We arrived several hours before check-in, and although our room wasn't ready, the staff kindly stored our luggage for a flat $8 fee, regardless of how many bags we had. They also let us leave our luggage after checkout so we could enjoy the city a little longer, which we really appreciated. The room was clean, comfortable, and stocked with toiletries and other essentials. My only suggestion would be to offer parking or a discount at a nearby garage. We found one about a 3-minute walk away and parked there for about 30 hours, which made getting around much easier. Overall, the staff was friendly, the location was fantastic, and the hotel was exactly what we needed for a comfortable one-night stay.

We had a great time visiting New York. The hotel staff were nothing but great the whole time, from letting us check in an hour earlier to having a comfortable place to hang out before and after our reservation. They also provided water bottles every day we were there, which was great for the hot days. Once we checked out we had the option to keep our bags there  for a $2 fee each, while we did some last minute shopping and sightseeing. Great restaurants close by and the subway station is within walking distance (20 min for Grand Central), we’ll be coming back to stay here.

The hotel is located in the heart of the city. Any possible thing that you’d want or need is close by. The hotel staff were helpful and answered all of our questions. A huge perk that was a surprise was the clean and private bathrooms that you were able to access since it’s impossible to use public restrooms in NYC. The room was exactly what we expected and nothing less or more, we were there to sight see and ONLY use the hotel to sleep. The room was clean, A/C was cold and there was a Roku TV. I would not only recommend this stay but from now on this is where I’ll be exclusively staying at even though I have family in the city!

It had two beds so it was good. Great location. The place feels a bit like a motel so it was just a place to stay in a great location and more space than a typical hotel room in NYC. Just be ok with smells in the hallway, medium clean place and noises coming from other rooms. Honestly it was fine if you don’t have high expectations. Beds and sheets were clean.

The apartment features a bright open living space, modern furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bedroom for a relaxing stay. Large windows bring in natural light / Sunset and showcase the Downtown skyline.

Perfect for couples, business travelers, or guests visiting concerts and events nearby. Restaurants, nightlife, and entertainment are all within walking distance.

Living & Dining

Laundry

Guest access

Detailed check-in instructions will be provided before arrival.

Other things to note

• No parties or events
• Smoking is not allowed inside the unit

Main complaints were there are 2 night lights in the room that stay on 24/7 and are fairly bright. Bring an eye mask or find a way to cover them! Rest of accomodation was fine. Our fitted sheet was ripped lol but it's fine. Mostly bitter because I paid $1500 for 2 nights, and it's nowhere near worth that, I wouldn't pay more than $350/night for these rooms.

Excelente recibimiento, desde la recepción hasta el manager ,todos muy profesionales y amables; de verdad q me he sentido en casa.
Por ahora es ,con diferencia, el mejor alojamiento que he disfrutado en NY, es todo nuevo, eso se nota; muy elegante, muy o práctico y la relación calidad/ precio inmejorable.
Ojalá mas lugares como este por todo el mundo.
Un 10 para el.propietario/ manager, muy atento y profesional.
Recomendable 100%

I would recommend this place with a few caveats. The lobby area was great and everything felt clean and cared-for.  Room was also very clean but felt smaller than the pictures make it seem. Unfortunately, I was put right by the elevator and the walls were thin so I could hear the elevator "ding" and my neighbors hacking/coughing.  Would've preferred the front desk hold a delivery I had no idea I was receiving and leave me a message rather than entering my room despite the "Do Not Disturb" sign being on the door. Knowing they'd entered anyway when I wasn't there made me uncomfortable. A great price for the area, though. Incredibly walkable with good restaurants nearby.

A lovely stay in the heart of New York!
We really enjoyed our stay at Little Something. The location is fantastic, right in the heart of the Financial District and so convenient for exploring New York.
Our room was clean, comfortable and beautifully presented, and we really appreciated all the thoughtful little details. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and helpful throughout our stay.
We had a wonderful experience and would definitely love to come back next time we visit New York. Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable! 🔅🥰
Great room and toiletries! Awesome location too. Would stay here again
NYC typical very small room, but everything you need. Basically was exactly what we did expect - a bit pricey but that probably was due to the events at that time in the city.
Had a great and easy stay! Would recommend and would stay again!
Loved my stay at Little Something. Perfect location, friendly staff and beds super comfortable. The bar is a great addition to the property.
Modern, clean and cozy
This is a great spot. The lobby is gorgeous and the room was small but had everything I needed and was really smartly designed.
Always a very good idea to stay here.
The room is incredibly small for the price you pay - as the name of the hotel suggests. Everything else was absolutely excellent: clean and renovated, great location, friendly staff.
Loved it

Overall, we had a really nice stay! The hotel was clean and the staff was super friendly and welcoming. The room was definitely smaller than I expected for two people, but it wasn’t a huge issue. Just be aware that there is no microwave or mini fridge, so there isn’t anywhere to store food or leftovers. We stayed in a basic queen room, so that may be different with other room types. There also wasn’t a dresser, so storage could be a little difficult if you’re staying for a longer trip. Breakfast is mostly pastries and coffee, but both were pretty good! The hotel is also conveniently located not too far from the subway, making it easy to get into the city fairly quickly. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely stay here again!

We loved our stay at Little Something and would absolutely stay again! The location was perfect—easy access to parking garages and the subway, and we always felt very safe. The hotel is new, extremely clean, and the staff was professional, attentive, and clearly prioritized guest’s comfort.
The rooms are compact, but very thoughtfully designed. My husband is 6’8” and we were both completely comfortable. Our room had a private shower and toilet area plus a Nespresso machine. Since we left every morning and returned later in the evening, it was exactly what we needed—a comfortable, clean place to keep our things and sleep.
Complimentary breakfast is offered from 6–10 AM, with cocktails and light snacks in the evening. We could occasionally hear muffled conversations from neighboring rooms, but it didn’t bother us and was somewhat expected in NYC. Great stay and great value—we’ll be back!

This place is a hidden gem! Right by express trains but in an area that’s as quiet as it gets at night in Manhattan. I recommend this for light sleepers. The staff were all super friendly, helpful and seemed relaxed, not stressed out. It’s a very small hotel so there’s no crowds. The bed was SO comfortable and the linens were pristine. The bathroom was pristinely clean and well designed. It’s a small room but very well thought out, with plenty of shelves and places to your hang your things. This hotel actually focused on what’s important- cleanliness, sleek and functional design, and getting a good night’s sleep.

My stay at Little Something was incredible. I stayed in a Queen Room and, while the floor space was on the smaller side (it’s essentially a medium sized normal bedroom) it was perfect.
It was brand new and pristine, the decor was beautiful (including in the lobby and communal areas) and the shower was fantastic.
I couldn’t find any pictures of the gym so wasn’t expecting much, but it was brilliant. Also brand new and modern, with lots of running machines, bikes etc, as well as a bench, dumbbells up to 30lbs (with adjustable dumbbells up to (I think) 60lbs), a smith machine and a squat rack.
It was on a quieter street, close to a subway stop and near great food, coffee & drink options.
The staff were also great - helpful, funny and very personable.
Overall, I absolutely loved my stay. They even provided free pastries in the morning. I will 100% stay again next time I’m in New York.

We absolutely loved our stay at this boutique hotel in New York. It was super peaceful, very clean, and the whole experience felt easy from start to finish. Check-in was simple and flexible, and checkout was just as smooth. They even held our bags until our flight, which was so helpful.
The lobby was gorgeous, and the outdoor seating area was such a nice bonus. Every employee we interacted with was kind, helpful, and genuinely made the stay even better. Would definitely stay here again!

1704452615554844556.description_html:
Two private queen suites, one private backyard—in the heart of East Austin, just minutes from UT, Downtown, and Moody Center. Fire up the Blackstone griddle, enjoy outdoor dining, and unwind with cornhole and comfortable lounge seating. Newly built with upscale finishes, this home comfortably sleeps 4 and is ideal for game days, concerts, work trips, or weekends with friends and family.

The space
Every detail in this newly built home was chosen for comfort—from plush queen beds and spa-like ensuite bathrooms to a fully stocked kitchen and lightning-fast fiber WiFi. Step outside to your private backyard designed for entertaining with a Blackstone griddle, al fresco dining, comfortable outdoor seating, and cornhole under the string lights. The perfect blend of modern comfort and East Austin convenience.

Living Area

The bright, open-concept living space is perfect for relaxing after a day exploring Austin. Stream your favorite shows on the Smart TV, stay connected with fast fiber Wi-Fi, or enjoy a selection of board games with family and friends.

Kitchen

The modern kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious island with seating—perfect for preparing meals, gathering with friends, enjoying morning coffee, or comfortably working remotely. Fully stocked with cookware, dishes, utensils, and cooking essentials, it's equipped for everything from quick breakfasts to home-cooked dinners.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms

Each queen bedroom is designed for a restful night's sleep with premium linens, room-darkening shades, generous closet space, and its own ensuite bathroom, creating the privacy and comfort of two true guest suites. A convenient half bath is also located on the main floor.

Family-Friendly

Traveling with kids? We've thoughtfully provided a Pack 'n Play, high chair, children's books, extra bedding, and luggage racks for your convenience.

Backyard

Fire up the Blackstone, enjoy dinner outdoors, relax in the cozy lounge seating, or challenge friends and family to a game of cornhole. The private backyard is the perfect place to unwind after a day exploring Austin.

Additional Comforts

Enjoy fast fiber Wi-Fi, Smart TVs, plush bathrobes, Native bath products, a HEPA air purifier, an in-home LG washer and dryer, and seamless self check-in for a comfortable, worry-free stay.

Guest access
Guests have exclusive access to the entire home and private backyard throughout their stay. Self check-in with a smart lock makes arrival easy on your schedule, and parking is plentiful with a private driveway, one-car garage, and free street parking directly in front of the home.

While you'll have the home entirely to yourselves, we're always just a message away if you need anything during your stay. We're also happy to share recommendations for our favorite restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, live music, and local attractions to help you experience Austin like a local.

Other things to note
* Professionally cleaned and inspected before every stay to ensure a comfortable, worry-free experience.
* Family-friendly amenities include a Pack 'n Play, high chair, children's books, extra bedding, and luggage racks.
* Exterior security cameras monitor the front and backyard entrances and driveway only for guest safety. There are no cameras inside the home.
* Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM to help maintain a peaceful neighborhood.
* One house-trained dog is welcome with prior approval and the applicable pet fee.
* Both bedrooms are located upstairs.
* This is a smoke-free home. Parties and events are not permitted.

Step into a boutique apartment designed to feel more like a private library than a hotel. Rich forest-green walls, vintage artwork, warm leather furnishings, and carefully collected antiques create a space that's cozy, sophisticated, and unlike anything else in Nashville.

Spend your evenings, curled up with a book, enjoy coffee beneath the gallery wall, or relax after exploring Broadway in a home that has been thoughtfully curated for optimum comfort.

The space
This luxe space is perfect for a romantic getaway or a relaxing solo trip, offering a fun and personality-filled atmosphere. Sink into the comfortable queen-size bed, or unwind on the brown leather sofa in the bright, open-plan living area, complete with a faux-grass accent wall and macrame hangings. Enjoy your favorite shows on the Smart TV or set the mood with the in-unit record player. The fully stocked kitchen, featuring dark wood cabinets and stainless steel appliances, is ready for your culinary adventures.

Your home away from home includes:
Comfortable queen-size bed
Full shower/tub combo with fresh linens and towels
Fully stocked kitchen with utensils and cooking supplies
K-Pod coffee maker with complimentary coffee
High-speed WIFI and Smart TV
In-unit washer and dryer

This apartment is professionally cleaned and maintained to ensure a perfect stay. Please note, this apartment is located on the second floor and is accessible by stairs only; there is no elevator in the building.


* I have more great units in the building - please click my profile located at the bottom of the listing to view what’s available and compare deals!

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire apartment for the duration of their stay. Free parking is available for one vehicle in the private lot located behind the building. If the lot is full, free street parking is also available in front of the building. Please be mindful not to park near any fire hydrants.

Other things to note
This apartment is on the second floor and can be accessed by stairs only. There is no elevator in the building.

Please park in the private parking lot behind the building. If there are no more spots, you can park in front of the building. Please be sure you are not parking near a fire hydrant.

The trash can outdoors is located at the back of the parking lot.

Please read all the house rules before booking. This apartment is only available to book for people living outside of Middle TN. No locals allowed. Strictly no smoking of any kind inside or around the apartment. You will be asked to leave and charged additional fees.

1753759205310098066.description_html:
Unwind with peaceful & tranquil sounds of the creek in this 650 square foot modern style home. “Creekside Oaks” is a perfect romantic getaway! Soothe yourself in the 2 person hot tub that overlooks the creek. Build a fire in the fire pit, grill out on the covered porch, then cozy up in the king sized bed while you enjoy the 75” TV. Play some corn hole, wander into the creek & explore, take a nap in the hammock, go for a walk, sit and swing the day away, or just absorb nature.

The space
Relaxation at its finest! The babbling creek is directly in front of the house! You’ll feel right at home in this modern style tiny home that holds big vibes! The property boarders the new Pisgah View State park, wrapped around huge hardwood trees, wildlife, and nature. All outdoor amenities are only a few steps from the house, easy to access! As soon as you exit your vehicle you’ll notice a large fire pit, relaxing chairs, a picnic table, and a hammock waiting for your attention.
On the covered porch is a hot tub, tv, gas grill, and chairs to relax. As you enter the house you will be in the open floor plan kitchen/living room/dining spaces. The tiny house doesn’t feel so tiny with the 12 foot ceilings! The living room boasts comfort with an Italian leather couch and chair. The 75” Smart TV is for your entertainment as well as an old school game system…Pac-Man anyone?! The full kitchen consists of granite counters and all the appliances and basic items for two people. The Keurig Coffee machine is ready for you complete with coffee, cups, and some snacks! At the hallway you will find the bedroom on your left with a cozy king sized bed, two night stands each with lamps, a closet, another 75” Smart TV for your viewing pleasures and two big windows for the perfect amount of natural sunlight! At the end of the hallway is the bathroom. The 5 foot tile shower gives plenty of space to move around and the vanity is just the right size! Outside you’ll find a swing waiting for you to sit for a while and just past the swing are steps that lead down to the creek! The water’s quite refreshing! Check it out! The side yard has Corn Hole set up & waiting on some players! Enjoy and have fun!

Our property is located in Upper Hominy Valley. The cabin sits on a 2 mile loop that is part of NC’s newest state park- Pisgah View! (The park isn’t open to public yet, still under construction) While we are in the countryside, we aren’t too far from lots of activities and attractions! Here’s a few…
~2 miles from Pisgah National Forest
~7 miles from Blue Ridge Parkway
~ 20-25 minute drive to Asheville Regional Airport
~20-25 minute drive to downtown Asheville
~20-25 minutes to Biltmore Estate
~44 miles from Great Smokey Mountains National Park
~60 minute drive to Cherokee

In addition, we are a short drive (less than 30 minutes) to many other awesome restaurants and small towns!

Guest access
Creekside Oaks sits along a creek with about 4.5 acres, 2 family homes, and one other small rental nearby. You’ll have your own oasis complete with full access to the entire home, covered porch, hot tub, grill, yard, creek, fire pit, swing area, and parking area. Two creeks run the full length of our property for your entertainment! In addition, our property sits on a two mile state road loop that’s great for walking & biking. Our property boarders Pisgah View State Park. Therefore, there isn’t any fishing permitted.

Other things to note
Please note: this charming tiny house is located among huge, beautiful trees (hence the name) and it sits along a creek. The sounds of the creek is prevalent all the time. While only a quick drive to the local gas station, you will be staying in the country. There aren’t any street lights, but we have installed solar lights near the home and on the bridge for guests’ safety. The house sits near a state road that’s not very busy. You may hear an occasional four wheeler or a tractor as well as cars and trucks and you may encounter critters that all help make country living what it is! We do our best to limit tiny creatures and such. However, total eradication is impossible; we live in their natural habitat. If you absolutely cannot tolerate tiny critters and insects this may not be the best place for your stay. Otherwise, we welcome you and hope you enjoy our piece of mountain livin’!
Pets are wonderful companions, but we do not permit them.

A private hot tub on the covered porch overlooking the creek, available year-round
Guests describe it as beautiful, peaceful, and incredibly clean, with one calling it their favorite Airbnb

content.localizedString:
—House Rules

We’re happy to host you and hope you have a comfortable stay! Please keep in mind that this is a private residence within a residential community, not a hotel. We kindly ask that you treat the apartment, common areas, and our neighbors with respect.

—Building Staff
Please do not contact or request assistance from building staff or the front desk. If you have any questions, concerns, or need assistance during your stay, please contact us directly through Airbnb and our team will be happy to help.

—No Parties or Drug Use
Parties, unauthorized gatherings, and illegal drug use are strictly prohibited. Violations may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation without refund and additional charges of up to $1,000.

—No Smoking or Vaping
Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside the apartment and throughout the community. Evidence or reports of smoking may result in cancellation of the reservation and additional cleaning or damage charges of up to $1,000.

—Respect Our Neighbors
Please do not knock on neighbors’ doors or disturb other residents for any reason. Loud music, excessive noise, yelling, or disruptive behavior in the apartment, hallways, or common areas is not permitted.

Quiet Hours: 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM

No Pets
Pets are not permitted unless specifically approved in advance.

—Keys, Parking & Damages

Your reservation includes:

* 1 building/elevator key
* 1 parking transponder

Please keep these items secure throughout your stay.

—Replacement fees:

* Lost building/elevator key: $50
* Lost parking transponder: $150

Guests are responsible for damage to furniture, walls, appliances, or other items beyond normal wear and tear. Please do not move or rearrange furniture.

All items in the apartment are inventoried between reservations. Missing items may be charged to the guest.

—A Few Final Reminders

We kindly ask that you remove your shoes while inside and help us keep the apartment clean and well cared for.

Most importantly, please treat the apartment as you would your own home and be considerate of the surrounding community.

Thank you for helping us provide a great experience for you and our future guests!

★ 2 Beds - King + Queen Pullout Sofa
★ Air Mattress

★ Dining table

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this quiet, spacious, comfy condo. Although parking is free & easy, you don't need a car for this condo. Guest access
You will have the entire condo to yourself.

1773464541700635371.description_html:
Welcome to The Nashville Postcard @ The Burnham!

Broadway is just a short walk away.

Your own private exit leads right out to the courtyard and pool.
1 king + 2 queen beds
Lighted glam station for the crew
Double sinks in bathroom
Garage parking $30/night
Fast WiFi + smart TV in each room
Full-length mirrors + stocked Keurig
In-unit washer and dryer

Common Areas:

Pool, cabanas & grills
Gym, yoga studio, climbing wall
...& sky lounge

Questions? Message us anytime.

The space
A downtown apartment @ The Burnham that sits on the courtyard, with the pool outside the windows and Broadway a short walk up.

You’re close enough to walk to Broadway and far enough that you’re not sleeping on top of it.

Sleeps 6 on three cozy beds: a king in the private bedroom and two queens in the living room.

Dream spot for a group to get ready
- The walk-in closet has a large lighted vanity mirror with a table and chairs.
- Twin sinks and two mirrors in the bathroom
- Two full-length mirrors, one in the bedroom and one in the living area.

Soft sheets, tons of pillows, and throw blankets in both rooms.

Smart TV in bedroom and living room.

Full kitchen with cookware, dishes, and glassware, plus a stocked Keurig. Fridge with water and ice.

In-unit washer and dryer.

Free high-speed WiFi

Outside the room is just as great!:
Hang out downstairs and around the building: heated pool, fire pits, grills, sky lounge, and a 2-story gym, spacious workspace. Free building WiFi reaches the common spaces if anyone needs a table and a change of scenery.

The pool:
This unit faces the courtyard. The pool is right outside the backdoor, you can get directly to the pool from the room. Hours are 10am–8pm. The courtyard with fire pits and grills stays open until 10pm. Because you sit on the pool side, days and weekends are lively. That’s the point of this unit.

Arrival and departure:
Check-in 4pm, checkout 10am. Tell us your arrival and departure times and we’ll grant building access at no charge on both days, so the lounges, courtyard, pool, and gym are usable before check-in and after checkout. Early check-in or late checkout is $30/hour, up to 2 hours each, if the turn is available. Lobby bellhop holds bags for $5.25/piece — message us for the appointment link.

Parking:
Garage parking on request, $30/night, unlimited in and out. Clearance is 6'8". You’ll get smartphone gate access, a space number, and a permit before you arrive.

Walking distance to:
Country Music Hall of Fame: 4 min
Bridgestone Arena: 5 min
Broadway: 5–8 min
Ryman Auditorium: 7 min
Grocery: 7 min
Ascend Amphitheater: 10 min
Nissan Stadium: 12 min
Vanderbilt: 8 min drive
Airport: 10–15 min drive
Grand Ole Opry: 15 min drive

BUILDING AMENITIES shared with guests in the building:
- Heated outdoor pool, open year-round (10am - 8pm)
- Outdoor courtyard with fire pits & gas grills (10am - 10pm)
- Pool and courtyard are both entered from the 2nd floor
- 2-level fitness center & yoga studio
- Climbing wall, treadmills, spin bikes
- Sky lounge with deck & city views
- The Collective: 2-story hangout & work
- Free building Wi-Fi throughout common areas
- On-site maintenance
- On-site concierge & security

Permit #2018074231

Guest access
Keyless entry through the DOOR app (formerly Latch). We’ll send access for everyone on the reservation.

The apartment is yours for the stay. Pool, gym, climbing wall, courtyard, grills, lounge, workspace, and the sky lounge are included and shared with other guests in the building.

The Burnham is an Airbnb-friendly building, so guests check in through the official app and have full access to common areas.

Other things to note
DISCLAIMER
This is an Airbnb Friendly Apartment Community

While amenities like the pool, gym, Collective, courtyard, and Skydeck are available to all Burnham guests, we have no control over their maintenance, repair, or availability. In the event that any of our building amenities become unavailable for guests, we assume NO RESPONSIBILITY for any inconveniences prior to or during your stay. By making your reservation, you acknowledge this disclaimer regarding our building amenities and agree that unavailability will not be grounds for a refund or cancellation of your reservation.

- Book your stay and enjoy a comfortable Miami getaway with skyline views

The space
Located high above the city on the 51st floor, this modern condo offers a bright retreat with partial ocean and downtown views. The condo blends contemporary details, abundant natural light, and comfortable furniture, creating a welcoming space to relax after exploring the city or working from home. With a thoughtful layout, private balcony, and access to shared building amenities, it’s a convenient stay for both short visits and extended trips.

Living Room
- The living area features a Smart TV, comfortable seating, and large windows that fill the space with natural daylight.
- The open layout creates an inviting area to unwind, enjoy entertainment, or spend time with family and friends.
- A double sofa bed provides additional sleeping space for extra guests, making the living room both functional and versatile.

Bedroom
- The private bedroom includes a king size bed with comfortable linens, closet space, and direct access to the full bathroom with a shower tub combination.
- The room offers a peaceful setting with city views and a relaxing atmosphere after a day of sightseeing or business activities.
- Guests can enjoy a private space with convenient storage for personal belongings.

Kitchen and Dining Area
- The fully equipped kitchen includes a stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, cookware, dishes, and dining essentials for preparing meals during your stay.
- The functional layout provides everything needed for casual cooking, morning coffee, or a relaxed meal at home.
- The dining table offers a comfortable spot to enjoy meals or set up a temporary workspace.

Outdoor Patio
- Step outside to the private balcony featuring outdoor furniture and partial ocean and skyline views.
- It’s a great place to enjoy fresh air, sip a morning coffee, or take in the city atmosphere from above.
- The outdoor space adds an extra area to relax while enjoying the surrounding views.

Amenities
- Guests have access to high speed WiFi, air conditioning, ceiling fans, a washer and dryer, and essential comforts for a convenient stay.
- The building also offers shared amenities including a swimming pool and gym facilities, giving guests options to relax, stay active, and enjoy their time at the property.

This condo is well suited for weekend getaways, extended stays, and business trips, providing a comfortable space with convenient amenities for every type of traveler.

Guest access
Check-in is in person at the front desk with one of our on-site representatives. Please share your exact arrival time in advance. The mandatory resort fee of $38.50 USD + VAT per night, paid at check-in, gives you full access to all building amenities.

Other things to note
Due to building regulations, food delivery services (such as Uber Eats, Rappi, etc.) are not allowed to go up to the apartment. Guests must meet their delivery at the front desk or building entrance

- Travelers must be at least 21 years old to book.

The space
Your Nashville Escape Awaits

Make your next Nashville getaway unforgettable in this stylish, modern retreat designed with groups in mind. From the private rooftop to the upscale interiors, every detail is set up to help you relax, celebrate, and enjoy Music City in comfort.

Private Rooftop & Hot Tub

Take in beautiful Nashville views from your own private rooftop deck. Start the morning with coffee above the city, gather with friends in the evening, or unwind beneath the stars in the rooftop hot tub after a day of exploring.

Cook, Dine & Gather

The modern, fully equipped kitchen makes preparing meals together easy and enjoyable. The spacious dining area offers plenty of room for everyone to sit down and share a meal, while the rooftop gives you another great option for outdoor dining and entertaining.

Close to Nashville's Best

You’ll be just a short drive from the excitement of Nashville, including Broadway, the Country Music Hall of Fame, iconic music venues, restaurants, bars, and nightlife. Whether you’re here for live music, great food, or a weekend with friends and family, you’ll have easy access to the city’s top experiences.

Stylish Comfort

Enjoy thoughtfully designed spaces featuring contemporary furnishings, quality finishes, and comfortable bedrooms. After a busy day in the city, come back to a welcoming home where you can relax and recharge.

Additional Amenities

20936239.description_html:
Welcome to our charming studio, cradled in the unique community of Atwater Village. The interior is modern with flowing natural light. There is a queen-sized bed and pullout sofa bed to give comfort to 4 people. There is a kitchenette equipped with microwave, coffeemaker, refrigerator, toaster but no stove. There is a Heat/Cool Window Air Conditioner. The studio is on top of a garage, expect to feel the garage door opening in the morning and evening. There is stairs leading to the studio.

The space
It is walking distance to a variety of good restaurants (All'Acqua, Blu Jam Cafe, Hail Mary, Bon Vivant Market & Cafe, Baracoa Cuban, Sagrado Mezcaleria, Viet Noodle Bar, Dune, Coral Reef Chinese), bars (Morrison, Atwater Village Tavern, The Griffin, Frogtown brewery), cafes (Black Elephant, Kaldi, Proof & Starbucks), unique shops, library and post office. Nearby attractions are Griffith Park, LA Zoo, LA River Bike Path, Greek Theater, Forrest Lawn Museum, The Americana Outdoor Mall, Sunday Farmer's Market, Hollywood Walk of Fame, Universal Studios, Hollywood Bowl, and Olvera Street.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire backyard / patio with pergola, daybed, and street parking. The firepit is for decoration only and not to be used.
Expect to share the backyard with our dog, Vino occasionally.

Other things to note
Vino, our rescue dog likes to share his love to guests. Our dog and cats are not allowed in the Airbnb studio. We have a storage for guests, if you want to leave your luggage and explore the city.

reviews.comments: Spacious junior studio with great natural lighting. The host was very accommodating, and the safe neighborhood was nice to walk around, with lots of great eateries nearby. Would definitely stay again!

Nous avons séjourné 3 nuits dans ce logement. Cela nous a permis de découvrir les alentours comme le Griffit observatory, Hollywood boulevard, Mullholland drive, Echo Park ...Le quartier est très agréable, et calme.
Logement propre et très fonctionnel pour 4 personnes. Je recommande à 100%,
La propriétaire est très réactive par message. Merci encore Claire.

Very welcoming and accommodating :D we were also helped with an emergency late at night so that was a nice experience <3
thank you for having us!! i will be saving this listing for future trips :)

This studio needs significant improvements. The shower area lock did not work, and the sofa bed was extremely squeaky and uncomfortable. The bed linens also felt quite old and could definitely use an update.
Overall, the studio feels dated, untidy, and in need of renovation and better maintenance. The main positives were the convenient location and the easy check-in process.

Absolutely would stay here again! The neighborhood was so peaceful and just a stroll away from shops, restaurants, and a cute little farmers market on Sundays! Our host Claire gave me lots of recommendations (including that farmers market - which was amazing). The home was beautiful and very cozy. Perfect little place to relax and still enjoy the LA life.
Great location, good food locations and close to Griffith Park. Studio was spacious and comfortable. Parking nice and easy too.
Claire’s place is as described! She’s easy to communicate with & very pleasant.

I had a great 2 night stay! The neighbourhood was pretty, walkable, great restaurants and shops right around the corner. The studio was comfortable, the AC worked well, Claire was responsive and helped me when I left something behind. It’s a good choice for 2-3 people.  I enjoyed Atwater Village, the location was perfect for exploring that area.
Quiet, easy to find and we really appreciated the ability to store our luggage safely. Great stay!
Claire's spot is in a great location and is tucked back from the street, with great working AC and amenities. Recommend!

Really enjoyed our stay here. Spotless, comfortable, and easily one of the best values in the area. Thanks for a great stay!
Super studio, idéal pour découvrir Los Angeles ! Logement très propre et très bien équipé, rien à dire c'est une très belle expérience !
We enjoyed the place a lot! Very nice area to walk around, easy to get in, no issues at all. Great communication from Claire as well. Would definitely stay again!

Second time staying at Claire’s BNB. Being a “tourist” but not extrovert enough to brave the tourist atmosphere, this is truly the perfect place, it’s safe and walkable, if you need a sweet treat I highly suggest the short walk to the ice cream shop down the street. Lots of food options in walkable distance. Parking can be a little bit of a challenge on the weekends but Claire is super accommodating if you communicate!
Claire's place was perfect for my visit to see family in the area. I hope I will be able to stay again the next time I am back! The apartment was spacious, calm, and well-equipped.

Had a great time staying in Claire’s in Atwater Village. The place was very nice and comfortable and the surrounding area had great food and fun shops.

We loved staying at Claire's airbnb!
The location was great. It is on a quiet residential street but less than a block away from Glendale Blvd where there is a wonderful assortment of restaurants (we particularly liked Dune and the Black Elephant Café), and close to Silver Lake where there is an even larger assortment!
The apartment is cosy and comfortable and very airy and light. We had access to the patio which we didn't have time to use but it was really nice to know that we could have.

Claire, herself, is a wonderful host. She was really responsive and helpful if we needed anything, and wanted to make sure that we were happy in her place. For us, a bonus was meeting Vino (her sweet dog), the friendly Whisky (cat) and the more stand-offish Tanduay (I think) (also a cat). Claire makes sure that the animals don't interfere with the guests but in our case, she kindly let us spend some time with them.
We would definitely be happy to stay there again.

This place a gold! There is so much room and the location and awesome outdoor area can’t be beat.
After a great day exploring the area and going to a Dodger’s game, it was wonderful to come back to this Airbnb and enjoy the beautiful back yard.
The area felt safe and there was a lot of great restaurants and cool shops nearby (as advertised). In addition to the wonderful place, Claire was a fantastic host! She was warm and welcoming. Overall it was a GREAT stay!

Great place, great location, great host. Perfectly met our needs for one night layover before flying to Hawaii. The neighborhood, Claire’s home and yard (they have an incredible outdoor space for relaxing with a drink), and the studio are all beautiful. Communication with Claire was flawless. We arrived prior to the scheduled check-in time and even though she provides a separate area to secure your luggage if you arrive ahead of schedule, the previous guests had an early departure and she was able to a prepare the studio for us early!  Thank you so much Claire for going so far above and beyond to help us out! Anything we would have needed was provided, just like being the guest at a friend or family members home. We chose this place based on proximity to The Greek Theater. The neighborhood is great, excellent restaurants and shops. Best of all, a nearby liquor store had a hard to find beer, Pliny the Elder. I’d love to come back and stay here when we have more than one night.

Claire's place was exactly as described, but surprisingly roomier than the photos suggested. The apartment was clean, smelled pleasant, and was tastefully decorated. We had no trouble finding the place, and directions for entering were very clear. We were made aware of the potential for noise from the garage door opening/closing, ahead of time, but honestly, it was not any louder than an AC kicking on, and it was very infrequent. Totally not an issue at all for us.
We didn't need to use the air mattress. but the bed and the pull-out were very comfortable. There were plenty of extra sheets, blankets (even an electric blanket,) pillows, towels, and wash cloths available, and all the drawers were clearly labeled, so no having to hunt for them!
The AC worked great, and there is also a tower fan. We didn't use the TV, so I'm not sure what channels are available, but Claire has provided a large selection of DVD's, as well as several games (monopoly, Jenga, etc) and books to enjoy.
The kitchenette has everything you need to reheat leftovers, or prepare a quick meal. We did not use the toaster, toaster oven, or the coffee maker, but coffee grounds are provided, and the mini fridge and microwave work great. There are plenty of paper towels, dish soap, dishes, silverware, and kitchen gadgets available for any occasion. The cute table has seating for 4, and the tabletop doubles as a chess/checkerboard.
The rain shower head was nice and the water pressure or temperature did not fluctuate at all. The bathroom was clean, roomy and stocked with ample soap and toilet paper.
The outdoor space was beautiful, comfortable, and spacious. Sadly we ever made time to experience it in the evening with the fire pit and the lights, but we appreciate all the attention to detail while out there in the morning. There is seating galore, beautiful succulents, and a charming lime tree. Such an amazing place to relax!
Street parking was ample, easy. convenient. and free! The neighborhood was cute with several restaurants and shopping options all within walking distance. Most importantly, we felt very safe!
Communication with Claire was thorough and prompt. Claire is thoughtful and very kind. We would definitely stay here again!

This place is located in a nice, safe neighborhood. My vehicle was safe for our stay. The advertisement is accurate in all regards. I liked the privacy I felt there. It was close to the places we wanted to go and there were reasonable places to eat near by. Claire is a very considerate hostess and is super attentive to her customer's needs and very eager to please. You will not be neglected or disappointed if you stay in her delightful studio. My wife and son needed to visit the Thai Consulate in LA and the Post Office close to the studio was convenient for Express Envelopes and Money orders needed to transact our business.
