23860926.description_html:
Live like a local in colorful East Austin! This charming stand-alone bungalow is minutes from downtown and the airport, and walkable to beloved coffee shops, restaurants, breweries, and live music. Relax on the screened porch or courtyard patio, gather around the 75" Samsung Frame TV, or enjoy music on the vintage record player. Thoughtful touches include a coffee bar, complimentary wine and snacks, cozy blankets, and free parking.

The space
Our 3/2 Bungalow, in a quiet East Austin neighborhood, is a lovely way to live like a local.

Stocked Kitchen: A fully equipped kitchen with essential appliances, cookware, and utensils, making meal preparation convenient and enjoyable.

Beds:
Room 1: King Bed with large ensuite bathroom
Room 2: Queen Bed
Room 3: Two Twin Beds, Rollaway Twin, Twin Floor Mattress

Outdoor Patio: A relaxing outdoor space where you can unwind, entertain guests, and enjoy the pleasant Austin weather.

Smart TV: A 75 in high-definition smart television for entertainment, streaming movies, shows, and sports events.

Record Player: A vintage touch for music lovers to enjoy playing vinyl records and experience a unique auditory experience.

Walkable Coffee: Flitch, Sa Ten, Hi Sign

High-Speed Internet: Stay connected with fast and reliable internet access for work, entertainment, and communication.

Air Conditioning and Heating: Central air conditioning and heating to ensure comfort throughout the year, regardless of the weather.

Washer and Dryer: Washer and Dryer are located outside in a laundry porch.

Parking: Free on-street parking is always available.e

Modern Appliances: Up-to-date appliances such as a dishwasher, microwave, oven, and refrigerator to simplify household chores.

Bus: Walk 10 min to bus stop. Bus to downtown is 1.25. Bus to airport is 2.50. Same bus stop is the Greyhound:)

TV: 75 in Samsung Frame TV

Walkable Restaurants: Justines, Kinda Tropical, Sawyer and Co, De Nada, The Holiday/

Outdoor Space: Screened patio with dining and TV. Courtyard with seating. Lovely! Guests comment on our many gathering places.

Guest access
A few days before your arrival, we send the key pad information to make coming and going easy. Please park on the street. It is free and there is plenty of space.

Most of our guests have cars, but plenty is within walking distance. Hit Flitch for your morning coffee, hang out at Kinda Tropical for a lazy drink and their Yucca Fries, or grab some cheap breakfast tacos at Betos. For a fancy night, make a reservation at Justines- you won't be sorry. If you love breweries, walk over to Central Machine works where they have movie nights, live music, and markets. A few steps beyond is Sawyer's, a modern cajun diner, or De Nada, where you'll find the strongest margarita around.

Other things to note
FREQUENT QUESTIONS
What is the parking situation?
Guests park on the street. There is plenty of parking for a car or two in front of the house and plenty more on the street.

Distance From:
Airport - 4 miles
Convention Center - 2 miles
Zilker Park - 3 miles
Domain - 15 miles
University of Texas/Moody Center - 3 miles

Are baby items available?
Yes! We have a pack n play and high chair stored in the bedroom closets. We also leave a few diapers, wipes, toddler dishes, etc.

Can we check in early or check out late?
We can arrange up to a two hour early check ins and late check outs. There is a $20 fee per hour.

Is the house a stand alone home?
Yes. The house is a single bungalow. We live in the back house but it is VERY separate. Guests enter from the front door and have a private fenced backyard. Our little house is at the end of the driveway and set back and to the side.

Is the space wheelchair friendly?
There are a few steps up to the front door. The entire house is one level, but the doorways are not too wide

Is child care or sitting service available?
We recommend: momsbestfriend (dot com)

What is in walking distance (within 1/2 mile)?
Coffee- Flitch, St. Benedict (trailer), Sa Ten, Medici
Restuarant - Kinda Tropical, Justines, Sunnys, Betos,
Bars - Hi Sign Brewery, Wanderlust, Central Machine Works

How do I check in?
A day or two before your arrival, we send the details for your check in: address, door code, wifi info. You will be able to come and go using a code. Your personal code is activated at 3 pm, so if you request an early check in the code may not work. Just remind us!

Can I extend a stay?
To extend a stay, you can request through the app or message us. We will check the calendar then send confirmation with the new payout.

Can I change or cancel my reservation?
We have a moderate cancellation policy. It may vary a bit between platforms, but usually 5 days prior to arrival guests may receive a full refund. If a guests wants to make changes within the five days arrival or after arrival, we cannot provide a refund.

Are pets allowed?
Due to allergies, we cannot allow pets.


Are there extra pillows?
We provided two pillows per person. For instance, a queen bed will have four sleeping pillows. We leave plenty of extra blankets as well.

Do you have beach towels?
Yes! We leave towels for taking to the pool or lake. We also have blow up floaties - we leave them on the back patio.

Are extra guests allowed?
If you have a few (2-3) friends pop over, this is not an issues. If you have extra guests sleeping over or more than five guests for an event, please ask and we can asses:)

Is smoking allowed outside?
Yes, you are welcome to smoke outside the space. Please pick up cigarette butts. Smoking inside the home would result in a 250.00 fee for cleaning and possible blocking nights for other guests.

Could we leave our luggage?
We are able to store luggage in the space for two hours before or after check in. Let us know so our cleaners are not surprised. Our carport is also a safe option for leaving bags for a longer time period. Just let us know. There is also a service (usebounce) that is an option for storing bags.

Are a washer and dryer available?
Yes. The washer/dryer is located outside the back gate.

What is a MUST do in Austin?
We love Barton Springs (especially in warmer months). South Congress has so much in a close proximity. Park close to Jo’s Coffee and stroll from there (shopping, cafes, music!). Vera Cruz tacos are really the best Austin has! Our Capital is gorgeous and very worth a drive by!

This charming stand-alone bungalow is minutes from downtown and the airport, and walkable to beloved coffee shops, restaurants, breweries, and live music. Relax on the screened porch or courtyard patio, gather around the 75" Samsung Frame TV, or enjoy music on the vintage record player. Thoughtful touches include a coffee bar, complimentary wine and snacks, cozy blankets, and free parking.
23860926.ld_name: Colorful East Austin Bungalow | Patio | Walkable

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: One of the most unique, artistic, relaxed homes we have visited.  Close to everything downtown & awesome recommendations listed for the guests to try.  Beds were super comfortable, bathrooms were pristine, & the kitchen was perfect for cooking in, should you want to.  The place felt like “home” from the moment we walked in.  A+ experience.

This was one of the best stays
It was so beautifully decorated. So much space! Screened in area! Mechelle left us snacks, drinks, wine etc.
Great area with great restaurants. Easy to get anywhere!
We loved it here. 5 stars

What a beautifully and artfully decorated home. There are so many unique details that make the stay feel cozy and welcomed into a home versus a hotel. The place is near fun east side spots and so close to the airport. Having stocked coffee was a great touch and we loved the filtered water as well. The king bed was incredibly comfortable. Highly recommend!
This is a beautiful well decorated home. You feel very comfortable and relaxed. Especially after a long day on the road. Location is perfect for every need. One place I would definitely book again.
Very nice place that looked better than photos. Close to everything in Austin.
Was great! Delivered as promised.

We had a wonderful stay at the Colorful East Austin Bungalow! The home was comfortable, charming, and full of personality, with a great patio that was perfect for relaxing. The location was fantastic! It was close to so many restaurants, shops, and things to do, and very walkable. Everything was just as described, and the stay made our time in Austin easy and enjoyable. We’d definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay here and especially enjoyed the short walk to Hi brewery!
Great place to stay in a walkable location. We loved all of Meshelle’s restaurant recommendations!

Such a cute and cozy stay in Austin! We absolutely loved this home and all of the personality it had. Everything felt so warm, welcoming, and thoughtfully put together. There were so many little details throughout the house that made it feel extra special. I especially loved the board with local recommendations and the cute postcards for guests. Such a sweet touch! You can really tell the host put a lot of care into making people feel at home here. We had such a comfortable stay and would definitely come back the next time we’re in Austin.
Es war absolut traumhaft..Wir wären gerne länger geblieben, wenn unser Zeitplan es erlaubt hätte

Meshelle’s place was everything I could have hoped for. Beautiful outdoor area with eclectic touches all throughout. The bathroom & bedroom were amazing, you knew she had put a lot of thought & care into this home. I am very well pleased with our stay & I can’t wait to book again. One of the best air bnb experiences I’ve ever had. Her friendliness & hospitality were much appreciated. A huge plus was that the master bed was SO COMFY. Perfect for a much needed nights rest before hitting the road again.   This is definitely a hidden gem in the heart of Eastside Austin.

We stayed for a girls weekend and this house was awesome. The location is great. You can walk to a lot of places. Breweries, restaurants, etc. All of the Uber rides we took were cheap because everything was close. And the house was awesome. Very cute. We loved sitting outside in the back. Would totally stay here again.

We were absolutely blown away by all the little touches, they truly have thought of everything when putting the home together. There were cold drinks and snacks upon our arrival at check in which was so thoughtful!! The kitchen was fully stocked with spices and everything you could possibly need to make a fantastic dinner. The beds were super comfortable and the shower was like a 5 star hotel. We loved hanging out and having breakfast on the screened in back patio watching all the birds in the morning. It was very very relaxing, it makes you forget that you’re 5 minutes away from the hustle and bustle of the heart of Austin. The location was great, De nada tacos right down the street was amazing!! It was really a great value for an immaculate stay, we can’t say enough great things about this property!! We can’t wait to visit again, we hope that you will too!!

My wife and a few friends were in town for a wedding close to Austin and Meshelle's place was just what we needed. I wished I had more time to just relax and enjoy the airbnb. The bedrooms were clean, stylish, and there are a few spaces to hang out with people like the living room and patio. Small details and nice amenities went a long way. Would definitely stay again!
Beautiful house and a beautiful neighborhood 10/10 would visit again.
Cute little spot! Meshelle was very responsive and everything was clean! Would book again.
I really enjoyed the stay! Everything was very close by and we really enjoyed walking around. The house was really nice as well, i would definitely come back again!
Charming home on the East side. Very happy with our stay, the house, communication, and the location.

All in all we had a great time at Meshelle’s place! The only reason I’m giving 4 stars is because the fridge went out on our first night and didn’t start working again until pretty late in our stay. In the host’s defense, the fridge went out on Christmas Eve and they were extremely communicative and helpful. They brought us a mini fridge and coolers on Christmas morning which we used until the fridge was fixed. It was just an unfortunate situation because it was a week long stay and we were without a real fridge/space for groceries, which resulted in a lot more eating out than we initially planned. Other than the fridge complications, this place is exactly as described. The house is well decorated and equipped with the things you will need during your stay. I would stay here again!

This house was absolutely lovely. Everything was how it was advertised, and better! The house has so many beautiful details, Meshelle really put her all into this home and it shows. The indoor/outdoor area was a freaking hit! We got lucky with some pretty amazing weather so we pretty much spent all of our time in the back area. The bed in the master was super comfortable as well so that’s a huge bonus. Everything was super clean, I loved how they left snacks and drinks for us, and a book with all the things to do.
Only area of concern was that Meshelle and her family live in garage located separately directly behind the home and that wasn’t communicated until after booking. Some people are weird about that so just a heads up. I wouldn’t have minded it necessarily, but the garage was super tight next to the house so it felt a bit invasive. Nothing major, just wish it was advertised that way prior to booking. Overall really enjoyed the stay and would book again.

This place was super cute! It had an 'old Austin' charm full of cheerful vintage and eclectic items. I would say that the photos did make it seem a bit newer than the place is, which was to my partner's disappointment. Yet, I totally embraced its homey and artsy feel. If you prefer modern minimalist like a hotel then perhaps this isn't your jam. But, if you prefer a place that has all the amenities a hotel has but feels like a true home, then book it! The outside has a great screened in porch that we totally took advantage of during our stay.
Steph and Meshelle were always super quick to respond. We asked about the cleanliness, because we were staying during the Covid epidemic and have a one year old. They assured us that everything was overly cleaned and sanitizer is left for our disposal. They also helped us after we left to retrieve an item that was left behind, with no issues.
The location is great and we would stay there again!

Meshelle’s place is beautifully decorated and looks exactly like the photos!  There’s plenty of extra blankets and towels stored throughout the house and pretty much anything you could need during your stay is provided. The screened-in back porch is a lovely bonus. Plus there’s a fire pit which is perfect for this time of year! Lots of street parking is available and the house is centrally located. I’d stay here again in a heartbeat!

This place is an absolute hidden gem! We stayed here while visiting Austin for my daughter’s orientation, and it couldn’t have been more perfect. From the moment we walked in, we felt right at home.
The decor is absolutely beautiful, stylish, thoughtfully designed, and full of gorgeous plants that make every space feel warm, peaceful, and inviting. Every room has its own charm, and it’s clear the hosts put so much care into creating an experience, not just a place to stay.
The home itself is incredibly cozy, comfortable, and private. After long, busy days, it was the perfect retreat to come back to and unwind.
One of our favorite discoveries was the adorable coffee truck just a five-minute walk away. Grabbing coffee there each morning made the whole experience feel even more special.
We genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay and we would absolutely stay here again!

27156940.description_html:
Architect-designed Loft and Cozy-Styled 1 bd 2 bth apt. (625 sqft) Overlooking DT AVL and Trees. PVT HOT TUB, Full Kitchen, Large Porch in RockWall Garden Nook/Lounge Entrance, Bdrm Deck. Nestled amongst large trees in the Heart of Beautiful Asheville. WALK to the HEART of DOWNTOWN in 7 Min. FREE PVT PARKING! Iconic Pack Square, South Slope, French Broad Chocolate Lounge among all breweries, restaurants n coffee houses 7 min WALK. Cozy. Relaxing. Romantic. Modern Open apt. attached to the home

The space
--WALK TO THE HEART OF DOWNTOWN IN 5-10 MINUTES
--PRIVATE WATERFALL HOT TUB NESTLED IN A ROCK-WALL GARDEN NOOK COURTYARD W/ 2 DECKS W/ 30 MASSAGE JETS
-- OVERLOOKING DOWNTOWN ASHEVILLE CITYSCAPE AND LARGE TREES
--QUIET, ROMANTIC, & ENCHANTING ENVIRONMENT
--PRIVATE PARKING, ENTRANCE, LARGE OUTDOOR PORCH, AND COURTYARD LOUNGE AREAS W/ PVT HOT TUB, BEDROOM DECK, AND OUTDOOR DINING NOOK
-- FULL OPEN-STYLE BRICK EXPOSED STAINLESS STEEL OPEN KITCHEN OVERLOOKING TREES AND ASHEVILLE CITYSCAPE
--YOUR LOFT and COZY AIRBNB APT. IS PRIVATE AND ATTACHED TO THE HOUSE, NOT SEPARATE.
--PRIVATE MOSAIC MODERN MASTER BATHROOM with brushed gold overhead waterfall rain shower and Large Console Sink
-- LARGE DEEP SOAKING TUB, supplied with bath salts and a pillow for those nights you want to relax.
-- Small 2nd Bathroom or mudroom with walk-in shower
—SAMSUNG STACKABLE WASHER AND DRYER w/Steamer & Iron
--Quiet and Private Residential Neighborhood.
--Sleep on a Queen-size Deluxe Foam Mattress.
--Twin Futon Oversized Chair with reading nook
-- Keurig coffee machine, French Press, Drip Coffee, Tea Kettle, Microwave, Toaster, and Cooper Full Kitchen Cookware, Stainless Steel Chef Knives
--Stock coffee or tea, heat up leftovers, or chill a beer from one of Asheville's many breweries in the stainless fridge, microwave, or Stove/Oven.
--Complimentary snacks, coffee, water, a local beer from one of Asheville's many breweries, and other goodies
--Relax and watch Netflix on 40 Inch UHD Smart Flat Screen TV with Roku.
—Keyless Entry for your convenience
-- Over 20 Years at 4 & 5 Star/Diamond Hotels Experience. Chill boutique feel to make you feel at home.
— Small professional personnel, individually trained to make sure you have a wonderful and memorable experience.
—Romantic, enchanting, and relaxing vibe
-Looking to accommodate more guests or a larger space look for our other listing The Charming Cottage.
-Stay Close to the Biltmore on a Couple of Acres Look for our listing Villa Rose

Guest access
--Your loft apartment- Bedroom, Master Bathroom with 2 Porches and Outdoor Areas with Hot Tub are Private and Your’s.
--The owner and host live on the opposite (back) side of the house; the rest of the house is off-limits

Other things to note
--There are a few easy steps leading to your entrance to keep in mind
--Please be respectful of noise levels. Quiet hours are 11 pm-8 am
-- Please be communicative if something is not working correctly, that way we can address it ASAP for you and other guests.
-- No Parties or Smoking.
--All additional guests must be announced.
--Please treat the space like it's yours

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: Absolutely loved our stay! Easily the most comfortable and clean Airbnb I’ve stayed in. The full kitchen setup would have been amazing for a longer stay. Hot tub was an amazing amenity. The hosts even reached us quickly after we left a personal item at the Airbnb upon check out. Thanks for the amazing stay!

This is the perfect place for a weekend getaway! The cottage was awesome, walking distance to downtown. Recommendations were awesome, loved exploring asheville and coming back at night. It was perfect for our little family, highly recommend.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here for a short stay in Asheville! The hosts truly thought of every little detail when preparing for guests. It was super convenient to walk to the downtown area.
This was a great weekend spot! Lots of space. Beautiful bathroom and awesome binder full of amazing recommendations.

This was a beautiful experience! The Airbnb was very close to downtown, so we were able to walk to places we wanted to go. Our stay was wonderful. We felt like we were in our own little world at the Airbnb. It was nice and quiet and peaceful. The hot tub was phenomenal! And we definitely enjoy the greenery around us. Brett was extremely helpful with all instructions and recommendations of things for us to do. Definitely would stay again. Made our first trip to Asheville together for our anniversary well worth it!

Awesome Property, It's feels like home. You can enjoy Cofee in balcony with chirping birds. Everything in house is perfectly set and best part is walkable distance to downtown and easy to approch highway to drive on blue ridge parkway. I would recommend to atleast try once if you are looking propery near to downtown and close to attraction. Thank you so much for warm welcomes and gifts

The cottage was awesome! Super cute and clean, and the hosts were super responsive and had tons of awesome local recommendations. We came for our honeymoon, and it was lovely! We’ll definitely be coming back at some point.
Our stay was wonderful! Would happy book again for our next trip!
We really enjoyed our stay. Everything was clean and comfortable and inviting. Great communication!

We lobed our stay! This is absolutely perfect for our future Asheville trips and plan on staying here again. It was so cozy, very clean, and quiet. It was an easy 15 minute walk right downtown to a ton of great spots. They provide awesome recommendations for trails and restaurants!
Very enjoyable and peaceful place! Close to downtown!

The stay in Brett’s place aka the cottage in the trees was magical. He was the best host a guest could ask for! This was my wife’s birthday trip and our first time in Asheville and we were thoroughly impressed! The cottage in the trees was cozy, tucked way, and absolutely stunning. It is just a few minute walk from downtown so it is in a wonderful location as well. All in all me and my wife will definitely be back!
Amazing place and easy walk to downtown
The place was very clean and cozy! Brett was a great host!
Loved everything about it. Would love to stay here again in the future. Great hosts with a great place in a great city.

My husband and I stayed here for a long weekend to celebrate our 20th anniversary. This was the perfect cottage for the occasion! The cottage is warm and inviting and in a perfect location for exploring downtown Asheville. We especially enjoyed coming home from a long day of exploring to soak in the hot tub!
Beautiful space super close to downtown! Brett was very responsive and we loved our stay.

Great place for a couple or single person to stay when they want a place close to downtown and walkable to just about everything.  Nice personal touches available for the guests. Very communicative and responsive owners. Safe environment and fit our needs for our two day stay.  Will recommend to couples who want a convenient getaway.
It was perfect- private and peaceful but still easily walkable. We would definitely stay there again!

Would highly recommend! Everything you need for a basecamp from which to explore Asheville. Although the space was small, it was cozy and Brett added great touches that added the hospitality that you'd get from a hotel (coffee maker, mini fridge, etc.). The shower had great water pressure and got nice and hot, too.
Brett was also super accommodating and went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable – turning up the heat a bit for us when it dipped into the 30's in the evening, and being extremely communicable all around.
As far as the neighborhood goes, you can't beat it. It's a 4 min drive to most things in town, and we enjoyed simply walking around the neighborhood as well. Close to all, but in a super quiet, peaceful neighborhood to get a good night's sleep in.
Last little bonus was the neighbor's cat, who came to say hello every day, and sat basking in the sun on the little deck outside our room. Such a soft little cutie!

Staying at Brett’s place was great!
It was clean and cozy! Great for just a weekend away- considering it doesn’t have a full kitchen Brett has a nice set up of a mini fridge and microwave with a few dishes etc.. for use! Reminded me of dorm life!
We got an inch of snow the night we arrived and it was so beautiful on the patio set up he had! Brett gave clear and detailed instructions which made our check in and out easy and fast!
Considering the room is attached to the home, we felt as though we had all the privacy of our own spot! No complaints at all!
Only hoping our girls trip late night gossips didn’t bother them! 😂
Great spot and will definitely consider staying again in the future!

Brett’s place is truly incredible. My boyfriend and I were impressed by quite a few things during our stay:
1) Cleanliness- the suite is immaculate!
2) Location- we were able to walk to most of our destinations during our stay, which was extremely convenient.
3) Personal Touches- having a bottle of wine, snacks, soaps, and makeup wipes waiting for us really did make us feel right at home. It’s that level of attention to detail that makes staying in Airbnb’s like this so special.
4) Communication- Brett was very communicative during our stay and had tons of recommendations on things to do and places to go. HIGHLY recommend his recommendations!!
Overall, Brett’s Airbnb is a gem in Asheville. Highly recommend to anyone visiting the city and wanting a charming stay, in a convenient location!

We had a fantastic stay at Brett’s cottage. The home was spotless, cozy, and beautifully designed, making it the perfect getaway. The highlight of the stay was definitely the hot tub, which was set in a serene spot where we could relax at the end of the day.
Brett was also incredibly thoughtful, providing clear instructions and even leaving little touches that made us feel right at home. He also checked in on us throughout our stay. The location was great too—quiet and peaceful, yet within walking distance to restaurants and bars in downtown Asheville.
If you’re looking for a place to unwind and recharge, this is it. I can’t recommend it enough and would absolutely stay here again!

We had a lovely stay at the cottage! Perfect spot for couples. Super close and walkable to downtown Asheville, but the cottage itself feels very private and peaceful. The hot tub was also a highlight as well as the gorgeous patio! Everything was super clean, beautifully decorated and parking was super easy and accessible! Overall we would definitely come stay here again, and the hosts were more than helpful and super friendly!

27611691.description_html:
Comfort with touches of whimsy. River views, parking outside your door, riverside pool (in-season), laundry room & fitness center. Walk to downtown, only 2 blocks from Sounds Stadium and Brooklyn Bowl. Your home away from home just far enough from the craziness of lower Broadway.

The space
This is a small space for 2 people. There's a king size bed in the bedroom and the sofa, when made up as a bed, is also king size, so you can sleep separately.

Please note that although there is a bedroom, there is no door to close on the bedroom, just a small hallway leading to it, so it is not a completely private space.

There's a full kitchen with all appliances. The remodeled bathroom has a shower, no bathtub.

**Please Note the pool opening is at the complete discretion of the condominium association and is weather permitting. It is usually open from the beginning of May to the end of October.

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: I can highly recommend Debbie’s place. Very well kept condo, perfect for a couple. Riverside and a balcony makes for a peaceful location.

We stayed at this Airbnb from September 11-15. The room and accommodations were clean, comfortable, and met our expectations. Unfortunately, our experience on the night of September 12 significantly impacted our stay.
Around 10:00 PM, we were locked out of the Airbnb because the battery in the door lock had died. There was no clear way to contact the host, and both of our phones died while we were trying to get help. We were stranded outside for approximately 2½ hours with all of our belongings locked inside.
Fortunately, we met a kind couple who allowed us to use their phone charger, and we were finally able to get in touch with Debbie. She eventually helped us regain access to the property. While the accommodations themselves were good, this situation was extremely stressful and could have been avoided with proper maintenance of the door lock and a more accessible emergency contact method.
Overall, the room was nice, but the lockout experience had a significant impact on our stay
Location was great with a nice walking path leading to downtown and Germantown. Baseball park just down the road with plenty of interesting places.

We were so happy at Debbie's!  She couldn't have been more helpful, kind, and accommodating! We had a wonderful time and the place was perfect for our Nashville experience! We cannot recommend this condo enough! Loved it!!

Perfect location in Nashville!  Quick Uber to all entertainment venues yet come back to a peaceful condo on the river!!  Such easy access and parking at the front door!!  Unheard of in Nashville!  Debbie's condo is spotless and well though out for convenience!!  Decor is so very 'Nashville intentional'.  We'll return!!
Great place, really nice space and close enough to Broadway, even got a raccoon on the back patio when we checked in lol
Great place to stay. I recommend  it
Great place to stay near entertainment and restaurants! Enjoyed being next to the river and seeing the groundhogs and raccoons!
She was very patient!!

Enjoyed my stay at Debbie’s. Safe and protected parking with a direct access to the front door. All the required amenities were available and the little deck at the back was very pleasant. Walked downtown daily in 20min. Equally easy to walk to the Farmer’s Market and Kroger grocery store. Adjacent baseball park was fun to catch a game. Two coffee shops 5min away by foot.  So really, a GREAT place to act as a home base while you visit this wonderful city!  My only heads-up is the gym.  If lifting weights is part of your weekly routine you will have to go elsewhere.  The dumbbell rack is devoid of dumbbells other than a pair of 5lb, 10lb and oddly enough a 30lb set.  There is a great Scott machine but zero plates other than 4 10lb plates.  The two bicycles are non-functional. The gym is essentially neglected by HOA. Even the television remote control doesn’t have batteries. I did not use the pool but it looked clean and perfectly functional.

We came to Nashville from Cincinnati to attend a concert. It was our first time in Nashville. Our stay was amazing. Amazing communication between the hosts. Conveniently located. Will be visiting Nashville again and this will be the go to spot to stay at!!!
One of the nicest apartments I've stayed at.  I loved the animals visiting and the little details.  The hosts were very communicative.  If you. can book this unit, I would suggest that you do!

We visited Nashville for Post Malones concert at the Nissan Stadium.  Debbie's listing was perfectly located for this.  It was a 15 minute walk to the stadium, and only a 10 min walk to broadway and all the fun honky tonk bars.  Debbie's decorations were super cute, and fun with a strong Nashville music theme.  We'd definitely stay again.

We had a great stay and would definitely book again. The Airbnb is exactly as described - clean, cute and very comfortable. King size bed was a plus. It had everything we needed & more. The location was great. We went to a ballgame at First Horizon Park and it's literally a 2 min walk. Germantown and Nashville Farmers Market are all nearby. Downtown Nashville was about a 20 min walk or very easy Uber ride. Highly recommend.

Gorgeous space, stunningly decorated with pop concert memorabilia. Every detail was a delight. We loved sitting on the little deck looking out at the river and spent quite a bit of time also at the lovely riverside pool. Couldn’t have enjoyed ourselves more! And Debbie was a kind and responsive host.

Wow!! If you want a place in Nashville that doesn't feel like you are in Nashville, this is the place! Right on the river. So peaceful. Saw lots of cardinals, a friendly racoon and a friendly woodchuck! So incredible. Very inexpensive Uber ride to Broadway. I wouldn't walk especially after dark. I would HIGHLY recommend this place!! Oh, I forgot to mention the pool, which was AWESOME! However no more than 2 people as it is perfect for 2 may be crowded with 3.

What a great find!  This place was perfect for my husband and I to relax and unwind. Great pool area and little patio with a river view. Beautiful little place. The area is really close to downtown and Germantown is just a short walk. Great place!
It was a wonderful location, especially for CMA fest and getting downtown. Great restaurants in the area and nice walking paths.

Overall we had a positive stay & no complaints. The location is great and easily walkable to Broadway. The unit is a smaller, cutely decorated Nashville-themed space. There is no door to the bedroom, the bathroom is only comfortable for one person at a time, & luggage space is limited, but these details matched our expectations from previous reviews.
The towels were incredibly soft, but only two were provided for two guests over a two-night stay. We heard a knocking sound each morning & the bedroom became very bright around 5 AM due to the sunlight, so darker blackout curtains would be a nice addition. The mattress was okay but felt somewhat worn.
We saw a groundhog when out on the patio one evening, which was a fun surprise. The host communicated quickly before check-in & after checkout. The lock instructions were clear & everything in the unit was well labeled. Our stay was positive & we have no complaints. I appreciate reviews that help set expectations; I hope these details help.

What an absolute gem! This was the BEST Airbnb stay. Debbie’s place is adorably decorated, incredibly well appointed, and super comfortable. Seriously, I could live here. The private patio overlooking the waterfront was my favorite spot. There is a family of cute little groundhogs that came to visit often. It’s close enough to everything yet it feels like a little oasis. If you’re in town for a concert at Brooklyn Bowl, this is your spot. It’s only two blocks away, as are good restaurants, coffee shops, a brewery, and a wine bar. There’s a great farmers market just a 15 minute walk away. As is a green belt and beautiful park. The Tennessee State Museum right there, free admission and extraordinary. I would stay here again and again in a heartbeat!

I liked the location-close enough to Broadway that it's walkable (15-20 min. walk, however we rode Bird's) yet far enough away from the busyness and noise. I felt safe there. The free parking was awesome and we very much enjoyed the pool! The river view was also nice. The bed and couch were comfortable. There was a Kroger very close by so that was convenient. The place had pretty much everything you'd need and was clean. The only downfalls in my opinion were the constantly running toilet and we would've preferred to have a TV in the bedroom. Overall, I was happy with it and the price and we had a great time!

This condo was the perfect home base for our trip. The condo was beautiful, well-stocked with everything we needed and great location.  We loved the covered parking and how plentiful the parking spots were. The walk to broadway was perfect for us and we had no issues walking it day or night. It was super hot this week so we did Uber to broadway a few times and it was only $8. We did go and check out pool which looked very nice however we never found time to swim. The laundry at condo was nice and easy with an app to run loads versus counting coins. Security was onsite rounding often and they were very friendly and personable fellows, we talked to them a few times just when we were out and about. It was a comfort to always see them just because we did not know area.  Debbie and Bill were great at communicating and we LOVED that they reached out to let us know condo was ready early and we were welcome early!! That helped us to kick off and organize day one so much better, we just appreciated that so much!! We would love to stay here again on our next trip to Nashville and we are recommending it to our friends.

We had a very nice stay.   The place was clean and comfortable with a nice view of the river and a quick walk to downtown.  The covered parking was a nice amenity.  The only thing that I would note, the bedroom is open to the living room, the wall doesn't go all the way to the ceiling and there is no bedroom door.  This could be a problem if you get up earlier than your spouse and want to turn the lights on or take a phone call.  The apartment had a nicely appointed kitchen, a nice bed, and my favorite couch I have ever sat on!  The air conditioning worked very well as did the internet.  I would absolutely stay here again.

A great place to stay in Nashville.  Far enough away from Broadway for peace and quiet, but easily walkable or Uber.  The condo was  perfect. Spotless and just as per pictures.  Watching the wildlife from the balcony and great river views, added to the experience.  The pool area was also ideal in the warm weather.  Hosts were always available if needed and provided great feedback.  Perfect for a short trip to Nashville.

reviews.comments: This is our second stay at Sean place and enjoyed it as the first time. We recommend Sean place and will stay there again.
The place was in a nice and quiet neighborhood. We had everything we needed. We enjoyed our stay very much.
Immediately felt at home.  I loved the pool, the waterfall was a perfect touch.   If we end up back in the Scottsdale area we will be back!
This place was quiet and felt private. It was clean and had everything you would need.  I had a surgery and needed to get around with a walker and it was tight but doable.  Pool area was very nice.

Sean’s place is great! Perfect for a couple. We’ve stayed multiple times and have enjoyed each time that we’ve been there. Very quiet neighborhood. Pictures are very accurate and just as described. Has everything you need and the pool is nice and private. Definitely our go to place. Thanks Sean!

Lovely place to stay! The private pool is such a huge perk I would honestly come back just for that. Casita feels bigger than the pictures too. Sean is very kind and proactive about making a comfortable stay. Really great neighborhood to stay in, just a 5 min drive everything in North Scottsdale.
Have stayed multiple times and this place never disappoints!  Quiet, safe location. Great pool. Comfortable bed. Restaurants galore. We hope to get back again next year.
Very comfortable and roomy.

We had a fantastic month-long stay at Suzi & Sean's Airbnb—it truly feels like our own private oasis. We are repeat customers! It's exactly as described: clean, spacious, and incredibly comfortable. We quickly settled in and felt right at home. The amenities were excellent and made our extended stay easy and relaxing. We especially appreciated the peaceful atmosphere, which made it the perfect place to unwind. The host was responsive and helpful throughout, and check-in was seamless. We look forward to a future stay and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quiet, comfortable getaway!

I genuinely loved my stay at Sean’s place. It was larger than I anticipated, easy to find and enter, clean as a whistle and in a nice and very quiet neighborhood. I felt comfortable immediately. The place also had every angle covered as it pertained to snacks and essentials. Every drawer you opened had utensils or wipes or bandaids and on and on. Just incredibly thoughtful and welcoming. Lastly but not least, the pool area is perfect. I spent a ton of time out there and it was serene and relaxing. I guess the best way to sum it all up is to say that I already booked a stay for the same time next year.

Perfect Casita for a couples getaway.
Safe quiet neighborhood, but close to anything you want to do in the greater Phoenix area. Oh yeah, and there’s a pool!
You will definitely stay again with Shaun and Susie!
We really appreciated having a place to stay near our family and friends that was affordable. Thank you!
We have developed a very good friendship with Saun and Suzi

The pictures were understated and didn’t give the full beauty of this suite. The studio was well stocked with items that made our stay very comfortable. The private pool was a gem sit near on a sunny morning with a cup of coffee. We loved this Airbnb and would highly recommend it!

I thoroughly enjoyed the space and appreciated Sean as a host. The only comment I have is I needed to do some work and the WiFi wasn’t  great, so I had to go to the local library. But otherwise I highly recommend!
Amazing host!

We have developed a great working relationship with Sean.
Having a place to know what, where and why’s about is very comforting during one’s travels.
I travelled for my career. I have been exposed to many Airbnbs and hotels. I choose to work with Sean and Suzi.
We had a great stay and felt completely safe throughout our visit. The place was clean, comfortable, and made for a relaxing experience. Would happily stay again.
Another wonderful stay at Sean and Suzy's guesthouse!

I travel a lot for work and have specifically spent many different stays down in the Phoenix area and can easily say that Sean's place was the best experience I've had so far. The place was spotless and conveniently arranged. He took the time to leave plenty of things I ended up needing and a fair few I just ended up wanting. Whether it was snacks that came in handy when I was in a hurry, or an extra tooth brush because I left mine behind, I was astounded by how fully stocked the space was to be lived in.
Sean allowed me the space to work and didn't interrupt me in person but sent several emails to check in throughout my week-and-a-half stay just in case I needed anything which was much appreciated. Really an experience you might get in a 5-Star hotel, except for a much MUCH better value. I cannot recommend a stay here more highly.

Stayed for a little over a week and had a great time. The place was welcoming and clean. Sean’s a great host that was super responsive if you had any questions. Good location if you just want to relax in Scottsdale. Bed was comfy and it was great to have access to laundry in the space. Pool was great and private. Thanks again Sean!

It's a bitter-sweet feeling writing this great review! Reminds me of finding the perfect fishing hole... You don't tell ANYONE!! Selfishly, I just want to save this for myself! lol
This place is perfect. Clean, comfortable, peaceful, pool was private and temp was so nice! Bed was comfy, Sean and his wife welcomed me, left me alone for my 1 week visit and I happened to run into Sean, shortly before we left. I felt so comfortable and everything I needed, was available! They thought of everything.
I left my only pair of running shoes behind and Sean was ever so kind to take them to the Post Office and have them returned to me, in Ohio, right away.
This place is something special and if you get the opportunity to stay here, it would be YOUR pleasure. Lastly, it's up the street from the Mayo clinic. Quick drive if you happen to be visiting for appointments.

Our stay at Sean's place was so smooth and enjoyable. I just wish it would of been warmer to make use of the great pool that is part of the package.  The place is perfect for either a single or two persons to stay. We were down there for a golf week and it worked out beautifully for us. I also think if a person had business in the area it would really work well. There was a desk area and the Wi-Fi was tremendous if you did need to do any work while you were there. We never had any real issues and did not have to request anything special. We did one night ask for a Mexican Restaurant recommendation and got a reply quickly. I give a double thumbs up to Sean's place and will not hesitate to come back again.

The property is exactly as posted.  It was a quiet peaceful place to stay.  I loved having access to the private pool.  The owners were great at communicating how to get in, a number to call if you needed anything, instructions on how to use everything.  Even checked (the one time we saw them) to see if we needed any tools during my daughters college move in.  Plus a very generous welcome snack basket.  Would recommend.  I will stay again when I’m in town.

Enjoy everything Asheville has to offer! Take a short walk through the backyard to hit the Mountain to Sea Trail for a scenic hike on the Blue Ridge Parkway or hop on by car approx two miles away to enjoy breathtaking scenery of the Blue Ridge Mountains. Start your day enjoying coffee on the peaceful front porch in the rocking chairs, or an afternoon nap in the hammock, and then to downtown less than 10 minutes away to your choice of incredible restaurants, breweries and shopping!

The space
Our cottage is completely furnished with a beautiful stone fireplace and gas logs. The sofa turns into a queen bed with a comfortable memory foam mattress.
Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen including a full fridge, microwave, toaster, blender, crockpot, Keurig coffee maker with an assortment of coffee and tea.
We provide hairdryers in both bathrooms as well as soaps, shampoo, and conditioner.
All linens and towels are provided and a full washer and dryer with detergent along with an iron/ironing board should you need to do personal laundry.
We love to provide our guests with all amenities to feel welcome and comfortable and to experience true southern hospitality.

No pets allowed.

Guest access
Our guests have access to the entire house and property.

Other things to note
Enjoy the abundant wildlife! Expect to see hawks, turkeys, deer, coyotes, and bears!

You'll be a quick 3-minute ride to the nightlife, sporting events, shopping, and everything Old Town Scottsdale has to offer.

Additional $75/day, for the entirety of your stay, to heat pool.

This newly remodeled and professionally decorated vacation home is the ultimate desert oasis with loads of smart home capabilities.

Family friendly - Available upon request - Booster, Playpen, Kids Dinnerware and toys for kids 6 mon-4 yrs.

The space
Beds are luxuriously appointed with high thread count sheets and resort quality mattresses. The 55" SMART TV is 4K Ultra HD with Youtube TV(local channels and live sports!), a premium Netflix account, Prime, Hulu, and Chromecast Ultra.

The TV room has a selection of board games. You'll find a whole list of games that you can play using the simple smart home system.

King Suite has a king size bed, Queen Suite has a queen size bed and Bunk Retreat has a bunk bed with 2 double beds and a twin trundle.

Wanna heat the pool!? for an additional $75 per day, for the entirety of your stay, the pool can be heated above 80 degrees! Please let us know at least 1 week before you arrive so you can be ready to jump in and make a splash!!

The corn hole game is located on the back patio.

The home is fully furnished with pots, pans, cooking utensils, iron, blow dryer, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, laundry soap, bath and pool towels, and literally everything you'd expect to have at home!

You have full access to the home including laundry, backyard, carport, easy to use smart homes system to maximize your enjoyment in the home. I want you to use it like it's your own!

TPT LICENSE: 21421694
City of Scottsdale License # ​STR2025-2031334

Guest access
The entire house is available for the guests to access.

Other things to note
Optional pool heating is available for $75 per day, must be purchased for the entire stay and requested at least seven days before arrival. The pool can be heated up to 80°F. The booking guest must be at least 25 years old. No pets are permitted, except service animals as required by applicable law and Airbnb policy. content.localizedString:
At least 2 guests must be over the age of 25 and will be an occupant of the unit during the entire reserved period.

*No parties, excessive noise, or any illegal activity shall take place at property.
*No excessive noise after 8 p.m. or before 6am.

Cleaning: Each property will be cleaned and inspected after your departure. We ask you to help us enable the cleaning crews as much as possible. Simple things like leaving the property tidy, running the dishwasher, starting to wash the towels, and taking out the trash are expected of our guests.

If excessive wear and tear is found on property, or additional cleaning is necessary due to spills, trash left on site, unclean dishes, stains to furniture, carpeting, linens, paint, wallpaper, or flooring, Guest authorizes the Owner to bill them for additional fees. If at any time the maximum number of occupants is exceeded or if the Owner receives information about excessive noise, Owner has the right to evict Guest and all occupants immediately and to bill the guest a minimum service fee of $250. If any sign of smoking is discovered Guest authorizes the Owner to charge the guest a minimum $500 cleaning fee. Unless the rental policy specifically allows, if any sign of any pet is discovered Guest authorizes Owner to charge the guest an additional minimum $500 cleaning fee.

Properties are fully furnished properties that will include bedspreads, linens, blankets, pillows, towels, a fully equipped kitchen, TV, furnishings unless otherwise specified.

POOL HEAT: The pool can be heated for an additional fee of $50+/day. Pending weather conditions, which will significantly impact the effectiveness of the pool heater, the pool can be heated up to 80 degrees in the winter months. It is important that the guests always keep the pool cover provided on the pool when not in use and at night when the temperature plummets.

Travel Insurance is highly recommended for any stay.

32724463.description_html:
DAVIDSON COUNTYSTRP#2018075308
Cozy up in the stone-lined hot tub or take an afternoon swim in the pool.

Beautiful historic East Nashville neighborhood, 50+ eateries & bars within blocks. Walkable to Broadway, Nissan stadium, Bridgestone Arena, the riverfront and the Ryman.

Come recreate Jessie and Deacon’s kiss from “Nashville”, Season 6, on the front porch where it was actually filmed.

Feel free to reach out for any assistance, we hope you enjoy your stay !

The space
This is a completely private 1000sqft loft with a separate entrance at a distance from the main structure of the house. There is a full kitchen, eat in area, large den, large bedroom with two queen beds and an additional 1/2 bath downstairs(accessible from outside) with washer and dryer. There is also a private outdoor shower (3 seasons).

Parking: You may park behind the garage for loading and unloading temporarily. Free parking is available 50ft away on 9th Street or Fatherland St. Russell St parking is permit only but enforcement is rare and random. Please Do not park behind the garage without discussion and permission; you may block our ability to get out and go to work .

Walkable to Broadway(1.0 mile), Nissan stadium(3/4 mile), Bridgestone Arena(about 1.3miles) and the riverfront(3/4 of a mile). Five points is a block away, see the guidebook upstairs for 50+ choices, bars, food, and live music close to you. We are 7.8 miles from the airport. No smoking is allowed on the property within buildings or inside the grounds. Please use the back alley if required. Swim at your own risk and NO DIVING is allowed in pool or hot tub. The hot tub requires 30-40 minutes to heat up in winter time. The heat is turned on separate from the jets and the heat must be turned on first for it to work properly. The heat stays on for two hours at a time the Jets for 30 minutes at a time. Utilizing the hot tub heat for more than two hours at a time is not allowed as it effects the system that is integrated with the pool. Particularly during freezing weather this could result in severe damage to pool systems. Instructions with pictures are in the book at the top of the stairs. There are several gyms available within 2-3 block walk for 3-15$ a visit.

Feel free to ask any questions we hope you enjoy your stay!

Guest access
Entry is via the rear of the property in the alley behind the house between Russell St and Fatherland street. We have electronic locks for the gate, outside and inside doors. Codes will be sent approximately 24 hours ahead of your stay. In addition to private indoor space, guests are welcome to enjoy shared outdoor grounds, pool, hot tub, outdoor kitchen/grill. This space is ONLY shared with my wife and I.

Other things to note
The property has a southwest exposure so the pool gets direct sun from 9am til 7pm during summer months. The sun deck is great in midday or the afternoon. The grill gas supply must be turned on to use and off immediately after use. Please ask for assistance if you would like to use it. We do not allow pets. Please no glass in pool area. No lifeguard on duty, swim at own risk.

Stayed for the Americanafest and this was a great location for many music venues. Fab restaurants and bars nearby. No need to go to downtown!

Lew & Susan are very quick to respond and very kind, accommodating hosts. We will stay here again when in the area!

Lovely place to stay! We really enjoyed it

Great place to stay, friendly, clean and very helpful! We would absolutely stay again.

This is our second time visiting Lew and Susan’s oasis! It is a great location. We immensely enjoyed their pool. It was very relaxing and private.
We can’t say enough good things about the hospitality Lew and Susan provide. Their communication is top notch and they’re so accommodating!

Great place to stay for a few days in Nashville! We loved this place!! Easy Uber ride to wherever you want to go!
The host do an excellent job of communicating and offering suggestions for entertainment and dining.
We loved the pool, hot tub and especially the outdoor shower. The pool seems larger than the pictures. However, as advertised, this is a true shared space. The host had visitors the last day we were there and they were outside the entire afternoon which made it a little awkward while we were using the pool and especially the shower even though they were super respectful and quiet. (We have never had to actually share “shared” space before.)
Highly recommend!!
Beautiful house, in great location, felt like a home away from home. hosts where extremely friendly and went above and beyond to make us feel as welcome as possible! Will hopefully be back

We had another fantastic stay at Lew and Susan’s place in Nashville. This was our second time staying with them, and they were great hosts yet again. Their communication was easy, proactive, and made everything seamless from check-in to check-out.
The location is outstanding — we were able to walk to a concert at Nissan Stadium, which made the trip incredibly convenient. The pool and hot tub were both excellent and added the perfect touch for a fun and relaxing stay.
The home had everything we needed, and it was clear that Lew and Susan put thought into making guests comfortable. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend their place to anyone visiting Nashville.
Great neighborhood.

Had a great stay, the hosts are super friendly and helpful, the home is beautiful and peaceful, pool and hot tub are perfect,couldn’t think of 1 bad thing to say about our stay it was everything we wanted and more 🤝

What a wonderful AirBnB! From the hot tub to the perfect location in East Nashville to wonderful hosts and super cute loft, this place was ideal and I highly recommend staying here. Directions were clear on finding the place and both the Susan and Lew were very communicative via the AirBnB messaging app. They even offered to start the hot tub for us upon arrival - what a wonderful way to start the trip! We were able to meet Susan briefly and get a run down of how to use the hot tub, although the welcome book is very thorough and clear, as well. (They also have the cutest dog!).
The place is clean and looks exactly as it does in photos. The rooms are well furnished for your needs, from a luggage rack for your suitcase to shampoo, conditioner, and a hairdryer for the bathroom. We especially loved that the freezer had filled ice trays and their was a water pitcher full of water for us in the fridge (and little bottles, should we need them!). They had glasses for wine and water, and plastic ones you can bring out to the hot tub!
The location.. I know a lot of people talk about location on AirBnB's and people usually scroll by that, but this place is seriously in an ideal location in Nasvhille. East Nasvhille is poppin' with great restaurants that are all very walkable from this loft and you can bypass the music-row-downtown feel and jump right into local, yummy eats and drinks.
This place, and its hosts, are fantastic! We will be staying here again in the future!

I thought this looked like a good spot to meet my father for about five days of vacation together in Nashville.  We were not disappointed!  Check in was very easy, the apartment was clean, private, comfortable, and welcoming, and the hosts responded almost instantly anytime we contacted them, were extremely knowledgeable regarding the wide variety of things to do in Nashville and the surrounding area.  Both of us are musicians and I had spent time in Nashville before so I can both vouch for the quality of the venues and activities recommended by the hosts from previous experience and also say they introduced me to some new places as well.  There are some great restaurants for breakfast all within a 10 or even 5 minute walk, and everything else we went to around the city was usually less than $10 a ride on the usual apps.  Great place to stay.

We stayed at Lew’s for 2 nights and it was great! Lew gave several helpful restaurant recommendations, and you can’t beat the hot tub & pool! Even in late October, we still got in the hot tub both nights that we stayed and it was great! The shower is very cool and extremely clean, but because of its unique shape, it was a tiny bit of a squeeze for my 6’4” husband. Definitely not a significant problem for the amount of time that we spent there, though. We also felt very safe during our stay due to the multiple key code locks on our doors. The hosts were very accommodating and quick to reply when we had questions, but also gave us plenty of space and privacy to do our own thing. It was just the two of us, but there’s plenty of room for a family or small friend group. Overall a great experience, would stay again!

We had the most amazing stay at Lew and Susan's. It's a gorgeous place and we loved the area of East Nashville - far enough away from the main centre to be peaceful but easy enough to get a Lyft in to town, or even walk in (although avoid hot times of the day, as its a fair distance!).
It really did feel like a little oasis with the pool and hot tub which we really enjoyed.
Lew and Susan provided a ton of recommendations before we headed out, responded quickly to my messages, and were close at hand if we needed any help. All in all we had a fantastic time and would definitely stay here in the future if we're back in Nashville!

Amazing accommodations, gracious and welcoming hosts, super close to everything we needed. Highly recommend staying here!
Apartment was tastefully decorated with beautiful and functional pieces that gave us the feel of being in a luxurious home, with a price closer to our budget.
Excellent recommendation for restaurants from $ to $$$ to fit anyone’s budget and a list of favorite things to see and do.
It is clear Lew and Susan have put a lot of care and consideration in making sure their guests have the most enjoyable experience possible.
Can not wait to go back again!

🤩 quiet, clean, well decorated. The bathroom a little bit too small but it was ok.

Lovely stay at this A-frame cabin. It was cute and cozy with real character, and clean throughout. The kitchen and cabin were well stocked with everything we needed, and the place was easy to find and access. Would happily stay again — thanks to Robin for a great home base for our Tahoe trip!

Absolutely loved this cabin for our family of four! Two toddlers that loved the stairs, the toy kitchen, and the deck. Our host was the nicest woman ever!! I would definitely rent this cabin again and recommend it! Super close to town and the lake but nestled in the woods, 10/10!
We will be back! This was a cute, intimate getaway that we truly needed. It was so peaceful and relaxing. Could not have asked for a better getaway. Thank you so much!
Nice stay.

Staying at the peaceful A-frame cabin in South Lake Tahoe was quiet even though close to a busy highway with standard comforts, bed, and bath. I would suggest some ear buds if you have family that gets up early and/or uses the restroom late at night as the home is VERY creaky and noisy. Watch your footing as well as there are lots of uneven pathways

Our stay in the A-Frame Cabin was fantastic!  The vibe of the place was exactly as described.  It was a beautiful nature location, which prompted us do take a lovely walk.  The deck outside was a wonderful touch, as we had our lunch on the picnic table.  Thanks for being excellent host, Robin! ✨🥇✨

Great spot. Quiet and private. We enjoyed sitting and having tea and coffee on the deck. This was our first time in Lake Tahoe and we only had a couple days there…this A-frame was just a short drive to all the things we wanted to do. Short drive to the state line. And we spent a ton of time at Emerald Bay. Responsive and friendly host…made good local recommendations…the Mexican restaurant near the state line on the Marriott property was great.
Just FYI…stairs to master bedroom are spiral and steep…no issue for us, but could be an issue for some.
We had a blast!

Awesome rental for great value, cleanliness was on point, interior was very subtle, not overly crowded with furniture and decorations like many other rentals I’ve stayed in. It definitely has the old cabin feel, wood walls, stairs, etc, but bathroom and kitchen are remodeled, making this cabin very well balanced between old cabin and modern functions. There was a variety of toys and books for the kids, were plenty to keep them busy for the night.
Secluded away from the city, but is on the corner of a small highway/street (though the windows are double pane and you won’t hear any noise from the inside), but sitting outside to enjoy the running water from the creek is not possible, and again, you’re at the corner of the entrance of a small neighborhood. That also means the top floor bedroom is exposed the every passerbyer on the street due to the huge top floor window, which doesn’t have any curtain or means to cover.
Fireplace is gas, not logs, which is one of the main filters I use when searching because sitting in a cabin between snow just needs a nice log fireplace with that beautiful burning wood smell. I thought this was a log fireplace, but sometimes its hard to tell as listings only list “fireplace” and the pictures aren’t always clear.
Overall, I’d definitely stay here again, just with the above in mind.

The most charming cabin. Great Location. Amazing amount of outdoor space. Equiped with everything you need. We appreciated the cleanliness, but unfortunately we did see cockroaches. Cable did not work as stated and we would have appreciated this communicated to us beforehand. Although we weren't planning on watching too much television one of our guests does have a strict routined day which includes television before bed. Overall we had a great time and enjoyed ourselves very much.

Beautiful, quaint cabin in such a nice location. We enjoyed our stay. Robin was able to got in sooner than the check-in time. So cozy and the interior is on point. The room downstairs is much smaller than upstairs. But the closet holds a toy kitchen which my toddler enjoyed playing. The stairs are narrow and makes a creaky noise when you climb up but the room upstairs is worth the view. Overall we had a great time.

This home was adorable and super clean. Robin left us a lovely welcome gift and was so easy to communicate with. it was such a relaxing atmosphere and the deck out front was perfect to sit on nestled underneath the huge beautiful trees....it was the perfect reading spot.    We will definitely stay here again the next time we're in town!

39037271.description_html:
Welcome to the Al Tahoe Oasis!

A perfectly relaxing cabin for your family or a couples getaway to enjoy all that Tahoe has to offer. The cabin is in the heart of South Lake -- just a 5-minute walk to Regan Beach/Lake Tahoe, or a short drive to Heavenly Village for skiing, dining and entertainment -- and yet, the quiet space of the home and neighborhood make it feel like you are a world away.

The space
The cabin is a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home that we have put our heart into renovating. It is a very comfortable space perfectly suited for a small family or two couples to spread out during their stay. Guests will have access to numerous amenities, including spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a kitchen stocked with cookware, a separate beer/wine refrigerator, a dishwasher, a washer/dryer, a smart TV, an outdoor fire pit, an outdoor swing, a gas grill, and a fully fenced private outdoor space that allows for children to run free while the parents relax on the patio. For families with young children, we also have a pack-n-play available.

If the Al Tahoe Oasis is not available for your preferred dates, please consider the "Tahoe Cabin Oasis" in South Lake Tahoe as another option. You can also find us at #mccluremccabins.

Guest access
Access to our Smart TV (use your own subscriptions to Netflix, Hulu, etc.), Gas Grill and Fire Pit.

The upstairs loft area is locked and off limits to guests. We use it for storage and as our daughter's play room when we're visiting the cabin.

Other things to note
After booking, we will email you a detailed Cabin Guide with instructions for the cabin, as well as some of our favorite spots around the area.

body.localizedContent: About a 5-min walk to Lake Tahoe and Regan Beach, with restaurants and coffee shops just blocks away
A fully fenced yard with a fire pit, gas grill, outdoor swing, and a private patio for unwinding
Guests highlight how clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully detailed the cabin is, with many returning

The special touches like Christmas decor and warm rugs and cushions added to make the place so gorgeously beautiful and a wonderful living space made our trip to Tahoe so special. I didn’t feel like I was at a “cookie cutter” Airbnb. Although the inside of the house was super nice, I think my favorite part of this stay was the front yard. The neighborhood is quiet and within walking distance of the lake, which incidentally there are two bikes in the garage that guests are welcome to use. I didn’t have time to ride, but maybe next time. There are also some nice little restaurants and local shops a short walk away. Overall, this was the quintessential Tahoe stay that everyone should expect when the visit. I will absolutely stay here again, but next I’m bringing my wife so she can enjoy it with me.

This is by far the best rental in Tahoe in my 10+ years visiting the area. The house is beautifully renovated with many thoughtful touches.
We stayed here with our 6 y/o daughter and enjoyed every minute.

Thank you for the perfect stay and we can’t wait to return!

The beds are comfortable and the bathtub and rainforest shower are great. Our three year old daughter got to binge watch disney plus and sled in the front yard to her heart's content. This place is also within walking distance to the lake and has next to some great dining options. We will not be staying or celebrating my birthday anywhere else :)

39290956.description_html:
Located just outside Asheville, NC on top of a mountain is a little piece of heaven. Clear views of the valley and the peace and quiet will make you question why you live in the city. You can spend your evenings relaxing by the fire or venture out into the area where there is lots to see and do. Asheville is only a few minutes away and is home to some of the best restaurants you can find. Arts, crafts, shopping etc. are at your fingertips as well as tons of hiking trails.

The space
The cabin is complete with high speed internet, smart tv, Polk soundbar, dvd player and movies. Fully equipped kitchen with all the utensils/pots and pans you will need as well as a coffee maker, coffee bean grinder, microwave, etc. Washer and dryer located in bathroom hallway if needed. Wood burning fireplace in living room. Firepit outside with adirondack chairs and a hammock. Chase lounge chairs on the deck as well as outdoor patio table. Best part is the peace and tranquility and waking up to amazing sunrises of the valley.

Guest access
You have access to the entire cabin as well as hiking on the property.

Other things to note
There is a short hike on the property. I have 50 acres and you can walk to the very top of the mountain, Inquire for more info.

Private Studio Garage Apartment: Detached, 2nd-story, Sleeps 2.

Detached unit at the rear of property has second-story deck surrounded by trees, affording outside living space with privacy. The balcony overlooks a small ravine with a creek, no other properties back up to it, so it's quite secluded and private - perfect for having a nice coffee or tea, or a great spot to do yoga!

Minutes walk to SoCo, the Lake, Downtown, with easy access to festivals, and all that Austin has to offer!

The space
This charming garage apartment, fully renovated but with remaining vintage charm, is convenient, comfortable, quiet and private.

Detached unit at the rear of property has second-story deck surrounded by trees, affording outside living space with privacy.

Open floor plan, vaulted ceilings, plenty of natural light, and a renovation that added all modern conveniences, while keeping many of the historic materials and trim for the original 1920's unit. We've also furnished it with family pieces, and some fine art in a style we'll call 'Mid-Century Mash-Up!'. Fun, funky, clean with solid lines, and all the creature comforts.

We walk downtown and to festivals while others are still looking for parking. Rent a couple of bikes and you have the majority of Austin at your convenience. SoCo is a veritable weekend in itself - shops, boutiques, restaurants, food trailers, bars, clubs and so much more, just blocks away. But, once you've had enough of folks, retreat to the calm of the Bolthole.

Perfect for a couple or single person just looking to be secluded, yet close. Hardwood floors, high ceilings, skylight provides wonderful light in the bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen and easy neighborhood street parking.

Minutes walk to SoCo, the Lake, Downtown, easy access to festivals, and all that Austin has to offer!

Waking up to the lovely view of trees was wonderful.  The aircon was really efficient and kept us cool.  We would absolutely stay here again if we return to Austin.  That you Chris for sharing your lovely bolthole.
Chris’s place is so beautiful and peaceful while being very close (within 5-15 min drive) to everything Austin has to offer. Also walking distance to Lady Bird Lake. A great getaway!

I had a very good stay here. The accommodation is huge, with lots of space, very clean, and it really does look and feel like a proper tree house. The peaceful surroundings make it a unique and very nice place to stay.
The main downside is the noisy air conditioner. It is a pity because without the noise, you could fall asleep listening to the sounds of nature outside. Communication with the owner was good and clear, although there was perhaps a little more emphasis on the checkout time than necessary. Most guests will simply respect the stated checkout time, so the additional reminders felt a little unnecessary.
These are minor points, though. Overall, it is a spacious, clean, peaceful, and genuinely special place, and I really enjoyed my stay.
Without a doubt, my favorite rental I’ve ever stayed in! Chris is ultra communicative and super friendly. The guy is a pro ! I will be back!
Great host, stay, and place!  Thanks for everything!!
Great accommodations in a walkable location. Chris was very kind and responsive. We loved every minute of our stay.

This Airbnb was beautiful, comfortable and quiet. The location is also fantastic and close to Austin's go-to spots. The apartment was also well stocked with items for our use. I would easily stay here again.
Amazing place, very beautiful, great surrounding area, and very peaceful. Chris was great with communication and giving local recommendations. Loved my stay, will definitely book again!
Great location and well equipped. Thanks for a great stay!
Really enjoyed Chris’ place! Was clean, peaceful, and in a great location to get where we needed to be. I would stay again!

The neighborhood was amazing… Super close to South Congress with lots of really cool and fun places to go. The place itself was nice… But the biggest thing that stood out to me was the fact that I couldn’t control the thermostat. I had a thermostat that I could change the temperature on, but inevitably both nights (maybe around midnight?) it would automatically go up to 72°. I like to sleep cold and so I would put it at around 68° when I went to sleep… And then I would wake up hot about four hours later. Really frustrating as that happened both nights. The second night I even woke up at 1 AM and changed it back to 68° after it was reset to 72, and then 5 o’clock in the morning woke up and it was back to 72°. The other thing was that there are no curtains or blinds or anything, so be prepared to wake up with the sun. Thankfully, for me, it was raining and overcast, but I can see how if you wanted to sleep in you wouldn’t really be able to.

Staying at the Bolthole in Travis Heights was an absolute delight! The picture frame windows provided stunning views and filled the space with natural light, making it feel cozy and welcoming. We loved the privacy and the serene atmosphere—it truly felt like a retreat. The kitchen was a dream, fully stocked with all the appliances and cookery you could need, making cooking a joy. Having access to every TV channel and streaming service was a fantastic bonus, and the bed was incredibly comfy, ensuring restful nights. This place has everything you could want and more. We can’t wait to come back!

This is a lovely space, quiet and v. private - walkable to South Congress, although I had a car during my time here which made it so much more pleasant.
Chris clearly takes really good care of his space. It has everything that you'll need -- and more. A lot of attention to detail which felt really beautiful to receive.
Very comfortable w/ a deck that looked out into the trees for morning yoga and meditation.
I hardly saw Chris except in passing -- very, very nice man and his little Egyptian dog!
I would say that only thing that was slightly challenging is being out by 10:00 am. If this isn't an issue w/ you then, this is a really, really great spot.

Beautiful and private location with a shady deck—I felt like I was staying in a treehouse. The property is tucked away in a charming neighborhood, within walking distance of coffee shops, a small market, and restaurants. The AC worked perfectly, and I loved the lived-in feel along with the art and unique style throughout the space. I traveled alone for a work meeting, but it would also make a wonderful romantic getaway for a couple.
Host was very responsive and accommodating, I would stay here again.

Chris is a very accommodating, friendly, and communicative host. He made us feel very welcome during our stay and was quick to respond to all our questions.
The unit itself was incredible. It was much larger than the pictures initially made it seem and everything we needed was provided by Chris. The location was fantastic! Everything was walkable or a short ride away. I would definitely stay here again, and would give it more than 5 stars if I could.

My husband and I loved staying at Chris’s place! The apartment is a great size, stylish, and very quiet, with a comfortable bed. We especially enjoyed the deck surrounded by nature—it felt so private and peaceful. The neighborhood is beautiful, and we loved walking to nearby restaurants and across the South Congress Bridge to watch the bats emerge at sunset. Chris was unobtrusive; while we would have enjoyed saying hello, we really appreciated the privacy his style allowed. Thank you, Chris—your place is wonderful!
