39501703.description_html:
This house is a collection of stories. Stories of cultural and personal history, ecology, and craft. To celebrate this area's incredible legacy of craft, we’ve collaborated with some of the most talented makers in the region. Staying at the Nook you’ll have an experience unheard of in the modern era -- almost everything you touch or interact with was woven, shaped or whittled by hand.

*Please note that outdoor bathhouse may not be available during winter months due to low temperatures.

The space
Traditional craft requires a relationship with local materials -- not just as supplies but as plants, trees, and ecosystems. The design is meant to highlight all of the interconnected facets of Western North Carolina that are worth celebrating from the artists to the land itself. It is also designed to foster a lifestyle of intentionality and awareness. We invite you to come in, slow down, and have your own experience with the nature and craft of this area.

The Nook was named the Most Unique Airbnb in NC by Travel and Leisure Magazine. A whole episode about the philosophy and building of The Nook can be seen in the TV series, Cabin Chronicles on Magnolia Network and HBO. The Nook has also been featured in Dwell Magazine, Apartment Therapy, Monocle, the book Parklife Hideaways, The Financial Times, Town Carolina and others.

Located just 15 minutes from downtown Asheville and 8 minutes from the Blue Ridge Parkway, the Nook is a perfect artist retreat or romantic getaway. Through the designs made for us by good friends and power couple, Rob and Karie of Shelter Collective, the Nook theme plays out in many ways, but starts with how tightly nestled the house is among the trees. The nooks inside include a breakfast alcove, a tea loft, an entertainment loft, and a cozy sleeping area. Aside from the nooks is an airy living space with an 18 foot ceiling, expansive windows, and a swing to enjoy the outdoor (or indoor) views. There is an outdoor bathhouse which is available most of the year, but is cut off for much of the Winter. A fire pit and wood to burn is available all year.

We provide local products such as spices, beer, liqueur, tea and coffee.

Every piece of art in the home, along with the materials used are part of an evolving story. As a single example to illustrate the point, there is a felted wool diorama made by local artist, Haley Nocik installed inside the wall next to the bed. The scene depicts a bird gathering materials to make a nest and a mother bunny in a burrow with its babies. The story is derived from two experiences while building the cabin. One was when we found a bird nest in the wall while building in the very spot where the diorama now resides. The nest was made of of our wood shavings and materials that we had been using to build the cabin. I gave the nest to Haley to use in the diorama in her recreation of the scene. The rabbits came from a time when we were building and heard a squeaking noice which ended up being a black snake trying to eat a baby bunny. The bunny was still alive and I rescued it from the snakes jaws. Later I came back and collected the fir that was used to create the den where the babies were born and gave that to Haley to include in the scene as well. This is just one of many examples of the depth of story in each art piece, each of which was commissioned as a one of a kind collaboration.

Guest access
The entire property accessible by your dedicated driveway is available and private to you.

Other things to note
There is a refrigerator, stovetop, and a toaster oven, but no freezer or full size oven. So be aware of that when planning meals. Some folks bring a cooler and leave it on the porch with ice.

Also, the water is from a well and is tasty and safe. We provide a carafe in the fridge that you can keep full of water from the faucet.

A private seasonal hot tub nestled among the trees, with a fire pit and swing for unwinding outdoors.
Guests describe a space where every detail feels intentional, from the handcrafted art to the cozy nooks.

42668767.description_html:
This second floor one bedroom condo has a comfy king size bed and all amenities including Wifi, a well stocked kitchen and complimentary coffee. There's a balcony overlooking the pool and views of Camelback Mountain out the front patio door. The location can't be beat!! Across the street from Fashion Square Mall and within walking distance of everything Old Town Scottsdale has to offer: nightlife, shopping, museums, art galleries, restaurants and more! Designated covered parking space included.

The space
We take pride in the cleanliness of our non-smoking condo. Everything is thoroughly cleaned, disinfected and sanitized before your arrival. Built in 1974, but recently updated, the space is bright and cheerful with tasteful, quality furnishings. Upon arrival you will find a covered designated parking space, convenient keyless entry, comfortable AC/heat and strong reliable wifi throughout. Relax and make yourself at home in this charming, quiet Scottsdale condominium.
The living room has a queen size sofa bed with an upgraded memory foam mattress. The 55" SmartTV has basic channels and streaming capabilities. The dining room seats four and there is room for two at the pass-thru bar. Enjoy happy hour on the patio balcony where you can perch and overlook the pool and lush grounds, or sit out front at the bistro table and watch the sunset behind Camelback Mountain. Whirl up a blender of margs, mix a cocktail or toast some champagne with our assortment of barware glasses. If you decide to cook in, the fully equipped kitchen has everything you need including spices. Or maybe you'd like to BBQ down by the pool... we have stuff for that too! And if you want to hang out at the pool, we provide pool towels.
In the bedroom there is another TV, ample closet/drawer space and an ironing board w/iron. You'll also find a fold down desk if you need space to work. You'll enjoy a restful slumber on the firm king size memory foam bed fitted with 100% cotton sheets and a variety of pillows. The bathroom is appointed with all the amenities you'd expect: fluffy towels, shampoo, conditioner, soap, lotion, and blowdryer.
There is an updated community laundry room conveniently located downstairs that uses the ShinePay app. We provide detergent pods and a laundry basket for your convenience.
There are also newly installed EV Chargers available in the complex for your electric vehicle.
If you choose to book with us, please have a complete profile (using the link under Account below your photo icon) so we can know a bit about you, thanks!
AZ License #21359921, City of Scottsdale registration #2023535

Guest access
Guests will have the entire condo to themselves.

Other things to note
Reminder: This is a non-smoking unit.
NO pets; NOT suitable for children or infants.
AZ License #21359921, City of Scottsdale registration #2023535

The accommodation is in an excellent location, plus there’s a pool you can use! I’d highly recommend this accommodation and hosts!

I hesitate to say how great it was because I’m fearful they won’t be available the next time I want to book but oh well enjoy!

Michelle’s condo is always lovely. This is my second time coming.. it’s that great! Such a homey feel, comfortable bed, and clean. Perfect location in Scottsdale. Nice overlook of the pool from the balcony in the evenings.
A wonderful oasis and peaceful!

I had a wonderful few days in Scottsdale at Michelle's place. It was cute, clean, quiet, and had easy access to the onsite pool and walkability to restaurants and Old Town Scottsdale. I would definitely stay here again in a future visit!

Clean, quiet, nicely decorated. Michelle has made sure that you’ve got everything you need. And she quickly responded to questions we had prior to heading down there. It was a great place for the money. We would definitely return the next time we go to Scottsdale.

This was our first airbnb experience and it was perfect, from the communication, check in, accommodations, pool and check out! Michelle was a wonderful host and we had a great time in Scottsdale! Thank you again!
The condo was very nicely decorated, clean and comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay at this condo. The space was spotless, comfortable and thoughtfully set up with everything we needed. The condo itself is small but very well designed. Michelle’s place is exactly as advertised and my stay was enjoyable. Would definitely look to stay here again when in Scottsdale.

I was looking for a nice place to stay when visiting my daughter in Scottsdale for the weekend. This place was perfect for my husband and I. Comfortable bed, nice televisions, and an accommodating kitchen with dining room table. We spent time at the pool which was conveniently located. I would definitely book this place again and would highly recommend.

Michelle was a great host and very responsive. The condo was clean and easy to find. It’s in a nice location and walkable to restaurants and shopping. The complex is very quiet and safe. It has a great pool area with lots of sun. I’d recommend staying here!

Michelle’s space was clean, had everything we needed and was the perfect location for exploring Scottsdale. The location was convenient for a walk to the downtown area (15-20mins) or a short drive (5mins) if that is what you prefer. The space was exactly as pictured in the listing and stocked with towels for the pool, kitchen items and coffee was provided too which was a nice touch! Michelle was very communicative and made the whole stay very smooth! Would definitely recommend.
Perfectly appointed little place. Close to restaurants and shopping
Clean and comfortable unit. Easily walkable to Fashion Square and Old Scottsdale and of the restaurants and shops there. Would stay again without hesitation

Everything was just as I expected and more. Michelle had beverages and chocolates for us in the refrigerator when we arrived. She answered any questions I had in a timely manner and I even extended my stay a few more days because it was so enjoyable there.
Great location, quiet and safe. I would stay there again sometime.

Michelle's condo was was everything noted on its description and more! It was the most immaculate Airbnb that we have ever stayed in. Her place had all the amenities that you would want, whether you were staying 3 days or months. From the fully equipped kitchen, which included coffee, to the closet full of hangars, to the bins of supplies and games, and the storage for her guests, all your needs were met. Even the location was perfect! We walked to all areas of Old Town, which included shops and restaurants. Travel by car to the Scottsdale/Phoenix's highlights were also easily accessible.
I would highly recommend Michelle's charming quiet condo in the heart of Scottsdale for your next visit to that area.
Sue & Dan

Have stayed at Michelle’s apartment twice and both weeks were outstanding. Little treats, very clean, safe complex and furnishings are up to date. Every need is anticipated.
The location is ideal.

We loved Scottsdale and Michelle's place. She was really communicative and helpful. The little touches around the space were really appreciated. The drinks in the fridge and chocolates in the room were exactly what we needed after a long drive in from California. We were close to everything from golf to shopping and eating.
The only thing to note is that to get to the unit is about two flights of stairs so if you have a lot of luggage it's something to consider. The laundry room is on the first floor, but was easy to access and Michelle left very detailed instructions which was helpful.

The condo was just what my husband and I needed for our week long stay in Scottsdale. The condo is a few blocks from old Scottsdale where all the shops and restaurants are located. The condo is clean, quiet and relaxing. The complex is also well maintained. Michelle had everything we needed and left a binder with instructions, etc. We had the best time and we were so grateful we found her place!

We loved our stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described and was the perfect home base for exploring Scottsdale, Tempe, and the Phoenix area. It was super easy to access, spotlessly clean, and well stocked with everything we needed.
Michelle went above and beyond to make our stay extra special, even leaving us a couple of drinks and a nice welcome note. She was very responsive to any questions we had and was super friendly.
The location was perfect—close to great restaurants, Old Town, grocery stores, the airport, and the Mayo Clinic (about a 15-20 minute drive). We’ll definitely stay here again when we’re in the area!

This place was the perfect location for a quick weekend in Scottsdale, walking distance to plenty of things and a quick & cheap Uber ride to anything else (especially if it’s too hot to be walking around). We even got to utilize the complex pool. Michelle was super responsive to any questions and helpful with everything. It is very clear that Michelle and her husband know what they are doing. There isn’t a single detail overlooked in this place. It had everything you could need, and they even left a cute note with two local beers in the fridge for us when we arrived and left chocolates in the bedroom! The condo is very cutely decorated, nice and cool/air conditioned, and has a large king bed. What more could you ask for?
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone else looking in the area.

We enjoyed our stay in this adorable condo. Perfect for the 2 of us and could accommodate 3-4 with the sleeper sofa.
Everything was sparkling clean, and everything we could want to cook (we didn’t!) was available. Quiet. Nice view over the pool. Near a huge mall. Convenient location. Nice welcoming touches- some goodies in the fridge!

Our cliffside cabin is an immersion into a world where adventure meets serenity, where you'll feel the embrace of nature and the thrill of the extraordinary.

Enjoy complete serenity while being just a short drive away from fantastic restaurants, shops, and attractions.

✔ Partially Suspended over a Cliff!
✔ Comfortable Queen Bed + Sofa
✔ Kitchenette
✔ Deck with Scenic Views

The space
Welcome to the Raven Rock Cabin! Nestled on the precipice of adventure, this cliffside cabin beckons those seeking a truly extraordinary ambiance. This one-of-a-kind retreat combines the thrill of being partially suspended over a cliff with the serenity of nature, offering a captivating blend of excitement and tranquility in a setting where modern amenities take a backseat to the beauty of the wilderness.

★ CABIN (BEDROOM, LIVING AREA, KITCHENETTE) ★
Step inside, and you'll discover a world of comfort and coziness. The cabin's interior features a plush queen bed that promises restful nights, while a comfortable sofa invites you to relax and soak in the breathtaking surroundings. The decor exudes mountain charm, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere that perfectly complements the rugged exterior. On cooler evenings, the mini wood stove adds a touch of rustic romance, filling the cabin with the crackling warmth of a real fire.

✔ Comfortable Queen-Size Bed - BRING YOUR SHEETS AND BEDDING
✔ Cozy Sofa
✔ Wood stove
✔ Kitchenette Accessories (Spices, Glasses, Plates, Mugs, Pot, Pan)

★ COVERED DECK ★
The cabin's covered deck is an two burner cooktop. Enjoy the simple pleasure of cooking amidst the wilderness or savor delicious meals at the dining bar, all while perched high above the cliff. This space is ideal for enjoying the fresh mountain air and immersing yourself in the beauty of the great outdoors.

✔ Outdoor Kitchen with a two burner gas cooktop
✔ Bar with Seating for 4
✔ 5-Gallon Springwater Dispenser

★ BATHROOM ★
Just 50 feet from the cabin, you'll find a clean and well-maintained Porta Potty, ensuring your necessities are well taken care of. While unconventional, it perfectly complements the cabin's unique setting, offering a private and hygienic space for your needs. The proximity to nature provides a connection to the great outdoors that's both thrilling and serene.

✔ Porta Potty (50ft from the Cabin)
✔ Spring Water Shower (50ft from the Cabin)

Escape to this unique cliffside cabin for an unforgettable adventure that combines the thrill of being on the edge with the tranquility of nature. Don't miss the chance to embrace the extraordinary - book your stay today and create cherished memories in this off-the-grid retreat like no other.

Guest access
The cabin is exclusively yours, without interruption during your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home also comes with the following:

✔ Self Check-In (Keypad)
✔ 500watt Solar Generator
✔ Gravity Spring Fed Spigot & Hose (Cold)
✔ Free Parking

Other things to note
★ OFF-THE-GRID SITE – ADDITIONAL INFO ★
Living off the grid, surrounded by a breathtaking natural environment, is a truly magical experience. However, there are some things you need to be aware of before you arrive at this dreamy haven.

☆ Electricity ☆
This site is off-grid and not connected to the electric grid. There is a solar-powered generator for cell phones and laptops. 5G is excellent, so you won’t have trouble checking your messages or texting your loved ones.

☆ Steep Access – 4 Wheel Drive Only ☆
Access is well maintained but too steep for 2-wheel drive. If you are coming with a 2-wheel drive car, look for designated 2WD parking area and hike for about 15 minutes until you reach the cottage.

☆ Kindling & Wood ☆
Please note we do not supply wood for the outdoor fire pits. If you wish to bring some you are more than welcome to. We do supply wood, fire starters and kindling for the indoor woodstove during the cold winter months..

☆ Wildlife ☆
Bears are extremely shy but hungry. Please store all the food. If you are an early riser and quieter, you may see bobcats, foxes, deer, turkeys, hawks, falcons, grouse, owls, and ravens.

☆ Linens & Bedding ☆
Guests are asked to bring their own queen-size sheets and blankets for a cozy at-home feel. Pillows are provided, along with a light comforter.


★ ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATION ON THE PROPERTY ★
Traveling in a larger group, or your preferred dates are already taken? You'll be happy to know that we offer additional unique accommodation on the property. Please browse our host profile for the complete list of gorgeous listings.

★ WEDDING & EVENT VENUE ★
Our properties offer more than just a place to stay; they provide the perfect backdrop for unforgettable moments. For those seeking a picturesque setting for weddings, gatherings, and special events, we offer an enchanting venue that can be rented at an EXTRA CHARGE. Nestled amidst the beauty of nature, our event spaces ensure your celebrations are as unique as they are memorable.

★ CLEANING & SANITATION ★
Health, safety, and well-being of our guests are of utmost importance. For this reason, we use a thorough cleaning process after each check-out.

★ PETS WELCOME ★
We love little (and not so little) furry bundles of joy. A pet fee of $35 dollars a night will be applied for guests bringing pets. The fee is to cover the additional cleaning and maintenance required after a pet stays.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in odor removal and furniture cleaning fees.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding

content.localizedString:
Driving directly to the venue requires an AWD or 4WD vehicle. Traction — not vehicle clearance — determines access. Two-wheel-drive vehicles cannot reliably reach the venue.
Guests who arrive without AWD/4WD must park at the lower parking area and access the venue via a steep, physically demanding uphill walk. Guests must be able to carry all belongings on uneven terrain. Rolling luggage, hard-shell suitcases, or dragging gear is not suitable for this property.
This is a remote mountain property with multiple venues. Guests are responsible for knowing exactly which venue they have booked before arrival.
Maintenance staff are available on the mountain only during daylight hours and with limited availability. Any gear shuttling or assistance is not guaranteed and is not concierge service. There is no nighttime staffing. Guests who arrive unprepared, after dark, or without proper access may experience delays or be unable to reach the venue

Unattended pets must be securely crated. 

Please clean up after your pet and dispose of waste properly (in trash). 

All wheel drive is required.  the gravel road its well maintained but much to steep for 2 wheel drive vehicles.

In winter months fire building and wood stove skills are required.

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments:
We had the BEST time at this incredible cabin! Truly a magical stay! The mountain views are 10/10, especially during sunrise and sunset. Some unexpected, delightful fall discoveries in the area included u-pick flowers at Singing Flower Farm and apple picking at Justus Orchard.
Some notes: they’re not joking about needing 4-wheel drive to make it up and down the mountain! Also we came prepared with some extra camping supplies that we were grateful for including some folding chairs, lanterns & flashlights, and some extra cooking supplies. Do keep in mind, there are bugs around (didn’t bother us) and be prepared for a chilly shower (polar plunge, anyone?)!
The hosts are very communicative and responsive. I would highly recommend this spot and I hope to visit again!
It’s a very cool place to stay. It’s not too far from civilization 😃 but still makes you feel isolated enough. I would definitely recommend staying here.
glamping with a view! this is gem of a spot and i will definitely be coming back.

We stayed here three years ago when I proposed to my wife, we came back for a one year anniversary and I did not disappoint. Everything was exactly the same, which is what we’d hoped for super peaceful and relaxing. Would recommend this to anybody.
My fiance, dog, and I had a great time. The location and view were perfect. We’ll definitely want to come back again in the future.

We absolutely loved our stay at Cliffside Cabin! The cabin was beautiful, cozy, clean, and the mountain views were incredible. It was the perfect place to come back to after a full day of hiking and exploring. We loved relaxing by the fire, enjoying the peaceful setting, and taking in the scenery. Jen and Doug were wonderful hosts and made everything easy from check in to check out. We packed so much into our trip, but coming back to this cabin each evening was definitely one of the highlights. We would absolutely stay here again! 🩷

I have nothing but great things to say about this stay. It is so unique with many thoughtful touches. It is the perfect “camping” spot with the luxury of a bed and spring fed shower. The views from the cabin were spectacular. This is definitely one of the neatest bnbs we’ve ever stayed in. We will be back!

I booked this place as a surprise trip for my husband’s birthday. It was even better than expected! Perfect combination of off the grid but still comfortable. Views were unmatched and so many cool features of the place! There was even a cool local coffee shop within 5 minutes. Sending this place to all of our friends and look forward to booking again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Jen and Doug’s place, this place is really special. The view was amazing, great sunset views. We loved cooking dinner in the outdoor covered kitchen area, the kitchen was perfectly stocked for our needs.  Everything was so clean and comfortable and we loved the indoor/outdoor feeling. Would definitely stay here again if we had the chance.

We enjoyed the stay in the cabin on the cliff! It has gorgeous views and the best glamping we ever done. The hosts  described the location very well and we are happy we had the AWD because the road to the cabin is very steep. We enjoyed taking a  cool shower as the day was hot when we stayed. If you're looking for getting away from hustle and bustle of the city, this cabin is the ticket.
Everything was better then expected!! I love it
Great adventure getaway
This place was amazingly peaceful. I had a great time recharging and enjoying the beautiful views. 100% recommended
Highly recommend

Their cabin was the coolest experience I’ve ever had while lodging somewhere. My family and i loved every second of staying there! We will definitely look to come back and also recommend it to my friends and family. And the views were incredible!
They have a beautiful place.  We loved every moment of the trip.  We will definitely stay at one of their properties again.

Jen and Doug were very responsive leading up to our stay. They made sure we had clear instructions on how to get there. The place was beautiful, and the views for breathtaking! Absolutely enjoyed our stay here.
Jen and Doug’s place was a perfect mountain retreat! Truly emerged in nature and ability to enjoy the simple things. They were so communicative every part of our stay! Def hope to be back again!

We loved our experience on the mountain. It was incredibly peaceful and we both felt physically and mentally recharged after just a one night stay. The fact that the cabin is built into the rock and having a fire pit underneath was really awesome. The pictures do not even give the balcony view justice. Jen and Doug provide everything you need to be comfortable in the cabin. We came in summer so the battery powered fan was a nice touch we weren't expecting. We hiked up with our food/gear since we did not have 4WD but we found it to be a rewarding challenge before enjoying our time relaxing in the cabin. We would love to stay again sometime in a new season to see the difference!

We had an amazing stay at Raven Rock Cabin! The views are incredible and we were able to easily unplug from our busy lives.
Everything is exactly as advertised—the cabin is small and clean, there are just enough amenities for two people, there is a portapotty outside of the cabin and a hose next to it with cold water. As this is a “glamping” experience, you can expect bugs inside and out of the cabin. Although harmless, they made their way in even with the doors and windows shut. We just scooped them up and gently placed them outside.
Doug and Jen’s house is right at the bottom of the hill from the cabin, so you feel very safe but can also enjoy the private feeling that you are the only ones around. Doug and Jen were available as much or as little as we needed them to be, which was very convenient. They made sure to check in with us via message, and Jen came outside each time we pulled up to offer us a ride up to the cabin. The gravel road is very steep and rocky, so it was a huge help!
It was amazing to unwind in nature, sit out on the beautiful deck or around the fire pit and enjoy the wildlife. It’s very close to town if you find you need anything. It’s also close to Asheville if you want to do some shopping or sightseeing. Many great hikes in the area to enjoy as well.
We tried to fit in as much as we could during our 2-night stay, but it went by so quickly. Our only wish was that we could have had more time! We can’t wait to come back again and try out the new Treehouse. Highly recommend!

Great communication, easy check in, and very beautiful cabin, which was spotless and has a gorgeous view of the valley that the pictures online just do not do justice too.  Everything in the cabin was as described,  it got a little chilly one night and the wood stove was more than enough to warm up the cabin, we even had to open a window.    We planned to cook all our meals there and wished we had thought to bring a serving bowl for mixing up stuff like salad and few extra food storage containers and foil for the grill.   Sunset was amazing with a big fire going in the firepit, but we could hear traffic noise from trucks and motorcycles on the road below late into the evening.   We brought a batterymax thinking we might need to recharge lights, as we usually stay up late, but the lighting supplied from the battery pack at the cabin had plenty of charge even when it rained all day.   A very unique location and experience so close to sites, shopping and dining, it was hard to choose what do each day!

We loved our stay at the cabin.  The views are outstanding as is the hospitality of Doug & Jen.   The location is easy to find and super quiet. We had everything we needed and Doug checked in on us just in case.  The surrounding area is excellent, with breweries and fun hiking trails.  Still a few things on our list to come back and check off.  The dark skies at night and still and quiet of the area were exactly what we were looking for.  Look forward to returning!

This was our first time using Air BnB, and we were very impressed with how easy the process was thanks to Doug & Jen. They maintained constant communication throughout our stay and had very fast reply times. They also answered all of our questions before the trip, and gave a very detailed/organized list of what we should bring and the check in procedures. The cabin itself was clean, gorgeous and exactly as advertised through the pictures. The Porta Potty was super clean and had the cleaning schedule on the inside. They were also very accommodating to our two small dogs and had no problem with us bringing them.
If you do not have a 4 wheel drive car (we didn't), the hill can be a challenge after a day out and about. However, the walk up is definetly do-able if you aren't constantly leaving the cabin.
In summary, everything was great and Doug and Jen are great hosts! Can't wait to come back soon!

This was by far, one of the most amazing out of the way, closest to heaven places I have ever spent. It was exactly as described, breathtaking. Every part of the cabin was exactly as pictured, every detail Excellent. If you’re looking for the out-of-the-way rustic Grizzly Adams vs Little House on the Prairie? Then be are sure to find this hidden gem here. Amazing views, A sleepy little town below, all very peaceful and quiet. Very close to restaurants, shops, cafés, hospital/ER. Do you be careful where you step.
Doug and Jen have two other cabin/treehouse Airbnb‘s on top of the mountain, and ps... will need a 4 x 4. (signs are up where to park if you have a 2WD).
Had to cut my experience short by one night but I enjoyed my night at Raven Rock immensely.
Looking forward to many adventures here, and hopefully with the family next time.

A private, restful hideaway. safe, charming, a newly renovated 1 bedroom Guest House in the residential, Kentwood area of Westchester. Simple street parking. Walking distance to LMU, Supermarkets, and neighborhood amenities. 10-minute drive to LAX, Playa Del Rey Beach, and SOFI. Drive north on coast to MDR, Venice, Malibu. Open plan Living/Kitchen with all amenities. The living space opens onto private outdoor sitting area.
Outdoor view from bedrm. Shared eating area for 6/ barbecue.

The space
Private entrance to a newly renovated, light-filled one-bedroom retreat located at the rear of the property. Fully retractable doors open onto a peaceful private garden and sitting area, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor feel. An adjacent shared outdoor dining space with seating for 6+ and a gas BBQ is also available and can be made completely private upon request.

The space features light wood floors, wood-beamed ceilings, soft wool rugs, and serene wall colors designed for comfort and relaxation. Unwind on the cozy sofa or enjoy the large-screen TV with fast Wi-Fi and cable service.

The full bathroom includes a deep soaking tub, and the unit offers a generously sized closet, in-unit laundry, and air conditioning for warmer days.

The kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for meal preparation. The bedroom overlooks the private rear garden and features a queen-size Saatva mattress, comfortable cotton bedding, plush pillows, and a down-filled duvet for a restful night’s sleep.

A desk workspace is located in the bedroom, and the kitchen island also includes convenient power access if you prefer working there.

Guest access
Walking distance to LMU, local market. 5 min drive to Trader Joe's, CVS, TJmax, etc. 10-minute drive to LAX and Playa Del Rey beach. Close to SOFI. Restaurants are a 5-minute drive away. This is considered the West side of Los Angeles, coastal climate. Scenic walking trails nearby in Playa Vista wetlands nature preserve. Great area for bikes.
5 minutes to 405, 10 and 110 freeways.

Other things to note
A queen size inflatable mattress is provided at 25. with advance notice. I have boogie boards, a beach umbrella, towels, cooler. There is a small local golf course and tennis courts.

我們非常高興入住這間房子 真的是我住過最好的！房主會細心的給我們講解屋子裡面各個地方 真的很細心 最後離開的時候房主還給我們做了麵包！

This was by far one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever rented, and I’ve stayed in some great places. The photos didn’t do it justice. The home is stunning in person. Everything is state‑of‑the‑art, impeccably clean, and beautifully designed. The décor is sharp and modern, and the backyard truly feels like an oasis. It honestly looked like something straight off HGTV.

The home was stocked with everything we could possibly need and more. Annie even surprised us with warm chocolate‑chip banana‑nut bread, which tasted amazing with my morning coffee.

My only wish is that we could have stayed longer. We were only in LA for a day, but this rental would be perfect for a long‑term stay as well.

Top‑notch place and top‑notch host.
Thank you for allowing us to stay in your lovely home. If you can’t tell already, I highly recommend it.

Annie and Alex were very nice, suggested things and had everything you need in the kitchen, I have never been in a place were they have food in the fridge, her backyard is great and peaceful, room very clean and the bathroom very clean, the area is very nice and peaceful, close to Venice Beach, Santa Monica, and other places, would definitely come back to stay with Annie, lovely lady.
Very nice home! Area is peaceful and quiet. Great stay.

We had a lovely 3 day stay in Annie's guest house. The neighborhood is peaceful and convenient - walkable to both LMU and Von's. Annie and her son Alex are super friendly and welcoming yet respected our privacy as we came and went. The guest house itself is perfect for a couple. Loved the french doors out onto the patio, with a comfortable and welcoming outdoor space. The kitchen is perfect for making breakfast and lunch and the water pressure in the shower was excellent. The cheese plate upon arrival was so sweet and the yoghurt/bananas a welcome touch as well. This place is a great value and we will be back.

Annie’s place could not have been better situated for my needs. It took me no time to get to LAX, and my time to Disneyland and the Academy Museum was very reasonable. The space was comfortable. Annie communicated quickly and clearly. I would happily stay here again.

We were visiting our grandchildren .We needed a place to sleep as we spent all of our days at my son’s. This was perfect ;it was walking distance from his home.
There was a comfortable bed and bath. Kitchen was well equipped but we never used it.
This neighborhood is wonderful- residential, yet very close to restaurants and shops.
We would stay here again.

We really enjoyed this stay. Annie and her son were excellent hosts, responding immediately, answering questions, bringing water and towels. We really couldn't have asked for better hosts.
The cottage was perfect for our needs in every way. Located in a quiet lovely neighborhood it was close to every place we were visiting. The bed is a murphey bed that pulls down out of a cabinet and was super comfortable (and no big deal to pull down.) The cottage was equipped with everything we needed, the coffee was excellent, and we enjoyed sitting on the patio enjoying the California mornings drinking coffee. All in all it was one of our favorite AirBNB stays. Our vacation in LA was perfect and Annie and her cottage were a big part of why.

We had a wonderful time staying with Annie! We had to book last minute due to a last minute extension to our trip. Communication from the get go was great! Parking was easy to get in the neighborhood. Both Annie and her son Alex greeted us upon arrival. We even met their cat, Girl, who was such a sweetheart. Upon checking in, Annie showed us how to work the Murphy bed. We also had champagne and a cheese plate waiting for us. We had a fantastic time relaxing in Annie’s tranquil backyard all afternoon and a restful, quiet night of sleep. We enjoyed it so much that we booked another stay for end of January!

46593007.description_html:
Ascend the 50ft Raven Rock Treehouse amidst the pristine wilderness and immerse yourself in the truly radical off-grid therapy experience, allowing you to explore the scenic surroundings and escape from the everyday hustle and bustle.

Weddings available for an EXTRA CHARGE. See below.

Despite the feeling of complete seclusion, you'll be delighted to discover that everything you might need is conveniently close by.

✔ Comfy Queen Bed & Loveseat
✔ Outdoor Kitchenette/Dining
✔ Deck

The space
The Raven Rock Treehouse is a remarkable haven suspended 50 feet in the air, allowing you to immerse yourself in the beauty of the surrounding wilderness from a truly unique vantage point. To reach this lofty retreat, guests embark on a memorable journey up an extraordinary spiral wooden staircase, each step enhancing the sense of adventure and anticipation.

★ TREEHOUSE (BEDROOM, LIVING AREA, KITCHENETTE) ★
Once you ascend to this elevated oasis, you'll find a cozy and inviting interior that offers comfort and style amidst the treetops. The heart of the Treehouse features a plush and attractive sofa where you can relax and unwind, gazing out at the panoramic views of the forest. The queen-size bed promises restful
nights of slumber, allowing you to wake up to the gentle rustling of leaves and the serenade of local birds.

The Raven Rock Treehouse also boasts a lovely outdoor kitchenette and dining area, thoughtfully covered to shield you from the elements. Here, you'll find a propane stove and kettle, ensuring you can start the day with a hot cup of tea or coffee surrounded by the sights and sounds of nature, adding a touch of
magic to every meal and creating memories you won't soon forget.

✔ Comfortable Queen-Size Bed - BRING YOUR SHEETS AND BEDDING
✔ Cozy Sofa
✔ 5-Gallon Springwater Dispenser
✔ Mini Wood-Burning Stove
✔ Covered Outdoor Kitchenette (Propane Cooktop, Hot Water Kettle, French Press)
✔ Covered Outdoor Dining Bar with Seating for 2
✔ Access to the Deck

★ DECK ★
The true highlight of the Raven Rock Treehouse is the spacious deck, which beckons you to step outside and absorb the breathtaking views that stretch as far as the eye can see. This open-air retreat is the perfect spot to bask in the sun's warmth, read a good book, or enjoy the natural beauty surrounding you.

As the sun dips below the horizon, the deck also provides an ideal setting for stargazing, offering a front-row seat to the celestial wonders of the night sky.

✔ Lounge Seating Area with Adirondack Chairs

★ BATHROOM ★
The bathroom facilities at the Raven Rock Treehouse provide a unique blend of rustic charm and practical convenience, ensuring that your off-grid experience remains comfortable and hassle-free. Located just a short 50-foot stroll from the Treehouse, the clean and well-maintained Porta Potty offers a private and hygienic space for your essential needs. A camping bucket with a toilet seat is thoughtfully provided within the Treehouse for added nighttime convenience.

✔ Porta Potty (50ft from the Treehouse)
✔ Spring Water Shower (50ft from the Treehouse)
✔ Camping Bucket with a Toilet Seat (empty in the Porta Potty – rinse in the outdoor kitchen)

The Raven Rock Treehouse is more than just a place to stay; it's a sanctuary that invites you to embrace the harmony of nature while indulging in creature comforts. The carefully designed interior and the captivating outdoor spaces combine to create a unique and unforgettable off-grid experience 50ft above
the forest floor.

Guest access
The treehouse is exclusively yours, without interruption during your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home also comes with the following:

✔ Self Check-In (Keypad)
✔ 500watt Solar Generator
✔ Free Parking

Other things to note
★ OFF-THE-GRID SITE – ADDITIONAL INFO ★
Living off the grid, surrounded by a breathtaking natural environment, is a truly magical experience. However, there are some things you need to be aware of before you arrive at this dreamy haven.

☆ Electricity ☆
This site is off-grid and not connected to the electric grid. There is a solar-powered generator for cell phones and laptops. 5G is excellent, so you won’t have trouble checking your messages or texting your loved ones.

☆ Steep Access – 4 Wheel Drive Only ☆
Access is well maintained but too steep for 2-wheel drive. If you are coming with a 2-wheel drive car, you can park in the designated 2WD parking spot and hike for about 15 minutes until you reach the the treehouse.

☆ Kindling & Wood ☆
We supply a crate of kindling and precut wood for the mini wood stove in the cold winter months only.

☆ Wildlife ☆
Bears are extremely shy but hungry. Please store all the food. If you are an early riser and quieter, you may see bobcats, foxes, deer, turkeys, hawks, falcons, grouse, owls, and ravens.

☆ Linens &Bedding ☆
Bring your sheets and bedding for the queen mattress, which is hermetically sealed and disinfected for your protection.

★ ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATION ON THE PROPERTY ★
Traveling in a larger group, or your preferred dates are already taken? You'll be happy to know that we offer additional unique accommodation on the property. Please browse our host profile for the complete list of gorgeous listings.

★ WEDDING & EVENT VENUE ★
Our properties offer more than just a place to stay; they provide the perfect backdrop for unforgettable moments. For those seeking a picturesque setting for weddings, gatherings, and special events, we offer an enchanting venue that can be rented at an EXTRA CHARGE. Nestled amidst the beauty of nature, our event spaces ensure your celebrations are as unique as they are memorable. For event bookings, please inquire directly.

★ CLEANING & SANITATION ★
Health, safety, and well-being of our guests are of utmost importance. For this reason, we use a thorough cleaning process after each check-out.

★ NO PETS ALLOWED ★
We love pets. Sadly, the treehouse is not suitable to accommodate them and they are not covered by our insurance. Please see our other venues that are pet friendly.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in odor removal and furniture cleaning fees.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

Very dreamy. We certainly felt connected to nature. It rained while we were there. Looking outside and drinking coffee from the deck and watching wild turkeys and deer walk by…it’s like we were in a picture book.
They anticipated the needs of the guests and had whatever was necessary on hand with clear instructions, so there were no surprises, everything worked out beautifully.

This place was absolutely gorgeous and breathtaking, we had no issues with the location and the place itself. However, the place was absolutely infested with stink bugs. We were warned there “may be bugs” So we were completely prepared to deal with a few of them or even more, considering this is an off grid treehouse. We spent most of our time here killing bugs unfortunately. We booked two nights but didn’t feel comfortable, so we slept outside our first night on the chairs since there were less of them outside. Jen told us this isn’t normal so it may have just been bad luck, she tried to help however the bugs made their way back in after an hour or so. Hosts were accommodating refunded us for the night we didn’t stay. Jen was great and helpful, but it was an unfortunate experience for us.

Words cannot describe how beautiful and serine it was staying here. Karine was so accommodating and very responsive! I was truly blown away with how many amenities were provided. I will for sure be back the next time I stay in Arizona. Book it you won’t regret it!
My husband and I loved staying here. The little house was perfect, and the hosts were incredibly friendly. They even shipped an item we accidentally left behind, which we really appreciated.
The location is at a private residence but is completely separate from the main house with area in front for parking. Very private place with thoughtful amenities.
Fab location and casita. We felt so at peace and home here. The space is truly inviting and we wish we had a few more days to relax there. Would highly recommend!
We had a wonderful stay, everything was so lovely inside and out the home ! The surrounding area is beautiful and really lets you feel the Arizona desert vibes absolutely loved it !
What a peaceful and pristine place to unwind and relax.  Great views of the Southwest. We would love to come back again!
For a peaceful, private and relaxing experience, this  location is perfect.

Our stay was absolutely amazing! The place was spotless, beautifully set up, and had everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing visit. The host was incredibly kind, very welcoming and made the entire process seamless from check-in to check-out. The location was perfect, and everything looked exactly like the photos, if not better. We truly felt at home and would 100% stay here again. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great experience!

Had a wonderful stay at Karine’s place. I loved the picturesque surroundings. Perfect place for a solo traveler or couple. Had all the amenities I needed and easy access to many hiking spots (Tom’s Thumb is my favorite). The home was very comfortable as well. Karine’s instructions were clear and simple and I didn’t have any issues at all. She was very responsive during the whole process from booking to checkout. Would definitely stay again!

2nd time staying here at Karine’s! Beautifully landscaped yard and neighborhood, with Granite Mtn trail access right down the street! Gorgeous sunrises & sunsets from a private patio, with absolute comfort in a modern casita, with all the amenities. Scottsdale is a 10-15min drive, as well as McDowell Regional Park. Karine is a wonderful person, with gracious hospitality to accommodate her guests. Such a gem of a place, I will be returning!

Staying at Karine’s guest home is the perfect getaway, surrounded by stunning mountains. It’s great for those who want to see the natural beauty that Arizona has to offer. Parking and checking in/out are easy. It was great to return here after hiking trips and exploring the area. The place was stocked with coffee, tea, food and more. The outdoor patio was great for birdwatching and morning coffee. We definitely hope to come back again!

Karine’s casita was absolutely perfect for my boyfriend and I and Karine was an excellent host. She checked in and made sure we had everything that we needed but also gave us a lot of privacy during our stay. My boyfriend is a golfer and she helped with some local recommendations which was awesome. The casita was perfect for me to work remotely with strong Internet and the morning sunrise views cannot be beat. Loads of wildlife around their property which is beautifully landscaped. We would love to stay with Karine again!

Tucked inside a gated Cave Creek community of multimillion-dollar homes, this casita promises top-tier luxury—but delivers something closer to bare-bones functionality. It’s peaceful & private, with strong WiFi, a reliable stove and a gracious host. But the wear is hard to ignore. The mattress needs replacing, the IKEA couch/daybed is worn out, & the kitchen feels neglected, stocked with IKEA tableware, no sharp knives or proper cutting board.
Karine is warm and responsive—when I pointed out the missing toiletries (soap, shampoo), she brought them over right away. But details matter, & a top-tier listing shouldn't require this. Fingerprints on the windows, leftovers in the fridge (including a bottle of gin), and a general lack of polish make it clear this space isn’t maintained to the level it claims.
For travelers who value solitude & don’t mind driving 30 to 45 minutes anywhere, it’s a workable stay. But without some much-needed updates, it doesn’t live up to its “top 1%" billing.

53861695.description_html:
Centrally located French Place guest house in quiet neighborhood near downtown Austin, UT campus, new Moody Center and stadiums. Local ABIA bus to AUS airport. Private driveway, privacy fence, complete kitchen, washer & dryer, and many amenities. The living area is located on the second floor with a complete free laundry area on the first floor. We provide comfortable accommodations to support the well-being of our guests. Come stay with us for your business, events, or vacation accommodations.

The space
No side yard or alley entry the property supports a direct private driveway off the street with a privacy fence around the entire house and outdoor security cameras. The living quarters are located on the second floor with the front door pointing southerly. Located only a few minutes (0.65 miles) from the state-of-the-art Moody Center, St. David's hospital, HEB and Fiesta. Lots of restaurants within walking distance.

At the top of the stairs to the second-floor dwelling is a balcony which offers seating for your enjoyment. The living area has a king size bed for your comfort, a full kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, sofa, table/chairs, 9 ft. ceilings, dimmable lighting, porcelain bath area walls, and energy efficient appliances/fixtures/construction throughout. The property supports a ventilated recovery system for balanced ventilation and your well-being.

The living area has a 55-inch adjustable (proper mounting height) wall-mounted LED smart television for your enjoyment. There is also a 2nd 55-inch flat screen on the first floor. The property has high-speed Google 5 Gb internet for your business and entertainment needs. The laundry area has a private full-size heavy-duty washer/dryer with all the necessary amenities and a waiting area.

We are committed to rigorous cleaning procedures and your safety and comply with local and national ordinances. If you’re planning your next meeting, event, or vacation we can help make it enjoyable.

Guest access
Private driveway off 29th street for your car or safe city lighted parking on the street, pickup and delivery services available at the house. Close to bus stops or just take a taxi to downtown within minutes.

Other things to note
Keeping the comforts of home close to you, our facility heightens your enjoyment of the City of Austin, and we welcome longer stays. Walking distance to restaurants/coffee house/bars/convenience store, just a few blocks from UT campus and sports stadiums. Located in peaceful French Place, property is only about a mile from wonderful downtown Austin. House has (2) 55" Smart TV's.

reviews.comments: Had a short stay with the wife while we went to a concert, the place was very clean and easy to get into. Host responded promptly and even gave us a heads up on local construction going on nearby to save us some time. Great place and host!
Great location with all the essentials! I would definitely recommend this to anybody!

We had a great stay at Mark’s Airbnb. It’s in a great location, around a 30 minute drive from Austin airport, and there are lots of restaurants within walking distance. We went to Love Supreme for dinner and had a great pizza, so would recommend. The Airbnb had everything we needed, with water and sodas kindly left in the fridge for us, and the bed was really comfy. The perfect Airbnb after flying into Austin, would definitely recommend.

Great place.  Like a much better version of a hotel room, complete with full kitchen.  18 min walk from football stadium in a nice neighborhood.  Walking distance to many restaurants.  We will definitely stay here again.
Beautiful accommodations.  Close to the Moody Center & I 35.
Always my favorite place for an Austin visit.

I would definitely recommend staying at Mark’s place again! He was so responsive and very quick to help out in any way possible! It was exactly the place we were looking for to stay at in Austin. Will definitely be booking again!

Wonderful, small solo home just outside of Austin downtown (10 min drive to 6th street area). The accommodation has parking in front and laundry on the first floor. The room is a studio with a nice bathroom. Everything feels new and clean in the home. Wonderful porch deck on top to have dinner on and watch the lived in neighborhood. Feels safe and secure in the area. The host was very communicative, welcoming and answered all questions in a short period of time. Would recommend this place to anyone traveling to or through Austin.
Beautiful place, really cozy and nice
Great stay. Everything was clean and exactly as described. Would recommend and stay again.

The guest house is exactly what I was looking for when I travelled to Austin to move my son into UT.  It’s close the campus and quiet. The accommodations are clean and comfortable. I really liked the private driveway to park off the street. I plan to return when  I am back to visit my son.
We had a great stay, would definitely stay here again. Walking distance to restaurants and close to moody center.
We had a very pleasant and comfortable stay.  Great location, quiet and peaceful spot.  Would definitely book again.
Very comfortable and beautiful place to stay we highly recommend staying again .
Perfect for what we were looking for!
Great walking distance from the moody would book here in an instant for another event
Honestly best Airbnb ever would recommend
We had a great stay at Marks place. It was very clean, and in a safe, quiet neighborhood close to UT’s campus. Mark was very responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend for your visit to Austin.

I needed a place to stay for a couple of days that was fairly close to the University of Texas at Austin, and this was perfect.  The university was, of course, close; there were plenty of restaurants nearby; and Mark was an excellent and responsive host.  This has to be one of the best "little" places we have stayed.

The host goes above and beyond here. It’s got everything you need and the location has all of North and South Austin quickly accessible.
The bedsheets and towels all smelled so fresh and clean. The refrigerator had water and sodas. Plenty of coffee and tea.
The only AirbBnB to have enough hangers for everything I overpacked. Not far from a great international grocery store, Fiesta.
I will stay looking out for this place when I visit Austin again.

I loved this place! I recommend it to anyone visiting Austin. Be aware you do walk upstairs to get to the room. Everything was clean and the room was homey. There were complementary drinks like water, coca-cola, and sprite ready in the refrigerator. It was not hard to find extra towels and there were plenty of comfy pillow options to choose from. The neighborhood was friendly. The restaurants nearby like DaiDue was delicious. The location was excellent! I was able to get around to most of my destinations at a great time!

This was such a lovely stay from start to finish. The location was perfect, so easy to walk to a yummy coffee shop and wait till my check in, I was able to leave my bags in a secure spot. Mark was very communicative and helpful, and so nice. The house was clean and so precious. Every detail was looked at and made comfortable. If you are thinking about either staying at a hotel or an Airbnb, I highly recommend this place. You get a little kitchen with a refrigerator and an icemaker, and there’s even coffee that you can make in the morning and some snacks if you like. The bathrooms even had little soaps and shampoos if you need it…they even had poo-pourri, so that was 5 stars right there!
The bed was super comfortable, and the pillows made me sleep like a baby…which is rare for me. The neighborhood felt safe and I was able to take a little walk and enjoy all the Halloween decorations that were going up. Really a cute area. I have nothing bad to say about this place, I really hope to get the chance to stay there again one day, and explore Austin even more. Thank you for such a great stay, and making me feel comfortable and at home.

Mark was a great host and definitely gets ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️from me!!
I had a great solo stay at Mark’s studio-style Airbnb. It was exactly what I needed; simple, clean, and comfortable. The space was spotless, and Mark clearly takes pride in maintaining a welcoming environment. He even stocked the fridge with cold drinks, which was such a thoughtful touch after a long day of travel. I always love when hostesses pride themselves on a clean bathroom and clean kitchen and both were exceptionally clean, and the layout of the studio made it feel cozy yet functional. Check-in was super easy, and I had no issues at all. Mark was also incredibly responsive, which made the whole experience seamless. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, quiet, and well-kept place to stay.

Great accommodation.   Clean, quiet and easy walk to nearby restaurants and UT Grad housing.   Host is very attentive with appropriate amount of communication.   We will be back for another stay next time we are in Austin.  Thank you.

575323635538805522.description_html:
Walk to Barclays Center arena, Prospect Park, The Brooklyn Botanic Gardens and Brooklyn Museum, and dozens of restaurants. 4 subway lines are 2 blocks away, and its a 15 minute ride to Canal St. and lower Manhattan. The room is in a 125 year-old house in a charming historic neighborhood. This cozy, ground floor bedroom is approx. 100 sq. ft. The bed is full size. It adjoins a private, 20 sq. ft., bathroom. Guests control heat/air conditioning. The attached garden has seating areas.

The space
The house, and most of its furnishings and fixtures are late Victorian. The wood finishes are original and dark. Guests enter through a hallway with oak wainscoting and embossed wall paper then pass through a kitchen with antique fixtures to access the bedroom which is in an addition added to the house in 1910.

Guest access
The Garden room has virtually exclusive access to the garden.

reviews.comments: We had a great stay and really appreciated how flexible they were with our arrival and early exit due to the weather. Would come again.

Superb, period correct brownstone in an amazing location and very friendly hosts. Very comfortable and well appointed small room and private bath with lovely period tile. Highly recommend and great value!

The old brownstone has a welcome homey feel. One passes a warm, other era, still perfectly functional kitchen on the way to a pleasant bedroom, with (in my opinion) thoughtful art of the walls, an AC should you need it, a backyard patio seen out the window, but still a sense of privacy. A stone's throw from awesome Prospect Park and so many pubs, shops and restaurants. Highly recommend.
It was a short one night stay before the cruise. It was perfect for that. It was lovely to sit out in the garden. Very nice.

This is truly a hidden gem. Anne and Alaric are wonderful hosts, and deeply care about ensuring you have a great stay! We loved learning about their beautiful property, which is unique and a true privilege to stay in.
The house is a museum piece restored to Victorian beauty. Ask for a tour!!
This location was perfect! Loved the beauty of the property as well. Strongly recommend.

Alaric und Anne waren tolle Gastgeber, die ihre Gegend genau kennen. Alles war ausgezeichnet. Das Haus ist bezaubernd restauriert. Das Zimmer und das Bad sind zwar klein, aber sehr schön. Außerdem steht der Garten zur Verfügung. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder. Vielen lieben Dank!

Such a wonderful experience with wonderful hosts that I would highly recommend this historic hoist to all my friends. I’m visiting from Montana and omg the details and atmosphere is so cool. Aleric and Anne are just amazing people.

Anne and Alaric were lovely, communicative hosts, and their space was perfect for my needs as a solo traveler. The bedroom was small but very comfortable, the bed was great, and the space was very private. Access to the garden was a delightful plus! The historic home is in an incredible area, close to everything you might need and with easy access to Manhattan. I would definitely stay here again.

Soggiornare nell'alloggio di Alaric e Anna è stata un'esperienza unica e fuori dal comune. La casa, un'abitazione storica di rara eleganza, è immersa in uno dei quartieri più caratteristici di Brooklyn, rivelandosi tra l'altro una base ideale per ogni spostamento. Alaric e Anna si sono dimostrati veramente gentili, presenti. Una scelta che consiglio a chiunque cerchi qualcosa di speciale.
Great stay!

This room was nice for a one night stay! The neighborhood is fantastic and the hosts are very chatty and friendly. The room and bathroom are small but functional and the backyard is lovely. Comfy and not too soft bed.
We has a very nice stay at Alaric and Ann's spot. Everything with very clean and it was such a great neighborhood to explore Brooklyn. Ann and Alaric both gave good knowledge and suggestions.
Super friendly host in a beautiful home
great place in a great neighborhood, would book again in the future for sure
Beautiful house and room, we learned a lot from Alaric and Anne about the house and the neighborhood and really enjoyed talking to them.
Small room in the back of a very old building. Charming. Very nice host, Anne is. Great location.

Loved our stay at Alaric's place! Alaric and Anne are wonderful hosts, very communicative and helpful. The room and the backyard are beautiful, we only wish we could spend more time there. Alaric showed us around their house, and we had a wonderful conversation about the history of the house, the neighborhood and the city! They also shared many personal recommendations which helped us explore the neighborhood. It's a perfect stay for 2 people, close to the subway, and lots of restaurants within walking distance. We will be back for future stays!

This is a great place with a wonderful host. Alaric goes out of his way to be available to check-in, check-out, show you his wonderfully restored historic home, spend time telling you about the neighborhood and pointing me in the right direction for where I was going. He even walked me down the street to show me where the subway station was located.
I loved my private room and bath that was right off the outside garden and the lovingly restored brownstone. It was comfortable, clean and efficiently functional. So interesting inside with late 19th century and early 20th century details throughout. Great outdoor garden in the back too.
Alaric made tea for me each morning and he's so interesting and personable to spend time chatting with. Love his two large Maine Coon cats too. I parked for free on the same block all weekend. I would definitely stay here again. Great experience.

What a treat! This place was such a gem, quiet, cozy, and full of fascinating character. The room itself was really comfortable, quiet and had everything we needed, including a private bathroom and our own AC controls. The garden was a lovely bonus. Waking up to the sound of birds outside our window was the perfect start to the day! The location couldn't be better — an easy walk to everything, including the subway. Alaric and Anne were extra gracious and flexible with our check-in and check-out, and we’re so grateful for their kindness. I also loved hearing about the history of their beautiful space and all the interesting little details. We felt totally at home and would definitely stay again.

This was a perfect Airbnb for my wife and I.  The accommodations were clean and comfortable and the location was in a beautiful neighborhood right near Prospect Park and literally just steps from multiple subway stations.  Most of all, the hosts were extremely accessible, friendly, helpful and flexible!   We would definitely book with this host again in the future!

Absolutely loved our stay in this wonderfully cozy and comfortable bedroom located in a stunning brownstone. Hosts Alaric and Anne were fantastic-- warm and friendly, prompt with their replies and excellent neighborhood recommendations to boot. Got a solid night of sleep in a super comfortable bed (with quality linens) and thoroughly enjoyed morning coffee in a lovely and lush garden just outside our door. The period details of the place are worth mentioning too-- incredibly special and you can just tell Alaric and Anne have put a lot of love in restoring the place. The location is also a major plus-- a gorgeous old street lined with brownstones and close to so much. All in all, this place is real gem. Cannot wait to stay here again!

Very unique place with private room and bathroom on lower floor overlooking an amazing garden with seating areas and a path right outside your bedroom window. You forget you’re in the city! Citibike bike share station within a couple blocks with lots of walkable restaurants, bars, and parks. Hosts are extremely gracious and I really enjoyed having morning coffee and great conversation with them. Bonus that they had secure indoor bicycle storage as I had just finished riding the Empire rail trail from Albany. Already planning my next visit!!!!  Fantastic stay!

607789673878508156.description_html:
Explore the city from a sunny, one bedroom apartment and plant-lover’s dream located in Central Austin’s historic Hyde Park neighborhood. Walk tree-lined streets to popular restaurants, parks, and coffee shops. A 10-15 minute stroll gets you to UT, while the Texas Capital, 6th street, ACL, SXSW venues, and much more are easily accessed by bike, scooter, rideshare, and Capital Metro.

For stays of 30 days or more, I offer a 20% discount-- if interested, please send an inquiry for your dates.

The space
Please be aware, this unit is below another AirBnB listing. If you are *particularly* sensitive to sound, this may not be the space for you. However, if you have lived with upstairs neighbors, this shouldn't be different. The upstairs renters have been asked to be mindful of downstairs guests. Earplugs are provided among the toiletries, should the need arise.

This listing consists of a small bedroom, a larger room divided into living space/kitchenette/dining area/workspace, and a wetroom style bathroom. Be sure you've checked out the bathroom photos-- it's a little non-traditional.

Parking is free and on-street. There is generally space directly in front of the property, but all parking is first come, first served. That said, the options are ample.

Guest access
Additionally, guests will enjoy a private gated patio and access to the outdoor lounge area/firepit shared with the upstairs unit.

Guests are also welcome to take advantage of the open air workout facility, equipped with a pull-up rig/squat rack, barbell and plates, kettlebells, and more.

Other things to note
No outlandish check-out instructions! I'll take care of everything when I turn the space over. Just enjoy yourself and respect the space; I'll handle the trash :)

Enjoy everything Asheville has to offer! Blue Ridge Parkway three minutes away. 10 minutes to Biltmore estate, downtown Asheville, and incredible restaurants breweries and shopping.
Our three bedroom, the three bathroom cottage is completely furnished with all the amenities to enjoy a comfortable getaway. ￼

The space
There are a few steps down to the sidewalk to the house. The main level has a living room, kitchen, dining area, 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths. Downstairs in the basement area is a desk area that looks out over the mountains and the 3rd bedroom and 3rd full bathroom. It is the only bedroom with a smart tv. This room is generally always cooler.
Enjoy the large partially covered deck with ample seating and dining table overlooking the mountain views and wildlife ( bears, deer, coyotes) that wander through. You may occasionally get a visit from our Bernese Mountain Dog, Chief who is constantly on bear patrol!

Guest access
The entire house and yard are available for our guests enjoyment.

Other things to note
Uber and Lyft services the Oak and Ivey Cottage

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: We stayed at Becky's for our annual mom's weekend away, and it was our very favorite. From the comfortable outdoor seating options and the view, to the well-outfitted kitchen (even sharp knives!), and the comfortable beds with lux linens, this was a truly beautiful, restorative place to stay. Bonus for bear sighting!

Becky was an outstanding host. The house was perfect and just as advertised. It was tastefully decorated and the linens were luxurious. Becky was very responsive and made us feel right at home. This was probably one of the best Airbnb’s we have ever rented and I have already recommended it to friends.
The place was immaculate.  The views were the best part, absolutely stunning. Home was cozy and comfortable.  Highly recommend!

We loved our stay at Becky’s place . Becky was very helpful with local recommendations for places to eat. The house was gorgeous with 3 large bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Loved the outdoor deck area.
We also enjoyed the area the house was located I - easy access to main roads and local restaurants.
This was one of the best places we have stayed at and will stay here again in the future

Becky’s place was amazing and the perfect spot for a girls weekend in Asheville!! It was very close to downtown and accessible to the nearby hikes. The view is really the showstopper, and the outdoor areas are perfect for gathering and relaxing. The house was very nice, clean, and well decorated. Can’t find a better place to stay than this!!

This was the coziest house!!! We came to Asheville for a long weekend trip and this was the most perfect little house! It's so cute and cozy and spotless! The views from the back deck are absolutely amazing! The location was wonderful- close enough to go and do anything we wanted but quiet and peaceful once we got back!!! We can't wait to visit again!!!

Beautiful home surrounded by scenic views and wildlife! Becky is a very responsive communicator, bed comfort and linens were exceptional. You can’t avoid the peace and relaxation this home’s deck will provide every day! We loved everything with our stay.
Beautiful home, well furnished, even items for fire pit.  Was a wonderful place to come home after a day of exploring.

Thanks for sharing your home with us
The views from both inside and outside the house were amazing

Becky is such a nice and hilarious person! I enjoyed her hospitality. She even communicated when and where we could see some of the local wildlife passing through the property. The view is amazing, the pictures don’t do it justice. Can’t imagine staying anywhere else in Asheville anymore. It’s private, cozy and she provided everything you could possibly need while vacationing!
I highly recommend!

We had a wonderful 4-night stay at Oak and Ivey Cottage. The place is beautifully furnished, spotlessly clean, and shows a real eye for detail. It’s easy to see why so many guests rave about the porch. We spent our mornings out there with coffee (a lovely touch that it’s provided!) taking in the view, and despite feeling tucked away and peaceful, we were still close to everything Asheville has to offer. Highly recommend for anyone wanting a relaxing, secluded home base near Asheville.
we had an awesome time while there. she took care of alot of details which was awesome.
What a beautiful and clean place to stay!  Becky was an amazing host!

Welcoming and easy check-in with clear instructions. The house was clean and well appointed. The standout was the peaceful surroundings and deck. So worth the visit!
Thank you Becky!

Our family of four enjoyed our stay at Becky's home. The beds were comfortable, the house was clean and the kitchen was well stocked. We enjoyed hiking and exploring downtown Asheville but also enjoyed hanging out and enjoying the patio and the mountain views.

This is a special place. Quiet, peaceful, and simple. The view is outstanding and inspiring. I already rebooked for same time next year. The house has everything one needs and nothing one doesn’t. Thank you!
We will definitely stay at Becky’s when we go back to Asheville!

Becky’s home was the perfect place to introduce our visiting family to western NC. It easily accommodated six adults, especially with the amazing back porch and its comfy seating and long-range Mountain Views. We spent most evenings watching the sunset from that porch and even spotted a mama bear with her cub in the meadow below,
We loved that the home was peaceful and private yet only five minutes to a grocery store and the Blue Ridge Parkway. It was also an easy drive to downtown and Biltmore.
Becky was a responsive host, who made our stay a joy,

Becky was a lovely host, with a beautiful house. The interior and exterior were both beautifully maintained. We felt so peaceful and relaxed, and enjoyed the privacy the spot provided, while also enjoying the convenience of downtown Asheville being only a 15 minute drive away. We would definitely come back again!

Possibly our favorite Airbnb ever. We stayed here with our family and everyone was very comfortable. The Airbnb was incredibly well appointed, which made cooking our “Thanksgiving” meal very easy. It had all the important things like comfortable beds, clean linens, enough seating for everyone in common spaces, and all the wish list items too, like beautiful views, lovely outdoor spaces, an indoor fireplace AND an outdoor fire pit with firewood provided (!), incredibly convenient to both the blue ridge parkway and downtown, washer/dryer… I could go on and on. An amazing stay and we really hope to be back!

We celebrated my husband’s 60th with two other couples. Becky’s home was absolutely perfect. The enormous back deck and mountain views are incredible. Our visit was on a cold January weekend, so our only regret was not being able to enjoy this feature more. But we thoroughly enjoyed the cozy yet spacious living room and easy to use fireplace for hours of game playing! The layout was great, too, with three king sized bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. In addition, we were a short drive to downtown for shopping and evenings out. Becky was super easy to communicate with and very hospitable - she stocked us up with plenty of coffee, tea, creamers and even a beautiful pound cake to enjoy! I highly recommend this marvelous home and hope to return!

We had a wonderful stay! It was perfect for our family of 4, although large enough for more guests. The home is exactly as pictured, well appointed, and pristine. There is no doubt a lot of love, thought, and care goes into making this home special. We felt cozy and comfortable. Loved having the deck to enjoy the beautiful view and peaceful environment. We even saw a family of bears down the street which was such a treat for us Marylanders! The location was perfect- very convenient to all of Asheville. We found so many fun activities within a 15 minute drive. Should we ever return to Asheville, and I’m sure we will, we won’t hesitate to stay here again.

There were three couples on our trip.  Becky‘s place was perfect with king size beds, and bathrooms for each room. The fire pit, the back deck, and the fireplace inside were wonderful.   The beds were so comfortable. We all slept great.  Every area of the house was spotless   Very convenient for The Builtmore or downtown Asheville.   The Mountain View’s were amazing in the mornings with coffee.   We wish we could’ve stayed longer   I cannot recommend enough staying with Becky.   If we ever go back to the area, we certainly will.   Thank you, Becky.

Our stay at Becky's beautiful cottage was nothing short of exceptional! It's rare to find a home that so perfectly combines an ideal location and serene atmosphere. The location couldn't have been more perfect, offering the ideal balance of being close to downtown for exploring and just a quick hop onto the Blue Ridge Parkway for scenic drives and waterfall hikes.
The deck is an optimum place to enjoy morning coffee and a book while listening to the birds or a family dinner while admiring the view. The entire house is immaculate and spacious. The kitchen is well equipped and all 3 bedrooms had quality beds and linens. If you're looking for a tranquil, convenient, and incredibly comfortable base for your Asheville adventures, this is it!

Located in the heart of Old Town-walk to restaurants, bars, mall. Run on the canal or fish at the park. Relax on front or back patios, bbq, firepit, and swim in the heated backyard pool. En suite bathrooms, spacious closets, and two outdoor showers off bedrooms. French doors throughout, an inviting gas fireplace, and fully stocked kitchen and laundry. Three dedicated parking spaces. Close to all valley attractions-spring training, hiking, kayaking, football, zoo, Tempe Town Lake and more!

The space
Our relaxing home includes a huge island in the open kitchen/family room for all to gather around--eat, drink, and play games. Each bedroom and the back patio has a television with cable or streaming. Play cornhole, shoot some baskets in the pool, and dine outside on the large patio table that seats 6-8. Air mattress and comfy couch in the family room for extra guests. Additional $40/day fee to heat the pool.

Guest access
A code for the front door will be provided prior to check in.

Other things to note
Self entry with a keyless code.
