reviews.comments:
David was a responsive host whose home was very comfortable, clean and very well-stocked with coffee pods, water and toiletries.
We appreciated the extra touches and excellent location of the home to everything Old Town has to offer.

This AirBNB was the best place we could have picked to stay for my friend’s bachelorette. The home was clean, had everything we needed, very walkable to all the restaurants around, and the pool was a nice addition for when we needed a day to relax! David was the perfect host, too. He let us check in early as our flight from Oklahoma landed at 9:30 am and he made sure we had all the info we needed for the home! Very communicative and helpful. I definitely would recommend booking this AirBNB for your trip to Scottsdale.
David was extremely kind and responsive during our stay. He was nothing short of great, and the house was beautiful.
Amazing stay in Old Scottsdale. Home is lovely, well stocked and had a perfect 2 week stay.   I would rent again!  Love this place.

This was the perfect setup for exactly what we needed. Each morning, my wife and I rode the bikes David provided through the beautiful historic neighborhood to the canal, went for a run, and then came back for a relaxing swim in the pool. We absolutely loved our stay and plan to make this our regular Scottsdale getaway.

Our stay was incredibly enjoyable. The house is beautiful and well appointed. And the backyard - well it was the icing on the cake. We swam in the spacious, refreshing pool each day and enjoyed eating outside in the early morning and evening. David was a very responsive and gracious host. I highly recommend this place!
We loved the pool and location.  Very cozy and comfortable home.
The house was beautiful! Host was super communicative and helpful.

I strongly recommend staying here. In the best location close to all the bars and restaurants of old town. Big comfortable space with lots of room. Back yard was perfect with a great pool, sitting areas, and outdoor TV
One of the best Airbnb’s we’ve stayed at.  Very nicely furnished, clean and quiet.  Would stay there again!

We loved staying here!
The beds were the most comfortable of any AirBnb I’ve ever stayed at and our whole group agreed. The pool was lovely and pool towels were provided, along with a variety of floats, umbrellas and seating around the patio. We used the pool a lot since it was 100+° outside during the day. The indoor living area was spacious and welcoming and we spent a lot of family time here. The kitchen was well equipped with everything we needed to make breakfast inside and take a nice break from the heat. Each bedroom has its own bathroom and closet which was really amazing.
In regard to the neighborhood:
It was June so too hot to walk, but otherwise would have been VERY walkable if the weather was cooler. Either way, everything was only about a 3-5 minute drive. We went out for dinners and ice cream every night since there were so many great options nearby. The vicinity is close to a lot of nightclubs and bars but the neighborhood was very quiet at night.
Highly recommend
Out of all of the Airbnb's I've stayed in this was the by far the best stocked house.

We had an amazing stay at David’s Airbnb in Scottsdale! The home had absolutely everything we needed for a perfect long weekend — clean, comfortable, well-stocked, and thoughtfully set up. The location was fantastic too, with so many great restaurants, shopping, and things to do just minutes away. David was a wonderful host and made the entire experience easy and stress-free. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Scottsdale!
Great hosts, very lovely area. Even during stay would reach out if any help was needed and would help with any and everything, very fun area and would recommend

This home is beautiful and was perfect for our needs. Home is exactly as pictured in photos. Outdoor space as very comfortable and peaceful. Indoor space is stocked with everything you could possibly need. Rooms are clean and very comfortable. David reached out to make sure all was going well and to make sure the pool temperature was what we were hoping for. We would definitely stay here again if in Scottsdale!!

Had a wonderful stay at this property with two colleagues for a work trip to Scottsdale. The location was unbeatable — we were close to everything we needed, which made getting around a breeze. The home itself was beautiful, comfortable, and had everything you could ask for. It was the perfect setup for a group stay, with plenty of space for everyone to relax after long days. Would absolutely recommend to anyone visiting the area and would love to stay again!

David was absolutely incredible! Such a great host! He truly cares if you have a great experience and goes above and beyond! Highly highly recommend! The place is the perfect location and is walking distance to old town with lots to do! The home is just as pictured and such a spacious environment.
This was a great space for our family. Nice open kitchen and family room. Pool was great! Neighborhood was nice and 4 minutes from some great restaurants and shopping. Would stay again.
The backyard and pool are a highlight of the house.  The pool was very clean and, at our request, heated.  Flowering vines added lushness to the yard.

Great stay.   David’s place was very nice, well stocked from kitchen, to bathrooms, to pool area and perfectly located very close to Old Town.   Less than 5 minute walk. David was super friendly, flexible and responsive.   Would definitely stay again.

David’s house in Scottsdale was the perfect place to stay for our annual Spring Training trip. The house and yard were very clean and well maintained. David was more than accommodating with our early flight into PHX and let us do a bag drop and early check-in once the previous guests had checked out.
The courtyard in front and pool in the back were the perfect places to congregate for a morning cup of coffee or an evening cocktail. The beds are very comfortable and the neighborhood was quiet and friendly. Easy walking distance to Old Town and Scottsdale Stadium.
We couldn’t have been happier with everything and we will absolutely stay here again.

Great location. Walking distance to old town, restaurants, convenience stores, etc. The place itself was clean if a bit dated. And the pool isn’t heated and that costs extra which is a bummer because I don’t recall seeing that when I booked. Host is communicative and there’s good value here relative to the area. It’s just not a knockout in terms of overall aesthetics and comfort.

Had a great stay for my bachelorette!
It is noteworthy that the master bed room actually has a juliet closet shared via sliding partition with the guest room that has the twin beds. The two rooms share the wall the beds are pushed against, and it was easy to hear conversation from the other room. No biggie for a girls trip but something to consider for a family trip.
Full range of kitchenware and much of the basic seasonings and cooking extra needed to prepare a meal was a huge plus!
I would definitely stay again.

Beautiful private home, walking distance to Old Town & Fashion Square. Spotless with gorgeous decor. So bright with many windows. Three bedrooms, all with doors leading outside. 2 En Suites with another bath right outside the 3rd bedroom. The backyard has a beautiful, sparkling pool with many pool toys! There is both sun and shade areas with plenty of seating including two table areas.  The TV on a roll-around cart is really nice!!!  As are all the indoor TVs with streaming services. Anything you could possibly need is included… shampoo, conditioner and bath gel in all 3 bathrooms plus the 2 outdoor showers! All the paper towels, toilet paper, Kleenex etc is included. Fully stocked kitchen including many spices! David has the thickest bath towels that would equal any 5-Star resort!  His communication is excellent and is so easy responding to requests. He will work as hard as he can to get an earlier check-in if possible. We highly recommend him as your host and his beautiful home!

Logement très agréable dans un quartier paisible à 7 minutes à pied du métro donc très pratique pour visiter Manhattan.

The host is incredibly warm, welcoming, and patient. If I visit New York again, I will definitely choose to stay here. Thanks again! :)
Es el lugar más tranquilo y cómodo en el que me he hospedado, dormí de maravilla. Hay muchos restaurantes alrededor y está muy cerca del metro. El anfitrión es increíblemente amable, cálido y paciente. Si vuelvo a Nueva York, sin duda elegiré este lugar otra vez. ¡Muchas gracias de nuevo! :)
是我住过最安静，睡眠最舒服的地方，这里周围很多餐厅，离地铁很近，房东人非常热情，耐心，如果我再次来纽约应该依然选择这个地方，再次谢谢：）
Jennifer was so accommodating and welcoming for our first trip to NYC!!! We all highly recommend staying with her!!

This place was great! So adorable and not from the subway. we really enjoyed our stay and it worked perfectly for our trip to New York. It was a great a place to come back to after some very long and exhausting days.

Jennifer's place was great value for money in a place like New York City. The nearest metro station was a 5 minute walk and there were plenty of convenience stores and restaurants in the area. All in all, we had a very comfortable stay.  The only thing to bear in mind is that if one is carrying a lot of heavy luggage (as in our case since we were on a very long tour of the USA), be prepared to carry it up a flight of narrow stairs to the second floor.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l’appartement de Jennifer. Le logement est idéalement situé, à seulement 3 minutes à pied du métro, ce qui permet de se déplacer facilement dans New York. L’appartement est très joliment décoré, fonctionnel et parfaitement équipé. Tout était conforme à la description et nous n’avons manqué de rien. Vraiment, tout était parfait du début à la fin. Nous recommandons ce logement sans hésitation et y reviendrions avec plaisir. Merci Jennifer pour votre accueil ! 🌸🌸🌸

This was a convenient location for our family of four’s itinerary of Queens and Manhattan events. Hosts were responsive and helpful at all turns. We hope to return to NYC one day and would love to stay here again.

One of the best Airbnb stays ever! We felt at home the minute we walked in the door. We loved Astoria, and Jennifer‘s recommendations of local places to eat. Access to Manhattan was so easy with the subway close by, and coming home to this peaceful oasis at the end of a busy day was perfect. The beds were very comfortable. The AC/fan was quiet and very effective. Everything was very clean. The couch was very comfortable. Jennifer was friendly and responsive and communication was fast and easy. A really wonderful visit and we hope to be back!

Heel fijn verblijf, na drukke dag in the City kom je lekker rustig ‘thuis’ in Astoria.
Metro-trein dichtbij en hele goede restaurants en supermarkten in de buurt.
Very warm and welcoming space in Astoria. So close to a metro station and so getting around is so easy. Furnite was also super comfortable. Overall, such a great stay.

Io e i miei 2 figli siamo stati a casa di Jennifer per una settimana, dopo il caos di Manhattan ( incredibile!)è stato molto piacevole tornare nella bella e tranquilla Astoria. La casa è tipica, molto carina con tutte le comodità, lavatrice , asciugatrice, metro vicina: gran valore aggiunto.! Molto gentile Jennifer e sempre pronta a rispondere, gran bella vacanza anche grazie a questo alloggio

We loved Jennifer's space.  The apartment is more charming and spacious in person. Fresh towels, linens, and a plethora of coffee was exactly what we needed after a late night arrival.  The size was perfect for our family of 3 and could have comfortably fit another person or 2.   Jennifer was easy to reach and answered all of my questions.  When a snow storm rolled in on our departure day, they offered us a late checkout and were happy to extend our reservation if our flight was canceled.  We were bummed when our flight departed on time as we would have loved to stay another night.  While we didn't want to leave, we look forward to returning to their delightful abode.

Our flights were canceled and I had to drive 650 miles from Cincinnati to Queens, so we ended up having a late check-in. Jennifer understood and genuinely was worried for us. She met us at the door to greet us and made us feel welcomed when we finally arrived. That was awesome and much appreciated. She gave us a bottle of wine to help us relax from our 12 hour drive. She located a parking garage for me to park my truck for the week. The place was excellent. Just what we were looking for. The location to great food and the subway to access the city was spectacular. I really enjoyed and liked Queens,  Astoria. I highly recommend staying here. You will have a great host and location to see New York. We will be back and staying here again.

What a treat staying at Jennifer’s place! We loved it!  We couldn’t have had a better location in NYC - so close to subway and tons of great restaurants. Really quiet given location. Apartment was great - Beds and pillows were super comfy - everything was perfect! Above all - Jen was an excellent host! She took extra care to make sure that everyone in our group had access to get in and had what they needed. (We got in at different times). And she was super supportive of us running the marathon- very sweet. The actions she took showed how kind she is - and showed how cool New Yorkers are! Thank you so much, Jen and Grace! We will be back!

We had a wonderful stay at the apartment of Jennifer and Grace! The place was clean, cosy and had everything you might need. It’s close to subway station Broadway and takes you right into the center of Manhattan, super easy!
The neighbourhood of Astoria was fine, a lot of stores and restaurants nearby.
Contact with Grace and Jennifer was great, they responded quick and were very helpful. We didn’t see them, so the contact was only online.
Overall a very nice stay!

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at Jennifer’s place.  It is cute, cozy, and close to everything.  The subway line is only a 5 min walk and there are so many amazing places to eat on every corner. Once again NYC was an amazing trip. We caught a Broadway show, went to the MoMa, did some shopping,  sightseeing, and got to eat at a Michelin star restaurant.  We will be back for sure!

Son appartement est magnifique. On y trouve tout se qu’il faut même bien plus . Si vous cherchez ou loger je vous la conseille les yeux fermés à 300% . Les parties communes sont bien utiles pour un petit déj ou un dîner rapide. Beaucoup de supermarché ou restaurant rapide à moins d'un km.

Estancia maravillosa, un 10 rotundo. Nos encantó todo de este lugar. La comodidad del alojamiento es de primer nivel; las camas, la limpieza y los detalles de la habitación nos garantizó un descanso perfecto. La ubicación es muy buena, lo que nos permitió movernos con muchísima facilidad, ya que hay paradas de buses muy cerca, a solo unas cuadras. La hospitalidad de Pia, su amabilidad y excelente atención desde el primer momento nos hicieron sentir como en casa. Siempre atenta a nuestras necesidades y con las mejores recomendaciones locales. La verdad que fue un hospedaje de 10 puntos. Volveremos!!!
Very sweet host!

Piedad was an amazing host! She was incredibly welcoming and did everything to make us as comfortable as possible from the second we arrived all the way until we said goodbye. Will absolutely be staying with her again the next time I am in the city!
Am gladly to be hosted by Piedad in nyc , she is a very kind, simple ,clean ,empathetic person. She made my stay wonderful. And the location it’s really good easy for transport to manhattan.☺️

Piedad's place is where you'll say "I wish I can stay some more days". We enjoyed being there. So much to do around. It's just the perfect place to stay plus she's super helpful with everything you have questions about ❤️ Thank you so much and I hope you can be our host again in the future!

My friend and I stayed here for 4 days and it was perfect! A very great pick and we felt especially lucky since it was our first time visiting New York. It’s in a quiet and peaceful area and had a bus stop just a few minutes away which made getting around the city a lot easier! Our host was very friendly and helpful and gave us tips on how to get around on the subway. Her and her family were extremely accommodating. My friend and I both felt very safe and comfortable. Would definitely recommend!
Ottima location, casa veramente accogliente, molto curata nei dettagli, io e mio figlio siamo stati molto bene li, ci ritornerei volentieri!!
Nice spot!

The place was very clean and offered free, secure parking inside the premises, which is a huge advantage in New York City. The kitchen was fully functional, and the bedroom had everything you could possibly think of or need for a comfortable stay.
The room was a little small, but that is understandable for NYC and not something to complain about. The main downside was the location. Anyone relying on public transit should plan for significant travel time—potentially an extra two hours, depending on where they are going. There also were not many things to do in the immediate area.
The host was amazing, welcoming, and clearly passionate about hosting. As a Superhost myself from Toronto, I truly appreciated the care, attention to detail, and effort they put into the guest experience.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Astoria, NY. Everything was spotless, clean, and exactly as described. The host was very kind, welcoming, and responsive, making the whole experience easy and comfortable. The apartment had everything we needed, and the location was great for exploring the area and getting around the city. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting New York!
We enjoyed our time sooooo much! The host was sweet and responsive. Loved this Airbnb! Thank you so much for a wonderful time 😁

Our hist was there when we arrived and was so kind to show us around and let us know not only about our space but the easiest and best ways to get around the city. Honestly they were lifesavers when it came to tips on where to go and how. We will be back!

Super comfortable bed and room. Bathroom shared with one other room. (No one in that room when I stayed). Room was cozy for two. There’s another room across the hall- and there’s also shared common space down the hall with comfy chairs and a tv.
Great place especially if you are okay walking 20 mins to M/F train, 30 mins to E train, or taking buses from just outside the apt. (Lyft will also take you to the subway for about $7-$12).
Loved walking over the nearby bridge to Roosevelt Island! A new experience for us.
Piedad collects New York memorabilia so the place has a sweet iconic feel my daughter enjoyed. It was pouring when we arrived and Pía even offered us ponchos/gear!
Cafe 9 down the block was lovely to hang out in and had great coffee and snacks- esp enjoyed the guava pastry.
Great location with many options to get into the city. Very clean, accurate description and instructions, and friendly host. Would definitely recommend and will probably stay here again.
Her şey çok güzel ve beklediğimizden iyiydi

Piedad was extremely accommodating and kind. the space is gorgeous and clean. easy check in and check out. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others. nice neighborhood, Manhattan is close by. overall ideal space.

Our stay was absolutely wonderful! The place was very clean, beautiful, and well-organized. The host was friendly and welcoming, which made us feel right at home. The location was perfect — only a few minutes away from the subway station with two convenient options nearby. The neighborhood was quiet, peaceful, and felt very safe to walk around at night. Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable stay. If we ever come back to New York, we would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay in Pia's place. She was a lovely host and went above and beyond with complimentary items. Everything was better than expected. The room was spacious, the bed was amazing and allowed us to sleep with our feet up after long days with lots of walking. The laundry was a great addition that really came in handy. We were in close proximity to a bus station that took you right to the subway and you could walk through the neighborhood, even late at night. You could also hire bikes right around the corner. A short bus ride (or even a jog) to Roosevelt Island was an unexpected bonus and a highlight of our trip. We would love to return and really enjoyed our stay.

We had a fantastic stay at Pia's place. The room had a nice view of the city, as in the pictures. We found on-street parking a bit tight but still available. The shared space, including living room, kitchen, and bathroom, all well-maintained and spotless. We also appreciated the free drinks in the fridge after a long day of exploring the city! The walk to the F train is about 20 mins, although if you're lucky, you can get a bus there. Overall, a great experience, and would love to come back in the future.

Highly highly recommend! Pia is probably the nicest and most hospitable host I’ve ever had at any airbnb - she went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable, even giving us rain jackets when it was raining and helping us carry our bags down the stairs. It is a private but spacious room in an apartment with 2 other rooms. Everything was cozy and clean and well-equipped! Location wise it’s quite near Manhattan, with the F train a 17 minute walk away. Although there are buses that bring you to the subway station, they weren’t always running properly or on time when we were here - so just something to note if you plan on relying on public transport. Overall, such a great experience for such a reasonable price - you should definitely consider staying here on your next trip to New York!

I had an excellent experience staying with Pia and at this wonderful accommodation. The place was spotless, with comfortable rooms, TVs, and well-equipped spaces that made the stay very enjoyable. The privacy was perfect, and every detail was thoughtfully arranged to create a relaxing and welcoming atmosphere.
Pia was an amazing host who truly went above and beyond. She helped with genuine care and kindness, making me feel welcomed and well looked after throughout my stay.
I highly recommend this accommodation and would happily return again in the future. Thank you, Pia, for such a wonderful experience!

house_rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedString:
1. There is a strict no party rule at this property. If you host a party or incur a noise complaint you will lose your security deposit and your reservation will be cancelled immediately without refund. I use an on-site noise detector to help enforce this rule.
2. RVs and Buses are not permitted at this property. This is a city ordinance. If you bring an RV or Bus, your reservation will be cancelled without refund.
3. Smoking is not permitted at this property. If you smoke, you will be charged a $500 cleaning fee.
4. Check-Out is at 10 am. If you are over 30 minutes late for check out, there is a $100 fee to pay for the maid's time. If you are over 1 hour late, you'll lose your security deposit.
5. If you bring a pet, you are responsible for any damage that the pet causes. If your pet sheds excessively or leaves a large mess, you'll be charged a $150 deep cleaning fee. If your pet damages furniture, you'll be responsible for the cost of repair or replacement.
6. The maximum occupancy for this property is 10 people. If you exceed that occupancy, you will be charged an additional $20/per day/per person.
7. Our pool company services the pool during the week. You agree to allow them to access the backyard during your stay (they access from side gate). They will not enter the house and service is very fast. They don't provide a specific time window or advance notice, but it is always during business hours.
8. Do not remove the pool vacuum from the pool, or make adjustments to it. This can cause major damage. If you remove the pool vacuum, you will be charged for the cost of repairs.
9. There is a pool in the backyard. There is no fence around the pool and there is no lifeguard on duty. Children under the age of 18 must be supervised at all times while in the backyard, regardless of whether they are swimming. Guests shall not use the pool while intoxicated or under the influence of any drugs that could affect their ability to swim. Since there is no lifeguard on duty, guests shall never swim alone.

4. Check-Out is at 10 am. If you are over 30 minutes late for check out, there is a $100 fee to pay for the maid's time. If you are over 1 hour late, you'll lose your security deposit.
5. If you bring a pet, you are responsible for any damage that the pet causes. If your pet sheds excessively or leaves a large mess, you'll be charged a $150 deep cleaning fee. If your pet damages furniture, you'll be responsible for the cost of repair or replacement.
6. The maximum occupancy for this property is 10 people. If you exceed that occupancy, you will be charged an additional $20/per day/per person.
7. Our pool company services the pool during the week. You agree to allow them to access the backyard during your stay (they access from side gate). They will not enter the house and service is very fast. They don't provide a specific time window or advance notice, but it is always during business hours.
8. Do not remove the pool vacuum from the pool, or make adjustments to it. This can cause major damage. If you remove the pool vacuum, you will be charged for the cost of repairs.
9. There is a pool in the backyard. There is no fence around the pool and there is no lifeguard on duty. Children under the age of 18 must be supervised at all times while in the backyard, regardless of whether they are swimming. Guests shall not use the pool while intoxicated or under the influence of any drugs that could affect their ability to swim. Since there is no lifeguard on duty, guests shall never swim alone.

816228943571246398.description_html:
Step into 1958—revamped.

This fun, second-floor condo in Scottsdale’s historic Garden District blends retro style with modern comforts.

Enjoy the newly resurfaced pebble-tec heated pool surrounded by banana and orange trees, and walk to Old Town's best restaurants, art, and entertainment.

The space
Step into 1958—revived and reimagined. This second-floor 1-bed, 1-bath condo is a retro-inspired retreat in Scottsdale’s historic Garden District, where googie-style rooflines and western details echo the glamour of the past. Originally built to house overflow guests from the Hotel Valley Ho, this mid-century gem has been fully updated with modern touches and vintage style.

**Location, Location, Location
Walk to 90+ restaurants, 320 shops, 80 art galleries, Scottsdale Stadium, parks, museums, and the canal path. The newly resurfaced, heated community pool is framed by banana and orange trees—perfect for lounging after a day out.


** Inside the Space

Plush King bed with OEKO-TEX linens

Fully restored vintage kitchen with retro-style appliances

Pink velvet Joybird pullout sofa for extra guests

Smart TVs in both living room and bedroom

Bluetooth record player, vintage vinyl, smart speaker

Games, books, mid-mod vibes, and fun décor

Full-size washer + dryer available on property

Fresh exterior paint (Feb 2025!)


**Extras That Matter

Quartz counters, playful tile, and curated lighting

Keurig + coffee maker with supplies

Hair dryer, towels, and a basket of just-in-case items

Awesome A/C, safety monitors, and funky vibes

This is a place to relax, recharge, and relive the stylish soul of Scottsdale. Come for the sunshine, stay for the design.

Guest access
You’ll have full, private access to the condo during your stay.

This quiet, 30-unit mid-century building offers:

Self check-in with a key code

One covered parking space

Heated community pool (kept at 84° in winter)

Pool access via gate code (provided before check-in)

Lush tropical gardens and courtyard

Community grills and shared patio seating

Brand-new patio furniture (Feb 2025)

Sliding patio door access

Other things to note
Transparency matters to us.

There is no elevator to the second floor condo, only exterior stairs.

Just so you know, 100% of our cleaning fee goes directly to our wonderful professional cleaner—we keep none of it. Airbnb automatically adds its platform service fee on top, which we also don't receive.

Thank you so much for helping us support our cleaning team!

house_rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedString:
We want you to feel welcome and comfortable. Please review these important rules, which include House, Community, and legal requirements. All Guests and Visitors must follow these rules and any instructions from the Host.

Reporting Issues: Please notify the Host promptly of any disputes, complaints, or damages during your stay.

Emergency: Dial 911 on your own phone for emergencies. There is no landline in the home, and Wi-Fi calling may not be reliable. Afterward, please inform us as soon as possible.

Non-Emergency Contact: For any other issues, contact us via your confirmation email or booking app. We live nearby and respond quickly.

Legal Compliance: Guests and Visitors must obey all federal, state, and local laws including health, safety, noise, waste, and licensing regulations.

Community Rules: Please respect all posted signage in the condominium community.

Child Safety: This home is not childproofed. Watch children carefully, especially near stairs and the gated pool. Children must never swim unattended.

Occupancy: Maximum overnight occupancy is 4 persons, including children.

Noise: Scottsdale quiet hours are 10 PM to 9 AM. Please keep noise to a minimum. If neighbors ask you to be quieter, please comply politely.

Smoking: No smoking inside or within 20 feet of doors, windows, or ventilation systems.

Visitors & Parties: A maximum of 5 visitors at any time is allowed. Parties and large gatherings are prohibited.

Open Flames: No candles allowed. Only use the stove or oven when supervised. Do not leave the home while cooking.

Security: When leaving, lock all windows and doors to protect the home and community.

Pets & Emotional Support Animals: Pets are not allowed.

Service Animals: Service animals trained to assist guests with disabilities are permitted without extra fees or prior notice. Please inform us if you have a service animal (not mandatory) and clean up after them. Service animals must be under control and not cause disturbances.

Prohibited Uses: The home is for short-term residential use only. Commercial use, events, housing offenders, sober living, selling controlled substances, adult businesses, or home births are strictly prohibited.

Enforcement: Violation of these rules or causing a nuisance may result in eviction and termination of the rental agreement.

Damages & Breakages: Report any damage immediately. Do not move furniture between rooms without prior approval to avoid damage.

reviews.comments: We absolutely loved our stay at Jeff & Erika’s place. It’s such a vibe and I was obsessed with all the details and many amenities! We enjoyed the pool to cool off one evening and played records every day while drinking our morning coffee. The place was super clean and the bed was very comfortable. We would love to come back when we have more time and can explore a bit more on foot. It was close proximity to so many great restaurants & shops and also to ASU  to visit our son. Definitely recommend this place!

Stunning AirB&B in Scottsdale - highly recommend. Jeff and Erica have done a wonderful job with the decor and provide everything you need and more for a perfect stay, extremely comfy bed, good A/C, extra towels for pool etc.
Super responsive with great food recommendations. Flexible with check in/out.

Jeff and Erika were by far the best owners we dealt with throughout the many years. They went beyond everything they said in the description-- the games and Lego set for children were a personal touch that made a huge difference when the grandchildren dropped by to visit. The guest book was thorough and helpful. The place was superintendent, clean and comfortable. Thank you, Jeff and Erika, for being so responsive to our needs. We texted three times with questions, and they answered within a minute. Bravo!

Jeff and Erika's condo was just what I was looking for on my recent trip to Scottsdale and lived up to and even exceeded my expectations. The location was great! It was close to Old Town Scottsdale with all of it's restaurants and shopping, safe, quiet and easily accessible.
The condo was extremely clean, comfortable and well laid out. The bed was extremely comfortable, the kitchen had everything I needed and the condo was extremely quiet and peaceful.
We had a great stay! The Airbnb looked just like the photos and we walked to many restaurants. Beautiful and safe location. We would definitely stay again.
I’d come back again! We loved the vibe and location of this Airbnb. Thank you so much for a wonderful stay!!!

A throw back in time with all the modern conveniences! Such a cute place.
I expected to open the vintage looking fridge and see an ambrosia salad and a tab!
So comfortable and convenient for our plans.
Only minor issue is that the covered parking spot is on the opposite side of the building from the condo….. we had a lot of stuff to carry in, but utilized a closer non covered spot to unload and load back up when leaving. It was too hot to leave our stuff in the car. But that was minor! Don’t let it stop you from staying at this unique fabulous place.

This place is a gem. Located in a quiet complex near Old Town Scottsdale, it is close to everything but still a quiet retreat. The mid-mod decor is a delight, whimsical but functional.   The unit is well stocked and squeaky clean. Jeff and Erika kept in touch and anticipated any questions we might have had.  Highly recommended.

This was my second stay at one of Jeff and Erika’s places. I really like staying there. It is a nice condo in a retro complex and there are plenty of places close by- I never even moved my car from the parking space!

Absolutely enjoyed our stay with our 2.5 year old daughter. The beautiful decor transformed us to another era. The hosts were so kind and always answered our questions. Couch and bed were super comfy, water pressure strong, pool clean and high-quality Turkish towels and sunscreen, games and music a delight, and relaxing lighting for reading. Loved the breakfast croissant sandwich and coffee at Grounds on 2nd, the pastrami burrito at Alo Cafe, and spaghetti at Pizzeria Virtu...all within a 5 minute walk or less. Already recommended this place to friends and would definitely come back!
Jeff and Erika's place was exactly as advertised. Their communication and consideration is fantastic! The location is wonderful, calming and welcoming.  A great place to relax.

Enjoyed our stay in this cute spot. We arrived at night so it took a minute to find the parking spot, but once you locate parking and the apartment, it’s a breeze. Loved the decor. Good spot for a couple nights!
Fantastic! Resorted my faith in Airbnb. Great unit- clean, safe, and loved the style! the hosts were extremely responsive and made the process seamless. Would def stay here again!

Decided to stay in Scottsdale for a staycation.
What a wonderful apartment building! In the heart of Scottsdale, old town, however quiet evenings.
Pristine apartment, perfect furniture, and beautiful views of the pool and greenery.
Came into town for work. This is a great spot right in the middle of Old Town! Walkable to any restaurants/bars. Love the Palm Springs vibe/decoration in the townhome. Would recommend

We had a great stay! The location was amazing and within walking distance to so many places, which made everything super convenient. The space itself was very clean and well taken care of. There were also lots of great amenities, and the house was stocked with so many things you might need, which made it feel comfortable and easy to settle in. The hosts were incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with, making the whole experience smooth from start to finish. Would definitely stay here again!
Quirky and comfortable. The pool is great. Parking in the space provided, and easy on the street as well. I enjoyed the records… Village People AND Lionel.

Jeff and Erikas place was charming and the location was great for us since we were attending a wedding at a nearby venue and we were in walking distance to multiple shops and restaurants. We appreciated the accomodations such as having pool towels and sun screen available as well as some snacks available in the kitchen upon our arrival. We did unfortunately have  issues with the water during our stay due to construction that was occurring in another unit,  but Jeff and Erika were helpful to work with when these issues occured. We appreciated their response to the situation and would still consider staying here again in the future if we return to Scottsdale.
We had a great stay here. It was the perfect place for a little getaway! The place had everything we needed and a cozy bed. The building was quiet and centrally located. Would definitely recommend!

I had a wonderful time at Jeff and Erika’s Airbnb. The apartment was well furnished and looked exactly like the pictures. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the home was very clean. The building was very quiet and everyone was super friendly. I loved that you could use the pool early in the morning. It was very clean and the perfect temperature. If I am ever back in the area I will definitely stay here again. It was so close to everything you needed.

This garden apartment truly transports you back in time to the 50/60s with its decor! The commons space was private and quiet by the pool with beautiful palms and cactus. King bed firm and comfortable. My daughter was also very comfortable on pull out sofa. Variety of restaurants and art galleries within walking distance. Quiet apartment close to activity!  Hosts very quick to respond with communication and accommodating.  Kitchen was well stocked to cook if needed, too. Overall, a terrific place!

Ive stayed at many airbnbs - but this one is exceptionally special and definitely a great experience. The attention to detail, aesthetics in decor and execution were spot on. Its not just a place to stay, but a place you want to go back to and enjoy after a day touring the sites.
Its in the perfect Scottsdale location with everything - food, dining, shopping, all within walking distance. Theres a cute little grocery shop across the street if you need any extras.
The complex was friendly and we enjoyed taking advantage of the seating that overlooks the internal court yard next to a GIANT orange tree to take a break after exploring. Really the only thing i can think that would make it better is if the original palms were still growing through the designated roof openings, like in 1958.
The hosts were as special as the airbnb - very communicative and friendly and go above and beyond to make their guests feel welcome and comfortable.
I highly recommend staying here.

Absolutely loved staying here! Extremely close to so many bars/restaurants/shops. The condo was very clean, and the decor inside was so cute. We enjoyed using the pool in this 100+ degree weather so that was a great perk. Never had any issues with A/C and the complex was always very peaceful. Felt very safe, would absolutely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Jeff & Erika’s. The condo was very clean, had all the necessities, and so cutely decorated . It’s within walking distance to restaurants and great location. Bed was very comfortable and we enjoyed using the pool. The property itself is maintained very well.
Hosts were great! We would definitely return and recommend to anyone visiting the area. I’d prefer this type of stay versus any hotel :)

8513235.description_html:
Your own private bedroom and bathroom, and a secured off-street parking space, in a condo at Santa Monica Blvd and LaCienaga within walking distance of everything West Hollywood is famous for; Cedars Sinai Hospital, Sunset Blvd., Melrose Ave. and Hollywood Blvd., as well as the bars, restaurants and clubs for the nightlife. I live in the condo and have my own separate bedroom and bathroom.

No stay longer than 24 days.

No SERVICE ANIMALS, airbnb exempted, allergies, 12-6-19

The space
My mid-century condo has two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The guest bedroom has a queen-sized bed, a bedside table and lamp, a TV, a work table for your laptop, and a comfortable chair. I also provide a "white noise" sound soother so you won't be bothered by any noise outside your room. (One guest liked that so much he offered to buy it from me!) There is a "black-out" shade on the window so you won't be awakened by the light if you want to sleep late. I provide secured off-street parking, full use of the kitchen, and a washer/dryer to do your laundry.

Guest access
Your bedroom has its own TV with cable. You can use the kitchen as much as you need. If you will travel to WeHo in your car there will not be a problem with parking because I have a space just for you that you can enter right off the street. It is a covered space or you can leave your car in the driveway, but you won't have to concern yourself with any possibility of availability of street parking. Extra large SUVs and trucks, like Suburbans, Yukons, Ford F-150s, etc. may be a problem but otherwise mid-size vehicles will have enough room.
And, of course, you will have free WiFi.

During your stay
I will be around to help you with anything you might need. My schedule varies, so some days I will be out most of the day, and other times I am in and out throughout the day and night. I'm usually out three nights a week, as well as weekend activities that keep me busy away from home. I am pretty casual, very easy-going and pleasant.

Other things to note
This building and neighborhood are quiet, so you will be comfortable staying here. There is a bus stop one block away, but all the things West Hollywood is famous for is within walking distance. Check-in time is 12:00 noon, except Sundays when check-in is 1:30, and check out is 10 AM, but I usually can be very flexible with those times. Just be prepared in case I cannot be.

852850.description_html:
Traditional Tahoe A-Frame, two bedrooms, one bath, private and quiet.

The space
South Lake Tahoe A-Frame, modern amenities, two bedrooms, one bath, private and quiet. The chalet-style vacation home is located in a tranquil area within walking distance of a golf course and bike trails. Lake Tahoe beaches, horseback riding, fishing, water skiing, shopping and casino entertainment are within a 5-15 minutes drive.

The gas fireplace is ideal for those chilly nights. You are 10-15 minutes drive from Heavenly Valley and Sierra-At-Tahoe Ski Resorts, and about 30 minutes from Kirkwood. The fenced yard, gas BBQ and large back private patio provide ample room for outdoor activities. Surrounded by national forests, the A-Frame chalet has plenty of room for the children to play in safety, and is an ideal vacation gateway for the entire family.

House Amenities;
Wireless Internet. Central heat. Gas fireplace in living room. Fenced backyard patio set with tables, benches, hammock and chairs during the summer. Propane barbecue.

Sleeping Amenities;
Downstairs bedroom with one Queen Bed, across bathroom.
Upstairs loft bedroom with one queen bed. Please note: the stairs to this bedroom are narrow and steep and are not suitable for elderly guests, young children, or anyone with limited mobility. For added safety, guests are advised to use the stairs like a ladder, descending slowly while facing the steps and holding the handrail.

Kitchen Amenities;
Large deep kitchen sink. Microwave. Fridge. Freezer. Toaster. Coffee maker. Blender-mixer. Fully stocked kitchen with utensils and wares for 6 people. The centerpiece of the kitchen is a rare 1950's Magic Chef gas stove and oven.

Bathroom Amenities;
One sink. One toilet. One shower.

Living Room Entertainment Amenities;
44 inches flat-screen TV. Apple TV. DVD player with a library of DVDs.

Video Surveillance Security; the front porch of the house is on outside outdoor camera you will see. There are no other cameras.

For fire security reasons, no outside fires allowed at any time. No smoking on the property, too dangerous with the dry wood surroundings. No loud noises after 10:00 PM. Quiet Hours are from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. Please be respectful of our neighbors. NO PETS. We have a child who is severely allergic to animal hair. NO PETS ALLOWED PLEASE. Thank you for not harming our family.

El Dorado County VHR Permit # 072861. TOT # T65070.
Four adults maximum occupancy during quiet hours (excluding children 5 and under). Quiet hours must be observed between 10 PM and 8 AM.

Guest access
The house, front and back patios and fenced garden.

Other things to note
Bed sheets and bathroom towels supplied on site.

As mentioned earlier, we have a child who is severely allergic to animal hair. NO PETS ALLOWED PLEASE. Thank you for not harming our family.

Parking for two cars available except during snow season. PARKING FOR JUST ONE CAR DURING SNOW SEASON.

During the winter snow season, a four-wheel drive car or snow ready vehicle (having chains with you) is recommended. We have a professional snow removal service for the cabin. They come clear the driveway to park ONE car after more than 4 inches of snow fall, timing vary depending on where we are in the queue. When you arrive, if needed in case it is hard to get in the driveway after a snow storm, you will need to shovel just enough to park your car on the driveway. You may not park your car on the street during the winter snow season to allow snow removal vehicles. If you need to use the snow shovel stored inside the house, return inside after any use to avoid losing it under fresh new snow.

body.localizedContent: Right next to Washoe Meadows State Park, with bike trails and a golf course within walking distance.
A vintage 1950s Magic Chef gas stove anchors a fully stocked kitchen with everything to cook for four.
Guests highlight how cozy and comfortable the cabin feels, with many returning or planning to.

• Clinton Hotel South Beach is a 100% smoke-free property.

Parking

• The hotel does not provide on-site parking.

We are a family-owned property in a neighborhood.  The space is a lovely, recently renovated, 1-bedroom house.  Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

* 10 minutes to Biltmore Village
* 10-15 minutes to downtown Asheville
*Close to breweries, restaurants, local attractions

quality.guest_favorite_description: One of the most loved homes on Airbnb, according to guests

reviews.comments: i loved it, will be there again!

We loved staying here! The views were amazing, the home was peaceful and cozy. Bethany was a wonderful host and really made us feel welcome. It was in a great location to access all the fun things that Asheville has to offer and we can’t wait to stay here again!
If youre looking for a place that's peaceful and quiet. This is the spot. Beautiful views in the back and very well kept interior.

The place was immaculate. Nicely furnished kitchen for cooking.  Great places to enjoy sitting outside.  Location of home is close to great restaurants and various outdoor activities such as hiking and sight seeing.  Hope to stay here again!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The place was immaculate and the view was phenomenal! I can't wait to come back and visit!
We absolutely loved our stay. The house had everything we needed, was extremely clean and felt like home. It was the perfect, peaceful stay. Truly one of the best rentals we have stayed at.
Great house in a convenient location. We really enjoyed our stay and visit to Asheville.
We had a great time staying at Bethany’s place in Asheville. It was peaceful, beautiful, and a short drive from downtown.

We couldn't have been more pleased with this place.  We loved how quiet and peaceful the surroundings were, lots of outdoor space to relax and even a cute tree swing. The place was immaculate and the amenities and extras were well thought out and made our stay super comfortable.  Everything was clearly labeled or communicated and the location was perfect, within 10-15 minutes or closer to shops and restaurants. The bedding was really cozy and soft, nice bath towels and comfy blankets for snuggling on the couch.  I love the guest book, it was so helpful to read other guests suggestions on things to do and places to eat. Would definitely stay here again.

Serene setting with drop dead gorgeous views. Nice and clean and enjoyed the decks immensely.
Very relaxing environment.

My wife and I stayed here and really enjoyed this location for a few days. The number of porches and swings around the house make it perfect for slow starts and lazy afternoons - exactly what we were hoping to find! Bethany communicates very well, and was great at covering any and all of our questions about the place!

My wife and I stayed at Bethany’s place, and it exceeded our expectations in every way. Everything was immaculate, comfortable, and even more spacious than we anticipated. There were multiple outdoor seating areas where we could relax and enjoy the beautiful, peaceful surroundings. It was exactly what we were looking for in a mountain getaway. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quiet, relaxing retreat.
Lovely place with lots of thoughtful touches! The views are wonderful.
Wonderful and peaceful place! Host was very accommodating.
Comfortable,  clean,  and beautiful.  Great stay.
Private backyard and beautiful backyard. We had a lovely stay.
The house is charming, immaculate, and perfect for a few guests. We stopped for only a few days on a trip from Florida to Michigan. We will definitely pass a recommendation to other couple friends.
We would definitely stay again. Cleaniest Airbnb to date. Nice and Peaceful. Views were beautiful as well.

This house was perfect for my partner and I! It was very clean and Bethany thought of everything we could have possibly wanted. We loved sitting on the porches in the evening and listening to the birds and watching the fireflies and the horses. The house was very comfortable and perfect for a couple. Thank you so much Bethany!

As stated, the only negative thing is the gravel road/driveway but it was no problem in the SUV we rented.   I hate to even mention it because everything else was absolutely wonderful! The Airbnb is pristine and everything is of the highest quality.  The bed is a very comfortable king.  The shower is great. There are two TVs-one in bedroom, one in livingroom.  Bethany provided keurig coffee , a few snacks and a couple waters (which we conveniently took with us on a hike).  I could mention many more details, suffice it to say everything you need is provided and top notch.  And the setting was so peaceful.  There is a wind chime that I thought might be irritating but instead was a sweet melodic tone. I'm going to buy one for my own home.   Sitting on the deck or the view from the dining area is beautiful--  rolling green grass, horse neighbors and surrounding mountains.  Bethany responds to questions and requests promptly and positively.  Bethany and her Airbnb certainly deserve 5 stars!

We’ve stayed in many Airbnbs around the world, and this was truly one of the best. The amenities were top-notch, the house was spotless, and everything was thoughtfully arranged and easy to find. The location was stunning—overlooking the mountains and a horse ranch, which made it feel incredibly serene. They were even able to provide a baby crib for us last minute—so accommodating and helpful. We especially loved the outdoor sitting areas, perfect for relaxing and recharging. A fantastic stay all around!

Perfect stay in Asheville!  Peaceful, beautiful surroundings.  Loved being just a few minutes from restaurants, hiking, and Biltmore, but with the quiet & nature of the country.  Extremely comfortable bed and linens.  Easy check-in.  All the amenities of home.  Would love to stay again if we are back in the area.

Bethany's place was great - we stayed for 3 nights and didn't have any problems after we found the place initially. (The driveway to the house wasn't quite what we expected - it's a gravel road and you can't see the house when you turn in, but can see several others that share the drive.) Place was clean and in a decent location. Only issue was that we thought based on the description that it was more private than it is. There are multiple rentals or airbnbs on the same land, so it's not really private. It was good for what it was, just not what we expected for our stay. The place is well-stocked, clean, and bright. Would recommend it to others.

Our stay was wonderful. It was beautifully decorated and had everything you needed. The Mountain View from the porch was gorgeous.
Bethany was easy to communicate with.
I would stay here again.

content.localizedString:
We live close to the Blue Ridge Parkway so occasionally you may see bears or other wildlife.  Do not approach them.  

Our neighbors have horses and there is an electric fence around the horse pasture.  You are welcome to look at the horses, just don't touch the fence.
